title: Kompaniya katalogidagi "remote/office" filtri faqat employment_type'ga qaraydi, yangi workplaceType maydonini e'tiborsiz qoldiradi

title: Default /vacancies saralashi (isPremium, publishedAt, id) indeksga tushmaydi: har sahifa, har filtrda 5k faol vakansiya blocking sort qilinadi

DATE_ORDER esa isPremium desc bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun Mongo indeks orqali saralay olmaydi va barcha mos hujjatlarni (description bilan, ~3-5KB) xotirada saralaydi. `popular` (viewsCount) va `salary_*` (isPremium, salaryMin) ham indekssiz. Bundan tashqari buildFilters'dagi relation filtrlari (category.slug, region.slug, company.isVerified/slug) va textFilter'dagi company.name/category.name Prisma Mongo'da $lookup+$match bo'lib bajariladi, bu indeksdan oldingi $match'ni zaiflashtiradi.

title: /api/conversations — barcha suhbatlar chegarasiz, har suhbat uchun nested `messages take:1`, company.description bilan, tartiblash xotirada
root_cause: findMany'da take yo'q; oxirgi xabar Conversation'da denormalizatsiya qilinmagan, shuning uchun har suhbat uchun `messages: { orderBy, take: 1 }` (Prisma Mongo'da per-parent take qanday bajarilishi — low confidence; ehtimol barcha messages $in bilan olinib xotirada kesiladi). Keyin `lastMessageAt` bo'yicha JS'da sort. Javobga `company.description` (2000 belgigacha) har suhbatda qo'shiladi. Qo'shimcha `application.findMany` (jobSeekerId in × vacancy.companyId in) — cross-product, relation filtr.
impact: Faol ish beruvchi (1000+ suhbat, 100k xabar miqyosi) uchun har /messages ochilishida minglab suhbat + ularning xabarlari + arizalari tortiladi; javob bir necha MB; DB'da har safar to'liq skan/lookup.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:449-472 (findMany take yo'q, `messages: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 1 }`, `description: true`), 474-482 groupBy unread, 487-513 applications, 580 `items.sort(...)`. schema.prisma:491-509: Conversation'da lastMessageAt yo'q, updatedAt indekssiz.
recommended_fix: Conversation'ga `lastMessageAt`, `lastMessagePreview`, `lastMessageSenderId` (message.create paytida update; backward-compat: null bo'lsa createdAt) + `@@index([employerUserId, lastMessageAt])`, `@@index([seekerUserId, lastMessageAt])`; `orderBy: { lastMessageAt: 'desc' }, take: 50` + cursor; `description` ni ro'yxatdan olib tashlash (kompaniya sahifasida bor); vacancy kontekstini faqat sahifadagi suhbatlar uchun so'rash.
dependencies: Message yaratish joylari: chat.routes.ts:392 (WS), applications.routes.ts:249 (reason xabari); web /messages sahifasi cursor'ga moslanishi.
fix_risk: O'rta: schema'ga maydon qo'shish (`prisma db push`), eski suhbatlar uchun backfill yoki fallback kerak.

title: /api/conversations/:id/messages — suhbatning BARCHA xabarlari bir so'rovda
root_cause: `message.findMany({ where: { conversationId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } })` take yo'q.
impact: Uzoq suhbat (minglab xabar) har ochilganda to'liq yuklanadi — katta javob va sekin render; 100k xabar miqyosida ayrim suhbatlar bir necha MB.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:602-606. Indeks [conversationId, createdAt] bor (schema.prisma:544) — sahifalash uchun tayyor.
recommended_fix: `?before=<createdAt|id>&limit=50` (max 100): `orderBy: createdAt desc, take: limit`, keyin reverse; javobda `hasMore`. Front'da yuqoriga scroll'da yuklash.
dependencies: apps/web/src/pages/messages/+Page.tsx xabarlar ro'yxati va WS bilan birlashish.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: UI'da 'yana yuklash' kerak; default limit katta (100) qilib bosqichma-bosqich o'tish mumkin.

title: /api/inbox/summary (header, tez-tez chaqiriladi) — barcha suhbat id'lari + isRead skan + ikki bosqichli relation count
root_cause: 1) `conversation.findMany select id` (chegarasiz) → `message.count({ conversationId in [...], senderId != me, isRead: false })` — [conversationId, createdAt] indeksi faqat prefiks beradi, isRead/senderId bo'yicha suhbat ichidagi barcha xabarlar tekshiriladi. 2) `application.count({ vacancy: { company: { ownerUserId } }, status: 'sent' })` — $lookup zanjiri, indekssiz.
impact: Har sahifa yuklanishi/polling'da og'ir so'rov; 1000 suhbat × yuz minglab xabar → doimiy DB yuki.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:750-764. schema.prisma:544 Message indekslari: [conversationId, createdAt], [senderId].
recommended_fix: Message'ga `@@index([conversationId, isRead, senderId])` (yoki Conversation'da `unreadForEmployer/unreadForSeeker` hisoblagich, read/create paytida yangilanadi). Yangi arizalar: companyId → vacancy ids → `application.count({ vacancyId: { in }, status: 'sent' })` + `@@index([vacancyId, status])`. Javobga `Cache-Control: private, max-age=15` yoki WS orqali push.
dependencies: P2 conversations finding bilan birga denormalizatsiya qilish qulay.
fix_risk: Past (indeks) / o'rta (hisoblagich — read/create yo'llarida sinxron saqlash kerak).

title: Kompaniyalar katalogi — har so'rovda (va har cursor sahifasida) BARCHA mos kompaniyalar uchun 2 ta $lookup + hisoblangan kalit bo'yicha xotirada sort; text/industry filtri regex
root_cause: rating/activeVacancyCount denormalizatsiya qilinmagan; pipeline: match(base) → $lookup reviews (group) → $lookup vacancies (group) → $set _sort → $sort → $limit. Cursor sahifasi ham to'liq qayta hisoblaydi. `industry`/`q` regex indekssiz.
impact: 2k kompaniyada har sahifa ≈ 2k×2 lookup (indeks companyId bor) — hozir yuz ms'lab, 10k+ kompaniyada soniyalar. Fayl sharhining o'zi (20-22 qatorlar) buni tan oladi.
evidence: companies.list.ts:262-305 computed, 317-343 pipeline/facet, 246 region lookup, 235-238 regex text. schema.prisma:299-336 Company'da hisoblagich maydonlari yo'q.
recommended_fix: Company'ga `ratingAvg`, `reviewCount`, `activeVacancyCount`, `activeVacancyViews`, `hasRemote/hasOffice` denormalizatsiya (review approve/delete, vacancy status/views o'zgarishida yoki 5 daqiqalik fon job bilan yangilash) + `@@index([isVerified, ...])`; pipeline'ni fallback sifatida qoldirish. Minimal: birinchi sahifa natijasini (filtrsiz `popular`) 60s keshlash.
dependencies: reviews.routes.ts, admin.routes.ts (review moderate/delete), vacancies status o'zgarishlari; similarCompanies ham shu pipeline.
fix_risk: O'rta: hisoblagichlar sinxron qolishi kerak; fon job bilan xavf kam.

title: /api/companies/:slug — kompaniyaning BARCHA tasdiqlangan sharhlari (user profili bilan) va BARCHA faol vakansiyalari (to'liq description, region, category) bitta javobda
root_cause: include'da reviews va vacancies uchun take yo'q; vacancies `include` to'liq.
impact: Yirik ish beruvchi (500 faol vakansiya × 3–5 KB) → 1.5–2.5 MB javob; minglab sharh ham to'liq. Ochiq sahifa — crawler'lar ham uradi.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:562-587.
recommended_fix: `reviews: { take: 20, orderBy }` + alohida `GET /api/companies/:slug/reviews?page=`; `vacancies: { take: 20, select: karta maydonlari }` + `activeVacancyCount`; qolganlari `/api/vacancies?company=<slug>` orqali (allaqachon bor). Ish beruvchining ichki maydonlarini (stir, ownerUserId, subscription*) select bilan chiqarmaslik.
dependencies: apps/web kompaniya sahifasi (+data.ts) vakansiyalar/sharhlar bloklari.

title: Sitemap'lar — 50 000 tagacha yozuv har so'rovda, 4 hreflang alternate bilan ~12 MB XML xotirada, kesh yo'q; companies sitemap filtrsiz
root_cause: `findMany take 50000` + har URL uchun 3 hreflang + x-default satrlar; Cache-Control yo'q; `company.findMany` barcha kompaniyalar (vakansiyasi yo'q/bo'sh profillar ham).
impact: 20k vakansiya × ~600 bayt ≈ 12 MB javob har crawler so'rovida; string konkatenatsiya + DB o'qish; Google 50 MB chegarasiga yaqinlashish xavfi 50k'da.
recommended_fix: Sitemap index'ni 5 000 talik bo'laklarga bo'lish (`/sitemap-vacancy-1.xml`, skip/take yoki publishedAt cursor), `select` faqat slug/updatedAt (bor), in-memory kesh 1 soat + `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600`; hreflang'ni `/ru`,`/en` faqat kerak bo'lsa (yoki x-default olib tashlash) — hajm ~40% kamayadi. Companies: faqat `vacancies: { some: { status:'active' } }` yoki description bor kompaniyalar.
dependencies: apps/web/vercel.json rewrites (`/sitemap*.xml`) yangi nomlarni ham qamrab olishi kerak.

title: /api/stats/salary — har so'rovda 20 000 tagacha faol vakansiya (category/region include bilan) xotiraga, kesh yo'q, ochiq endpoint + sitemap havolalari
root_cause: `findMany({ where: { status: 'active' }, select {...category, region}, take: MAX_ROWS=20000 })` har chaqiruvda; filtrlar keyin JS'da. Sitemap-static har kategoriya/hudud uchun /salaries?… havola beradi → crawlerlar bu endpointni tez-tez uradi.
impact: 20k vakansiyada har so'rov ~2–4 MB Mongo'dan o'qish + 2 qo'shimcha $in so'rov (category, region) + JS'da sort/percentile — 100+ ms CPU; bir necha parallel so'rovda event-loop bloklanadi.
evidence: salary.stats.ts:75 MAX_ROWS, 161-175 findMany, 189-249 xotirada hisob; seo.routes.ts:694-703 salary sahifalari sitemap'da.
recommended_fix: Bazaviy dataset'ni (rows) in-memory keshlash TTL 5–10 min (bitta Promise, stampede'siz) — filtrlar allaqachon xotirada qo'llanadi, shuning uchun kalit kerak emas; yoki Mongo `$group`/`$bucket` aggregation. `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. select'dan `category/region` include o'rniga categoryId/regionId + bitta katalog kesh.
dependencies: Yo'q (mustaqil).
fix_risk: Past: ma'lumot 5–10 daqiqa eskiroq bo'ladi (statistika uchun qabul qilinadi).

title: /api/stats (bosh sahifa) — `application.count({ createdAt >= today })` indekssiz (Application.createdAt), kesh yo'q
root_cause: Application modelida createdAt bo'yicha indeks yo'q; count → 50k hujjat skan har bosh sahifa yuklanishida. `company.count()` ham countDocuments (skan, 2k — arzon).
impact: Eng ko'p ochiladigan sahifa har safar 50k hujjatli skan qiladi.
evidence: stats.routes.ts:266-270; schema.prisma:465-467 (Application indekslari: [vacancyId,jobSeekerId], [jobSeekerId], [resumeId]).
recommended_fix: `@@index([createdAt])` Application'ga; javobni 60s in-memory kesh + `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60`. Admin overview (admin.routes.ts:349-350, 359-365) ham shu indeksdan foydalanadi; User'ga ham `@@index([createdAt])`.
dependencies: prisma db push.

title: /api/employer/vacancies — chegarasiz, relation filtr, to'liq region/category include, har vakansiya uchun _count
root_cause: `where: { company: { ownerUserId } }` ($lookup), take yo'q, `region: true, category: true` to'liq, `_count.applications` per vakansiya.
impact: Yirik ish beruvchi (yuzlab vakansiya, har biri to'liq description) → katta javob va sekin sahifa; 20k vakansiya miqyosida $lookup companies har safar.
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:575-585.
recommended_fix: companyId ni avval topib `where: { companyId }` (indeks companyId); `?status=&page=&pageSize<=50`; ro'yxatda `select` (id, slug, title, status, salary*, workplaceType, publishedAt, viewsCount, region{name,slug}, category{name,slug}); applicationCount'ni `application.groupBy({ by: ['vacancyId'], where: { vacancyId: { in } } })` bilan; `@@index([companyId, status, createdAt])`.
dependencies: apps/web/src/pages/employer/vacancies/+Page.tsx.

title: Vakansiya ro'yxati: sort indekssiz (xotirada), LIST_INCLUDE `company: true` to'liq kompaniya obyekti, count double-scan, page cap yo'q
root_cause: orderBy [isPremium desc, publishedAt desc, id desc] / [viewsCount...] / [isPremium, salaryMin] uchun mos indeks yo'q (faqat [status, publishedAt]); Mongo filtrlangan to'plamni xotirada saralaydi (description bilan katta hujjatlar). `company: true` → description, stir, legalName, ownerUserId, subscriptionPlanId, images[] har kartada. `count({ where })` alohida to'liq skan. `page` faqat >=1 clamp, yuqori chegara yo'q (`?page=1e9` → skip 5e10).
impact: 20k faol vakansiyada har ro'yxat so'rovi indekssiz sort + count; javob 20–50 karta × to'liq company ≈ 100–300 KB; ichki maydonlar (ownerUserId, stir) ochiq API'ga chiqadi.
evidence: vacancies.service.ts:35 `LIST_INCLUDE = { company: true, region: true, category: true }`; 129-142 SORT_ORDERS; 154-187 listBySalary (3 so'rov + count); 190-192 page/pageSize (page cap yo'q); 240-251 findMany+count. schema.prisma:436-439 Vacancy indekslari.
recommended_fix: Schema: `@@index([status, isPremium, publishedAt])`, `@@index([status, salaryMin])`, `@@index([status, viewsCount])`. LIST_INCLUDE → `company: { select: { id, name, slug, logoUrl, isVerified, industry } }`, region/category `{ name, slug }`; ro'yxat kartasida `description` ni 200 belgiga qisqartirish yoki chiqarmaslik (detail sahifada bor). `page` ni `min(page, 200)` yoki `ceil(total/pageSize)` bilan clamp. Kirish `page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000)`.
dependencies: VacancyCard (apps/web/src/components/vacancies/VacancyCard.tsx) va lib/types.ts company maydonlari; alerts.service.ts listVacancies'ga tayanadi.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: front company.* maydonlaridan foydalansa (masalan description) tekshirish kerak.

title: Matn qidiruvi (Meili yo'q rejim): 6 termgacha × (title|description|requirements|company.name|category.name) regex contains — to'liq skan + $lookup, keyin count va 7 facet so'rovi bir xil filtr bilan
root_cause: `contains, mode: insensitive` → `$regex /term/i` (indeks ishlamaydi), description (KB'lab matn) ustida; `company.name`/`category.name` relation filtr → har vakansiya uchun $lookup. Bitta sahifa = findMany + count + facets (7 ta) = ~9 ta to'liq skan.
impact: 20k faol vakansiyada har qidiruv yuzlab ms – soniyalar; facets bilan birga DB CPU ko'p; alerts sweep ham shu yo'ldan yuradi (har obuna uchun).
evidence: vacancies.service.ts:101-126 textFilter; 232-251; 276-285 vacancyFacets (7 parallel so'rov, har biri where('...') + textFilter); search.service.ts:882 reindexAll.
recommended_fix: Minimal: Vacancy'ga `searchText` (normalize(title+companyName+categoryName+regionName)) maydoni (Article.searchText kabi, create/update/company rename'da yangilanadi) — qisqa so'zlar faqat shu maydonda, `description` faqat term>=4 va faqat `title/searchText` mos kelmaganda; relation filtrlar ($lookup) yo'qoladi. Prisma `fullTextIndex` preview (Mongo `$text`) ham variant. Facets: bitta `aggregateRaw` `$facet` pipeline yoki 60s in-memory kesh (normalized query kaliti). Meili yoqilganda production'da ishlatish tavsiya.
dependencies: vacancies.service.ts createVacancy/update, companies.routes.ts kompaniya nomi o'zgarganda backfill; demo-seed.
fix_risk: O'rta: qidiruv natijalari biroz o'zgaradi (description'da qidiruv qisqaradi); backfill kerak.

title: vacancyFacets — 7 ta groupBy/count har so'rovda, companies groupBy 2000 guruh → 2000 id bilan findMany → keyin .slice(0,100)
root_cause: Har o'lchov o'z filtrini chetlab alohida aggregate; companyId bo'yicha groupBy barcha kompaniyalarni qaytaradi, so'ng nomlari `company.findMany({ id in [~2000] })` bilan olinadi va faqat 100 tasi ishlatiladi. Kesh yo'q; facets har filtr o'zgarishida chaqiriladi.
impact: Har ro'yxat sahifasi 8–9 DB so'rovi; matn bilan — 7 regex skan. 20k vakansiya, 2k kompaniya: yuz ms'lab qo'shimcha.
evidence: vacancies.service.ts:276-300 (7 so'rov), 292-295 company.findMany id in barcha groupBy natijasi, 323-331 `.slice(0, 100)`.
recommended_fix: byCompany'ni count bo'yicha saralab 100 ga kesgandan KEYIN nomlarni olish; barcha facetlarni bitta `vacancy.aggregateRaw` `$facet` bilan (1 ta skan); 60s TTL in-memory kesh (Map, key = normalized filtr). Filtrsiz (default) facet natijasini alohida keshlash — eng ko'p chaqiriladigani.
dependencies: Matn qidiruvi finding'i bilan birga.

title: /api/employer/applications cheklanmagan: barcha arizalar to'liq rezyume bilan bitta javobda, filtr va sahifalash client'da
root_cause: findMany'da take, cursor va filtr yo'q; har bir ariza uchun resume.experience, education, skills va statusHistory include qilinadi, vacancy._count esa har qatorda qayta hisoblanadi. Frontend butun ro'yxatni xotirada filtrlaydi (EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:98-113, adapter.ts:199-219).
impact: ~50 000 ariza hajmida faol employer uchun javob megabaytlab bo'ladi, Mongo'da ko'p $lookup ishlaydi (application→vacancy→company relation filter ownerUserId). Har tanlovda markViewed bor, sahifa sekin ochiladi. inbox/summary ham har sahifada xuddi shu relation filter bilan count qiladi (chat.routes.ts:479-483).
evidence: applications.routes.ts:128-177 (take yo'q, 144 _count, 168-174 to'liq resume); EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:61-64 izohi 'to'liq ro'yxat — qidiruv, filtr va sahifalash klientda'; DESIGN.md:100.
recommended_fix: Bosqichma-bosqich: 1) Avval companyId'larni olib `where: { vacancy: { companyId: { in: ids } } }` ishlatish. 2) Server'da `status`, `vacancyId`, `page/pageSize` (≤50) query parametrlari, `total` va status bo'yicha `groupBy` sonlari. 3) Ro'yxatda faqat karta maydonlari qolsin, to'liq rezyume esa `GET /api/employer/applications/:id` detali bilan. 4) Application'ga `@@index([vacancyId, status, createdAt])`. Frontend URL state allaqachon status/vacancy/page'ni saqlaydi, uni server so'roviga ulash kerak.
dependencies: lib/employer/applications/api.ts, query.ts, EmployerApplicationsView; statusCounts server'ga ko'chadi; schema index (prisma db push).
fix_risk: O'rta: client qidiruvi (ism/ko'nikma) server'ga ko'chishi kerak.

title: Holat izohi chatga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri DB yozuvi sifatida tushadi: WS push yo'q, chat telefon gate'i chetlab o'tiladi, notify URL izohsiz ham /messages
root_cause: Izoh `prisma.message.create` bilan yoziladi, chat modulidagi `sendToUser` (chat.routes.ts:111-125) chaqirilmaydi. PATCH route'da `requirePhoneVerified` yo'q, holbuki `/api/conversations/start` uni talab qiladi (chat.routes.ts:140). Bildirishnoma izoh bo'lmasa ham `url: '/messages'` va 'Suhbatni ochish' CTA'si bilan ketadi.
impact: Nomzod onlayn bo'lsa ham izoh chatda real vaqtda ko'rinmaydi. Telefoni tasdiqlanmagan employer boshqa yo'l bilan yoza olmaydigan nomzodga shu yo'l bilan xabar yubora oladi. Izohsiz holat o'zgarishida nomzod bo'sh yoki aloqasiz suhbatga yo'naltiriladi.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:243-252, 262-269; chat.routes.ts:111-125 (sendToUser), 140 (requirePhoneVerified).
recommended_fix: chat modulidan xabar yaratish va push qilishni bitta exported helper'ga (`postSystemMessage(conv, senderId, body)`) chiqarib, shu yerda ishlatish. Izoh bo'lsa phone gate qo'llash (yoki izohni faqat verified employer uchun qabul qilish). `url` va `ctaLabel`: izoh bo'lsa /messages, bo'lmasa /applications.
dependencies: chat.routes.ts'dagi sendToUser/isOnline eksporti.

title: Nomzodlar qidiruvi har bir employer'ga ochiq ish izlovchilarning email va telefonini beradi; sahifalash yo'q, qat'iy 50 ta
root_cause: Javobda `email: p.user.email, phone: p.user.phone` bor, faqat `isOpenToWork: true` sharti bilan. Ariza munosabati yoki nomzod roziligi tekshirilmaydi. `take: 50`, `orderBy: userId` bo'lib cursor/page yo'q, `resumes: { some: {} }` va ichki skills `contains` so'rovi indekssiz.
impact: 402 gate olib tashlansa, har qanday ro'yxatdan o'tgan employer barcha ochiq nomzodlarning kontaktlarini ommaviy yig'ib olishi mumkin (rule 3 'noqonuniy expose'). Birinchi 50 tadan keyingilarni ko'rib bo'lmaydi. 10k user'da `contains` + nested some so'rovi to'liq skanerlashga olib keladi.
evidence: candidates.routes.ts:250-285, 307-312; pages/employer/candidates/+Page.tsx:210-223 (email/phone ko'rsatiladi).
recommended_fix: Product qarori kerak. Minimal yechim: ro'yxat javobidan email/phone'ni olib tashlash va aloqani mavjud 'Xabar yozish' (conversations/start) orqali qilish. Kontaktlar faqat ariza orqali (`/api/employer/applications`) ochiladi. Sahifalash: `cursor` (userId) va `take ≤ 20`.
dependencies: Nomzodlar bazasi 402 topilmasi (gate olib tashlansa bu ustuvor bo'ladi); types.ts Candidate; candidates +Page.tsx.

title: Employer bir nechta kompaniya yarata oladi; barcha yo'llar findFirst'ni orderBy'siz ishlatadi, shuning uchun qaysi kompaniya tanlanishi noaniq
root_cause: POST /api/companies mavjud kompaniyani tekshirmaydi. PUT upsert'i findFirst→create ketma-ketligida, ownerUserId'da unique indeks yo'q (schema.prisma:333, faqat @@index), shuning uchun parallel so'rovlarda ikki kompaniya paydo bo'ladi. Vakansiya yaratish, nomzodlar va chat `findFirst({ where: { ownerUserId } })`ni orderBy'siz chaqiradi.
impact: Vakansiya ixtiyoriy kompaniyaga bog'lanadi. /api/employer/company profilda boshqa kompaniyani ko'rsatishi mumkin, logo boshqa kompaniyaga yuklanadi. /api/employer/vacancies esa barcha kompaniyalarni aralashtiradi. Ma'lumot izchilligi buziladi.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:211-221 (tekshiruvsiz create), 88-121 (upsert race), 73, 130, 164; vacancies.routes.ts:136; candidates.routes.ts:238; chat.routes.ts:150; schema.prisma:333.
recommended_fix: POST /api/companies: kompaniya mavjud bo'lsa 409 qaytarish (yoki web ishlatmasa endpoint'ni olib tashlash, grep qiling). Barcha `findFirst({ where: { ownerUserId } })` chaqiruvlariga `orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }` qo'shish (deterministik). Unique indeks faqat dublikatlar tozalangandan keyin qo'yilsin.
dependencies: Bazada dublikat kompaniyalar bor-yo'qligini tekshirish (read-only so'rov).
fix_risk: Past: orderBy va 409 qo'shimchalari mavjud yagona-kompaniya holatini o'zgartirmaydi.

title: /api/employer/vacancies cheklanmagan to'liq hujjatlar qaytaradi; tahrirlash sahifasi bitta vakansiya uchun butun ro'yxatni yuklaydi
root_cause: findMany'da take yo'q va hamma maydonlar (description, requirements, conditions, images...) qaytadi, region/category esa to'liq include. GET by id endpoint'i yo'q, shuning uchun VacancyFormView edit'da butun ro'yxatni olib `find` qiladi.
impact: Yuzlab-minglab vakansiyali employer har dashboard ochilishida va har tahrirlashda butun ro'yxatni to'liq matnlari bilan oladi. Filtr, qidiruv va sahifalash client'da (EmployerVacanciesView.tsx:75, 97-98).
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:100-116; VacancyFormView.tsx:79, 86-89; EmployerVacanciesView.tsx:42-47; DESIGN.md:67.
recommended_fix: 1) Ro'yxat uchun `select`: faqat VM maydonlari (id, slug, title, status, rejectionReason, region{name,slug}, category{name,slug}, employmentType, workplaceType, salary*, isSalaryHidden, createdAt, publishedAt, _count), `take` limiti bilan (masalan 500) yoki page/pageSize. 2) `GET /api/employer/vacancies/:id` (ownedVacancy bilan) qo'shib, VacancyFormView edit'da uni ishlatish. Bu mavjud bo'lmagan feature emas, mavjud data'ni to'g'ri olish.
dependencies: lib/employer/vacancies/api.ts fetchEmployerVacancyRecords; VacancyFormView.

title: Route va query ID'lari ObjectId sifatida tekshirilmaydi: noto'g'ri ID Prisma xatosi orqali 500 beradi; coverLetter uzunligi cheklanmagan
root_cause: `req.params as { id: string }` to'g'ridan-to'g'ri findUnique'ga beriladi. MongoDB Prisma noto'g'ri ObjectId'da P2023 (Malformed ObjectID) otadi, error handler esa faqat P2002 va P2025'ni ushlaydi (server.ts:126-133). candidates.routes.ts'da `query.region` Zod'siz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri `regionId`ga ketadi. applySchema.coverLetter'da max yo'q.
impact: `PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/vacancies/abc`, `PATCH /api/applications/abc/status`, `POST /api/vacancies/abc/apply`, `/api/vacancies/abc/applications`, `/api/candidates?region=x` so'rovlari 400/404 o'rniga 500 va error log beradi. Cheklanmagan coverLetter (Fastify body limiti ~1MB gacha) bazani shishiradi.
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:150, 199, 231 (+ownedVacancy 78); applications.routes.ts:29, 187, 214; candidates.routes.ts:246, 254; applications.routes.ts:14; server.ts:126-133.
recommended_fix: Umumiy `const idParams = z.object({ id: objectId() })` bilan `idParams.parse(req.params)` (Zod xatosi 400). candidates query'si uchun `z.object({ text: z.string().max(100).optional(), region: objectId().optional() })`. `coverLetter: z.string().trim().max(5000).optional()`. Xohlasangiz error handler'da P2023 → 400.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: PATCH status → active placement qoidasini qayta tekshirmaydi: eski yoki to'liq bo'lmagan yozuvlar qayta e'lon qilinadi
root_cause: POST va PUT `assertVacancyPlacement` chaqiradi, PATCH status esa draft/archived→active'da chaqirmaydi. workplaceType=null yoki categoryId=null bo'lgan eski yozuvlar (schema'da ixtiyoriy) faollashtiriladi.
impact: Kategoriyasiz yoki joylashuvsiz vakansiya ommaviy ro'yxatga, facet'larga va indeksga tushadi, kategoriya facet'ida hisoblanmaydi. Rule 2 ('kategoriya majburiy') faqat yaratish/tahrirlashda amal qiladi, qayta faollashtirishda emas.
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:195-223 (assert yo'q) vs 139, 154-158; schema.prisma:398, 408 (categoryId?, workplaceType?).
recommended_fix: `status === 'active'` bo'lganda `await assertVacancyPlacement({ categoryId: vacancy.categoryId, regionId: vacancy.regionId, workplaceType: vacancy.workplaceType ?? (vacancy.employmentType === 'remote' ? 'remote' : null) })`. Xato bo'lsa 400 'Avval tahrirlab kategoriya/joylashuvni to'ldiring'. Frontend vacancyActionErrorKind 400'ni generic emas, backend xabari bilan ko'rsatsin.
dependencies: lib/employer/vacancies/api.ts setVacancyStatus xabarni tashlab yuboradi (api.ts:767), uni ApiError message bilan uzatish kerak.
fix_risk: O'rta: eski archived vakansiyalarni tahrirlamasdan faollashtirish endi bloklanadi (backward compat trade-off).

title: 401 → refresh yo'li yo'q: bitta refresh muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa 15-24 daqiqa oralig'ida hamma so'rov 401, status 'authed' bo'lib qoladi
root_cause: Access token faqat 12 daqiqalik intervalda yangilanadi (77-83); interval chaqiruvi tarmoq sabab `null` qaytarsa hech narsa qilinmaydi — keyingi urinish 24-daqiqada. lib/api.ts da 401 ni ushlab refresh qiladigan umumiy qatlam yo'q (grep: faqat useApplication.ts:79 lokal 401). Refresh cookie tugaganda (30 kun) ham `status` 'authed' qoladi, token o'lik. useChatSocket.ts:35,48 esa closure'dagi eskirgan token bilan har ≤30s qayta ulanadi (server rad etadi → onclose → yana).
impact: Foydalanuvchi 'kirgan' ko'rinadi, lekin arizalar/xabarlar/saqlash 401 bilan yiqiladi; WS reconnect shovqini.
evidence: AuthContext.tsx:78-82 `const fresh = await refreshAccessToken(); if (fresh) {...}` — else yo'q; api.ts:148-158 refreshAccessToken; useChatSocket.ts:44-50 onclose → connect (token o'zgarmaydi).
recommended_fix: api qatlamida markazlashgan `authFetch`: 401 kelsa bir marta `refreshAccessToken()` → localStorage/context yangilash → so'rovni takrorlash; refresh `null` bo'lsa `logout()`ga tushirish. Intervalda muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa 30-60s dan keyin qayta urinish. useChatSocket'da token'ni ref orqali o'qish.
dependencies: lib/api.ts, lib/apiExtra.ts, AuthContext (setToken ni tashqariga chiqarish).
fix_risk: O'rta: auth oqimi markaziy; e2e-check.mjs bilan tekshirish kerak.

title: Mount'dagi seansni tiklash va login() poygasi — login natijasi 'guest' bilan ustidan yozilishi mumkin
root_cause: Mount effekti (37-71) `localStorage` bo'sh bo'lsa `refreshAccessToken()` ni kutadi; shu payt foydalanuvchi (yoki InviteAccept/SocialLogin polling) `login(token)` (87-93) chaqirsa, effekt `cancelled` bo'lmagani uchun 62-66 da `removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); setToken(null); setStatus("guest")` qiladi — yangi kirgan seans o'chadi. `login` da `fetchMe` muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa status 'guest', lekin token localStorage'da qoladi (88-92).
impact: Kam uchraydigan, lekin 'kirdim — yana chiqib ketdim' holati; ayniqsa sekin tarmoqda va Telegram polling orqali kirishda.
evidence: AuthContext.tsx:51 `const fresh = await refreshAccessToken();`, :62-66; :87-93 login.
recommended_fix: Mount effektida `guest`ga tushirishdan oldin `if (cancelled || tokenRef.current) return` (login bo'lganini ref orqali bilish) yoki login() `cancelled=true` qiladigan umumiy `restoreSeq` ref; login'da fetchMe null bo'lsa localStorage'ni tozalash.
dependencies: Yo'q.

title: Ochilgan har suhbatning to'liq tarixi cheksiz keshlanadi; xabarlar sahifalanmagan
root_cause: `threads` state (50) ochilgan har suhbat uchun `fetchConversationMessages` (messages/api.ts:29-33, limit/cursor yo'q) qaytargan BARCHA xabarlarni saqlaydi va hech qachon bo'shatmaydi; onMessage har xabarda massivni nusxalaydi (166-169). Uzoq suhbatlar (100k xabar maqsadi) va ko'p suhbat ochish bilan xotira va render vaqti chiziqli o'sadi.
impact: Xotira/renderda sekinlashish; katta suhbat ochilganda bitta so'rov ulkan javob.
evidence: useMessenger.ts:50 `useState<Record<string, ThreadState>>({})`; :111 `items: [...items, ...local]`; messages/api.ts:30 `getJson(`/api/conversations/${id}/messages`)` parametrsiz.

dependencies: apps/api chat.routes.ts messages endpoint (sahifalash).
fix_risk: O'rta: newFromId/unread hisoblash mantiqi (105-110) sahifalashga moslanishi kerak.

title: loadPartner/loadRating xatoda ushlanmaydi — panel 'loading'da qotadi yoki unhandled rejection
root_cause: `fetchUserSummary` (api.ts:864-872) `res.json()` xatosida uloqtiradi; `loadPartner` 315-317 `.then` faqat — reject bo'lsa `partners[id]` 'loading' bo'lib qoladi va qayta chaqiruvda `state !== "error"` sabab qayta so'ralmaydi (313). `loadRating` 290 ham catch'siz.

title: useFavorites.toggle har o'zgarishda yangi identity oladi va closure'dagi `ids` ga tayanadi
root_cause: `toggle` `useCallback(..., [enabled, accessToken, ids])` — har bosishdan keyin yangi funksiya → uni prop qilib olgan barcha kartalar (VacancyList → VacancyCard) qayta chiziladi; `wasFavorite` closure'dan olinadi (41). useSavedCompanies.ts:32-56 esa idsRef bilan to'g'ri yozilgan — ikkita bir xil hook ikki xil naqshda.
impact: 20-50 kartali ro'yxatda har yurak bosishda barcha kartalar re-render; tez ketma-ket bosishda eskirgan `ids` bilan noto'g'ri yo'nalishdagi so'rov ehtimoli.

title: Har foydalanuvchi uchun ikkita WebSocket (/ws/chat) ochiladi; bildirishnoma soketida reconnect yo'q
root_cause: NotificationBell (Header'da doim) useNotifications orqali `/ws/chat` ga ulanadi (61-88); /messages sahifasida useChatSocket ham xuddi shu endpointga ikkinchi ulanish ochadi (useChatSocket.ts:35). useNotifications soketida `onclose` reconnect yo'q — server restart/tarmoq uzilsa real-time bildirishnomalar token yangilangunga (≤12 daq) qadar jim, faqat 45s polling qoladi. Ustiga useInboxSummary (20s) + useNotifications (45s) polling + focus/CUSTOM event'larda throttle'siz refresh.
impact: Server WS ulanishlari 2x (10k user → 20k potentsial ulanish), ortiqcha polling; real-time bildirishnoma tushib qoladi.
evidence: useNotifications.ts:63 `new WebSocket(`${WS_URL}/ws/chat?token=...`)`, :79-87 cleanup'da faqat close; useInboxSummary.ts:29 `setInterval(refresh, 20000)`, :31-33 focus+INBOX_CHANGED.
recommended_fix: Bitta umumiy soket: useChatSocket'ni `notification` turini ham qabul qiladigan qilib, AuthProvider darajasida (context) yagona ulanish; useNotifications shu kontekstga obuna bo'lsin. Reconnect'ni useChatSocket'dagi backoff bilan umumiylashtiring. Polling intervallarini `document.visibilityState` bo'yicha to'xtatish.
dependencies: useChatSocket.ts, NotificationBell.tsx, useMessenger.ts, backend /ws/chat message turlari.
fix_risk: O'rta: chat va bildirishnoma oqimi bitta ulanishga bog'lanadi.

title: useNotifications/useInboxSummary: so'rovlar bekor qilinmaydi — logout yoki token almashganda eskirgan javob holatni yozadi
root_cause: useNotifications `refresh` (26-35) va useInboxSummary `refresh` (15-21) natijasini tekshiruvsiz `setItems/setSummary` qiladi; effekt cleanup'ida cancel flag yo'q (38-57; 23-39). Token `null` bo'lganda (logout) `setItems([])` qilinadi, lekin havoda qolgan eski so'rov keyin kelib ro'yxat/badge'ni qaytaradi. Focus + NOTIFICATIONS_CHANGED + interval bir vaqtda kelganda parallel so'rovlar, oxirgi kelgani g'olib (eng yangisi emas).
impact: Chiqib ketgan foydalanuvchi header'ida oldingi hisobning badge/bildirishnoma nomlari ko'rinishi mumkin; mayda 'sakrash'lar.
evidence: useNotifications.ts:32-34 `const data = await fetchNotifications(token, { limit }); setItems(data.items);`; useInboxSummary.ts:20 `fetchInboxSummary(token).then(setSummary)`.
recommended_fix: Effekt ichida `let alive = true` / `seq` ref; javob kelganda `if (!alive || seq !== current) return`. Refresh'ni 1-2s throttle qiling.
dependencies: Yo'q.

title: Zod default inglizcha xabarlari maydon nomi bilan birga uch tilda ham chiqadi
root_cause: Ko'p zod sxemada custom message yo'q (auth.routes.ts:13-14 `z.string().email()`, `.min(8)`; vacancies.routes.ts:42-43 `title: z.string().min(3)`, `description: z.string().min(10)`, :59 email). Error handler `${field}: ${issue.message}` qaytaradi. Signup parol input'ida minLength yo'q.

evidence: server.ts:115-119; auth.routes.ts:13-14; components/AuthForm.tsx:116-124 (PasswordField input: required bor, minLength yo'q), holbuki messages.uz.ts:368 passwordHint 'Kamida 8 belgi'; vacancies.routes.ts:42-43,59.

Bundan tashqari submit'dan oldin t.signup.passwordHint bilan client tekshiruv qiling. 2) Backend zod sxemalariga o'zbekcha custom message bering. 3) VALIDATION_ERROR javobiga `field` maydonini alohida qo'shing, shunda frontend t.* bilan tarjima qila oladi.

title: Bildirishnoma title/body bazaga o'zbekcha matn sifatida yoziladi va RU/EN'da xom ko'rsatiladi
root_cause: Backend notify() chaqiriqlari tayyor o'zbekcha matnni saqlaydi: 'Yangi ariza', STATUS_UZ emoji bilan, '"X" bo'yicha N ta yangi vakansiya'. User modelida locale maydoni yo'q. Frontend item.title/item.body'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chizadi.
impact: /ru va /en foydalanuvchining bildirishnomalar sahifasi va sidebar'i to'liq o'zbekcha. ~100k bildirishnoma hajmida ular DB'da bir tilda qotib qoladi. Email/Telegram/push ham faqat o'zbekcha.
evidence: NotificationCard.tsx:45-46 `const heading = item.title ?? item.body`; apps/api/src/modules/applications/applications.routes.ts:69-80 (title "Yangi ariza", ctaLabel "Arizani ko'rish"), :255-275 (STATUS_UZ, "Ariza holati o'zgardi"); apps/api/src/modules/alerts/alerts.service.ts:163-170; schema.prisma'da locale/language maydoni yo'q (grep bo'sh).
recommended_fix: Backward-compatible yo'l: frontend lib/notifications/adapter.ts da type + payload bo'yicha matnni t.* shablonidan yarating. Masalan application_status_changed → payload.status orqali t.notifications.templates.statusChanged(vacancyTitle, t.enums.status[...]); new_vacancy_match → payload.count. Payload'da vacancyTitle yo'q bo'lsa, yangi yozuvlarda payload'ga qo'shing. Mos shablon bo'lmasa (system, eski yozuvlar) title/body fallback qoladi. Email/Telegram uchun keyinchalik User.locale (ixtiyoriy, default uz) qo'shish mumkin.
dependencies: Backend notify payload'iga vacancyTitle/status qo'shish (applications.routes.ts, alerts.service.ts); messages.*.ts ga shablonlar
fix_risk: O'rta: payload'i to'liq bo'lmagan eski bildirishnomalar fallback bilan ko'rsatilishi kerak.

title: Hudud nomlari ba'zi joylarda backend'dagi o'zbekcha nom bilan chiqadi (regionName tarjimasi chetlab o'tilgan)
root_cause: Mapper'lar raw.region?.name ni oladi (DB'da o'zbekcha 'Toshkent', 'Farg'ona') va komponent uni xom chizadi. Boshqa 16 joyda esa regionName(locale, slug, name) orqali tarjima qilinadi.

title: Backend o'zbekcha xato matni RU/EN interfeysda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatiladi
root_cause: Backend faqat o'zbekcha message qaytaradi: common/errors.ts:13-19, auth.service.ts:82 'Email yoki parol noto'g'ri'. error kodlari esa umumiy (UNAUTHORIZED, CONFLICT). Frontend ko'p joyda err.message'ni tilni tekshirmasdan ko'rsatadi. Locale'ni hisobga oladigan yagona helper lib/admin/useNotice.ts:30 errorText, lekin u faqat admin'da ishlatiladi.
impact: /ru va /en foydalanuvchisi login, signup, social login, kompaniya formasi, reyting, Telegram, obuna, rezyume yuklash, profil, ariza holati va vakansiya formasida o'zbekcha xato ko'radi. Tarmoq xatosida ham lib/api.ts:302 kabi joylardan 'Serverga ulanib bo'lmadi' chiqadi. Core flow'da i18n buziladi.
evidence: pages/login/+Page.tsx:34 va pages/signup/+Page.tsx:52 `err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : ...`; components/SocialLogin.tsx:60,114 va components/EmployerCompanyForm.tsx:48,61,95 (fallback ham qattiq yozilgan "Xatolik yuz berdi"); components/messages/RatingDialog.tsx:58; components/TelegramConnect.tsx:76; components/SaveSearchButton.tsx:67; components/profile/ResumeFile.tsx:40; components/profile/ui.tsx:333; components/employer/applications/EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:170-171 (failedWithReason ichiga uz matn qo'yiladi); components/employer/vacancies/VacancyForm.tsx:227; pages/pricing/+Page.tsx:63. Bundan tashqari "Xatolik" sentinel satri bilan literal taqqoslash mo'rt (ResumeFile.tsx:40, ui.tsx:333).
recommended_fix: lib/admin/useNotice.ts dagi errorText(err, fallback, locale) ni umumiy lib/errors.ts ga ko'chiring va barcha listed joylarda `errorText(err, t.x.fallback, locale)` ishlating: uz'da server matni, ru/en'da tarjima qilingan fallback. Asosiy flow'lar uchun backend'da aniq kodlar qo'shing (INVALID_CREDENTIALS, EMAIL_TAKEN, RATE_LIMITED, PHONE_REQUIRED) va frontend t.errors[code] orqali tarjima qilsin; message maydoni backward-compatible qoladi. Qattiq yozilgan "Xatolik yuz berdi" o'rniga t.* kaliti ishlatilsin.

fix_risk: Past-o'rta: faqat ko'rsatiladigan matn o'zgaradi. Kod qo'shilganda eski message saqlanadi.

title: POST /api/employer/subscription/checkout istalgan employer'ga ochiq — UI'siz, lekin cheksiz pending Payment yozuvi yaratadi
root_cause: billing.routes.ts:103-115 `requireRole("employer")` bilan har qanday employer `createCheckout` chaqiradi; billing.service.ts:198-233 har chaqiruvda yangi `Payment{status:pending}` yaratadi — mavjud pending'ni qayta ishlatmaydi, kompaniya bo'yicha cheklov yo'q; provayder sozlanmagan bo'lsa `checkoutUrl = WEB_ORIGIN/pricing?pending=...` (:223) — bu sahifa 302 → /employer. evidence: billing.routes.ts:103-115; billing.service.ts:207-218 `prisma.payment.create({... status: "pending"})`; :221-223 `\`${env.WEB_ORIGIN}/pricing?pending=${transactionId}\``; server.ts:177 `await app.register(billingRoutes);`.
recommended_fix: Feature-flag: env.ts `features` ga `billing: env.BILLING_ENABLED === "true"` qo'shing (default false); server.ts:177 `if (features.billing) await app.register(billingRoutes);` va :194 `ensurePlans()` ni shu shartga oling. Webhook (:121) ham shu flag ostida qoladi. Muqobil (minimal): faqat :103-115 checkout'ni flag bilan 404 qiling.
dependencies: e2e-check.mjs:139-153 (/api/plans kutish + tarif soni), demo-seed.ts:1620-1624 (`ensurePlans` + plan id'lari) — demo seed mustaqil `ensurePlans()` chaqiradi, flag'ga bog'liq emas.

title: Provayder webhook'i imzo o'tgach HAR QANDAY so'rovda to'lovni 'paid' qiladi — method/action/summa tekshirilmaydi (kalitlar bo'sh bo'lgani uchun hozir 401)
root_cause: billing.routes.ts:121-160: `verifyWebhookAuth` (billing.service.ts:301-327) faqat Basic auth (Payme) yoki md5 sign (Click) ni tekshiradi, keyin :142 `markPaymentPaid(transactionId)` darhol chaqiriladi. Payme JSON-RPC `method` (CheckPerformTransaction / CreateTransaction / PerformTransaction / CancelTransaction) va Click `action` (0=prepare, 1=complete) farqlanmaydi; `body.amount` payment.amount bilan solishtirilmaydi; javob `{ result: { state: 2 }, ok: true }` (:159) ikkala protokolga ham mos emas. Kalitlar bo'sh (env.ts:61-65 default "") → :307,315 `return false` → 401, ya'ni hozir xavfsiz o'chiq.
impact: Hozir zarar yo'q (401). PAYME_KEY/CLICK_SECRET_KEY kiritilsa: CheckPerformTransaction (to'lovdan OLDINGI tekshiruv) yoki Click prepare bosqichida obuna faollashadi — pulsiz plan. Bu (b) izolyatsiyalangan kod, product rule'ga tegmaydi, lekin 'production-ready' emas.
evidence: billing.routes.ts:127-142; billing.service.ts:256-291 `markPaymentPaid` — status `pending` bo'lishini ham tekshirmaydi (`failed`/`refunded` ham `paid` bo'ladi).
recommended_fix: Feature-flag ostida qoldiring (yuqoridagi topilma) va faylga 'PROTOTIP — real integratsiyada method/action/amount tekshiruvi kerak' izohi yozing; yoki webhook'ni butunlay olib tashlang (arxitektura §14: 'to'lov integratsiyasi MVP'da yozilmaydi'). Minimal xavfsizlik: `markPaymentPaid` ichida `if (payment.status !== "pending") throw Errors.conflict(...)`.
dependencies: Provayder protokoli tafsilotlari (Payme/Click hujjatlari) — kod tekshirildi, protokol talablari xotiradan.

title: Bildirishnomalar 'tarifi faollashtirildi' matni va url:/pricing bilan yaratiladi — demo hr hisobida ham
root_cause: billing.routes.ts:150-156 va admin.routes.ts:477-485 `notify({... body: \`"${plan.name}" tarifi faollashtirildi.\`, url: "/pricing" })`. demo-seed.ts:1296 hr uchun 'Premium tarif faollashtirildi — 100 tagacha vakansiya va nomzodlar bazasi ochiq' (`/pricing`), :1299-1300 admin uchun 'To'lov kutilmoqda/amalga oshmadi' (`/admin/payments`). Web tomonda adapter.ts:79-80 `/pricing` → `employer` kategoriyasiga map qilib 'Tariflarni ko'rish' tugmasini yashiradi (i18n uz:1578 `pricing: "Tariflarni ko'rish"` endi ishlatilmaydi).
impact: Demo hr (@demo.ish.top) bildirishnomalarida 'Premium tarif ... 100 tagacha vakansiya' matni ko'rinadi — mijozga ko'rsatiladigan demo product rule ('bepul, limit yo'q') ga zid ma'lumot beradi. Admin qo'lda tasdiqlasa real user'ga ham shunday xabar boradi.
evidence: demo-seed.ts:1296 `["hr", "system", "Premium tarif faollashtirildi", "Obuna 30 kunga faol: 100 tagacha vakansiya va nomzodlar bazasi ochiq.", "/pricing", 144, true]`; adapter.ts:79-80.
recommended_fix: demo-seed.ts:1296 qatorini olib tashlang (yoki bepul modelga mos xabarga almashtiring). billing.routes.ts:155 va admin.routes.ts:483 `url: "/pricing"` → `"/employer"` (flag ostida bo'lsa ham). i18n `notifications...actions.pricing` (uz:1578, ru:1590, en:1577) va adapter.ts:32 `"pricing"` kategoriyasini olib tashlang.
dependencies: Demo seed qayta ishga tushirish (`db:demo --reset`).

title: Heartbeat (ping/pong) yo'q — o'lik socketlar map'da qoladi, `isOnline` yolg'on true → Telegram fallback ishlamaydi
root_cause: addSocket/removeSocket faqat `close` hodisasiga tayanadi (chat.routes.ts:136). Mobil uyqu, NAT timeout, tarmoq uzilishi FIN yubormaydi → socket soatlab `readyState=1` ko'rinishi mumkin. `grep ping|pong|heartbeat` — API'da yo'q. `ws.on("error")` ham yo'q.
impact: chat.routes.ts:128 `!isOnline(otherId)` false qaytaradi → oflayn foydalanuvchiga Telegram xabari bormaydi; sendToUser o'lik socketlarga yozadi; uzoq muddatda Set'lar o'sadi (xotira).
evidence: realtime.ts:12-40; chat.routes.ts:127-133, 136.
recommended_fix: chat.routes'da `ws.isAlive=true; ws.on('pong', …)`; server-level 30s interval: `isAlive=false; ws.ping()`, javob bo'lmasa `ws.terminate()` (close → removeSocket). `ws.on('error', () => removeSocket(...))` qo'shish.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Admin broadcast: barcha userlar bitta HTTP so'rovda ketma-ket notify — minutlab so'rov, timeout'da qayta bosilsa duplicate
root_cause: `user.findMany` (510-513) limitsiz; `for … await notify()` (516-524) har user uchun 2 DB so'rov + telegram/push/email fetch. Job/queue yo'q, javob oxirida (`sent`).
impact: 10k userda so'rov daqiqalar davom etadi, proxy/klient timeout → admin qayta bosadi → hammaga ikki marta; server ishlayotgan boshqa so'rovlar sekinlashadi.
evidence: admin.routes.ts:500-526; notifications.service.ts:55-112.
recommended_fix: Darhol `{ accepted: n }` qaytarib, `setImmediate` fonida cursor (`take: 500`) bilan yurish; in_app uchun `notification.createMany` + `sendToUser` loop; bir vaqtda faqat bitta broadcast (modul flag).
dependencies: notifications.service.ts

title: Alert sweep: unbounded savedSearch skan, parallel sweep'da duplicate bildirishnoma, top-20 chegarasi
root_cause: (a) `savedSearch.findMany({emailAlertsEnabled:true})` limitsiz, har biri uchun ketma-ket `listVacancies` (134) — 10k obuna = 10k qidiruv so'rovi/15 daqiqa. (b) `startAlertScheduler` `setInterval` (201) va admin `/api/admin/alerts/run` (admin.routes.ts:497) bir vaqtda ishlashi mumkin; in-flight guard yo'q — ikkalasi ham eski `lastNotifiedAt` ni o'qib (117, 137) `notify` (163) chaqiradi → foydalanuvchiga bir xil xabar 2 marta (in_app+telegram+email). (c) `pageSize: 20` (133) — kunlik obunada 20 tadan ko'p yangi vakansiya bo'lsa son kam ko'rsatiladi/ba'zilari o'tkazib yuboriladi.
impact: Duplicate bildirishnoma va email; sweep vaqti interval'dan oshsa doimiy overlap; miqyosda DB yuklama.
evidence: alerts.service.ts:100-142, 163-175, 181-203; admin.routes.ts:497.
recommended_fix: Modul darajasida `running` flag (sweep davom etsa qaytish); `updateMany({where:{id, lastNotifiedAt: search.lastNotifiedAt}, data:{lastNotifiedAt: now}})` natijasi `count===0` bo'lsa notify qilmaslik (optimistic lock); obunalarni `take: 500` cursor bilan yurish; bir xil `queryParams` larni guruhlash.
dependencies: vacancies.service listVacancies

title: Rad etish/taklif sababi xabar sifatida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri DB'ga yoziladi — real-time uzatilmaydi, Telegram fallback yo'q
root_cause: `prisma.message.create` (248-250) chat modulidagi yuborish yo'lini (chat.routes.ts:111-133: sendToUser ikkala tomonga + oflayn bo'lsa Telegram) chetlab o'tadi.
impact: Nomzod /messages sahifasi ochiq bo'lsa sabab xabari ko'rinmaydi (faqat qayta yuklaganda yoki reconnect'da), suhbat ro'yxati bump bo'lmaydi; ish beruvchining o'z ochiq /messages'i ham yangilanmaydi. Oflayn nomzodga Telegram'ga chat xabari bormaydi (faqat notify() orqali qisqa holat).
evidence: applications.routes.ts:242-251; chat.routes.ts:111-133; useMessenger.ts:162-170 (faqat WS orqali kelgan xabar qo'shiladi).
recommended_fix: chat modulida `postMessage(conversationId, senderId, body)` helper (create + sendToUser x2 + oflayn Telegram) ajratib, WS handler va applications.routes'da ishlatish.
dependencies: chat.routes.ts refactor

title: WS uchun payload limiti, rate-limit va isBlocked tekshiruvi yo'q
root_cause: server.ts:108 `app.register(websocket)` optionsiz → ws kutubxonasi default maxPayload 100 MiB; body 4000 ga faqat JSON.parse'dan KEYIN kesiladi (108-112). @fastify/rate-limit (server.ts:103) WS'ga taalluqli emas — har xabar DB yozuvi + Telegram fetch. Ulanishda faqat `verifyAccessToken` (76): bloklangan foydalanuvchi (auth-guard.ts:41 REST'da tekshiradi) WS orqali yozishda davom etadi; token muddati tugasa ham socket yashaydi.
impact: Bitta hisob soniyasiga yuzlab xabar/100MB frame bilan CPU/xotira va DB'ni bosadi; adminning blocklashi chatga ta'sir qilmaydi.
evidence: server.ts:108; chat.routes.ts:71-81, 107-133; auth-guard.ts:41-42.
recommended_fix: `app.register(websocket, { options: { maxPayload: 16 * 1024 } })`; ulanishda `prisma.user.findUnique({select:{isBlocked}})`; userId bo'yicha oddiy token-bucket (masalan 20 xabar/10s) — oshsa xabar tashlanadi.
dependencies: #1 bilan bir joyda

title: /api/inbox/summary har 20s har tab'da — isRead indekssiz message count + nested application count
root_cause: useInboxSummary.ts:29 `setInterval(refresh, 20000)` + focus + INBOX_CHANGED. Endpoint (466-485): conversation findMany → `message.count({conversationId in [...], senderId not, isRead:false})` — Message indeksi faqat `[conversationId, createdAt]` va `[senderId]` (schema.prisma:544-545), `isRead` yo'q → har conversation uchun barcha xabarlar skan; employer uchun `application.count({vacancy:{company:{ownerUserId}}})` ikki bosqichli relation filtri.
impact: 10k user × 3 so'rov/min = eng qaynoq so'rov; 100k xabar/50k arizada har chaqiruv o'nlab ms-dan sekundgacha. WS bor bo'lsa polling ortiqcha.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:466-485; useInboxSummary.ts:24-38; schema.prisma:533-546.
recommended_fix: `@@index([conversationId, isRead])` qo'shish (prisma db push); polling'ni 60s ga oshirib, WS `message`/`read` hodisalarida `emitInboxChanged` bilan yangilash (allaqachon bor); employer uchun `application.count` ni `companyId` orqali (`vacancy: { companyId: { in: ids } }`) qilish.
dependencies: schema.prisma

title: GET /api/conversations sahifalanmagan, og'ir include va barcha suhbat×kompaniya arizalari bir so'rovda
root_cause: `conversation.findMany` take/cursor'siz (168-191), `company.description`, seeker profili kabi katta maydonlar; so'ng `application.findMany` (207-233) barcha seekerId×companyId juftliklari uchun (Cartesian `in` × `in`). Frontend har reconnect'da `reloadList(true)` (useMessenger.ts:221) va har yangi suhbatda (175) qayta so'raydi.
impact: Faol ish beruvchi (1-2k suhbat) uchun har reconnect'da yuzlab KB javob va 3 ta katta so'rov; miqyosda xotira/latency.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:166-300; useMessenger.ts:65-88, 175, 221.
recommended_fix: `take: 100` + `?before=<lastMessageAt>` cursor; `select` bilan minimal maydonlar (description'ni olib tashlash); application so'rovini `OR: [{jobSeekerId, vacancy:{companyId}}...]` ga aniqlashtirish yoki Conversation'ga `lastApplicationId` denormalizatsiya.
dependencies: messages/adapter.ts, MessagesView (cursor UI)
fix_risk: O'rta — frontend ro'yxat 'ko'proq yuklash' kerak bo'ladi

title: Suhbat REST marshrutlarida `:id` ObjectId validatsiyasi yo'q → Prisma P2023 → 500
root_cause: `/api/conversations/:id/messages` (304), `/rating` GET/POST (329, 360), `/api/users/:id/summary` (400) `id` ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Prisma'ga beradi; server.ts error handler (126-133) faqat P2002/P2025 ni map qiladi.
impact: `/api/conversations/abc/messages` → INTERNAL_ERROR 500 + error log; frontend 'Kutilmagan xatolik'. Monitoring shovqini.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:304-309, 329-334, 360-366, 400-412; server.ts:126-133; validation.ts `objectId()` mavjud (import 5).
recommended_fix: server.ts error handler'ga `error.code === "P2023"` → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR qo'shish (barcha modullarni qamrab oladi); ixtiyoriy: `objectId().parse(id)`.

title: Qo'ng'iroq uchun ikkinchi, reconnect'siz WebSocket — uzilsa 12 daqiqagacha jonli bildirishnoma yo'q, har tab 2 socket
root_cause: useNotifications o'z `new WebSocket(/ws/chat)` ini ochadi (62), `onclose` faqat null qilinadi, reconnect logikasi yo'q; useChatSocket (useMessenger orqali /messages'da) alohida socket ochadi. Faqat token yangilanishi (AuthContext 12 daqiqalik interval) effect'ni qayta ishga tushiradi.
impact: Server restart yoki tarmoq uzilishidan keyin qo'ng'iroq faqat 45s polling'ga qoladi (son to'g'ri, lekin `emitNotificationReceived` → /notifications markazi jonli yangilanmaydi). /messages'da har tab uchun serverda 2 socket, 10k userda ikki barobar ulanish.
evidence: useNotifications.ts:61-88; useChatSocket.ts:26-80; Header.tsx:157; messages/+Page.tsx:27.
recommended_fix: Bitta umumiy socket: useChatSocket'ni `onNotification` handler bilan kengaytirib, modul darajasidagi singleton (subscribe/unsubscribe, ref-count) qilish; useNotifications shu singleton'ga obuna bo'ladi va reconnect'dan keyin `refresh()` chaqiradi.
dependencies: useChatSocket.ts, useMessenger.ts
fix_risk: O'rta — ikki hook birlashadi, StrictMode double-mount'ni ref-count bilan sinash kerak

title: Qo'ng'iroq: API xatosi 'bo'sh' holat sifatida ko'rinadi va 45s polling xatosi mavjud ro'yxat/sonni 0 ga o'chiradi
root_cause: `fetchNotifications` (apiExtra.ts:147) `get(..., EMPTY_NOTIFICATIONS)` — 401/500/tarmoq xatosida `{items:[], unreadCount:0}` qaytaradi; `refresh()` (26-35) shuni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri `setItems/setUnreadCount` qiladi.
impact: Product rule 4 (EMPTY ≠ ERROR) buziladi: bell 'Bildirishnomalar yo'q' deb ko'rsatadi, badge yo'qoladi; bir marta muvaffaqiyatsiz poll oldin yuklangan 8 ta elementni ham o'chiradi.
evidence: apiExtra.ts:44-48, 140-148; useNotifications.ts:26-35, 38-57. Taqqoslang: notifications/api.ts:29-43 (markaz to'g'ri — throw qiladi).
recommended_fix: `refresh()` da `fetchNotificationCenter`-ga o'xshab xatoda throw qiladigan variant ishlatish va catch'da avvalgi state'ni saqlash (`error` flag qo'shish); bell'da xato bo'lsa 'Yangilab bo'lmadi' matn.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Mobil menyu client-side navigatsiyadan keyin ochiq qolib ketadi
root_cause: `menuOpen` state Header'da, Header esa Layout ichida (vike-react `extends: vikeReact`, clientRouting sukut bo'yicha yoqilgan) va sahifalar orasida qayta mount qilinmaydi. Mobil nav havolalarida (288-298, 313-325) `onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}` yo'q, pathname o'zgarganda yopadigan useEffect ham yo'q (faylda useEffect umuman yo'q). Desktop user menyusida esa `onClick={() => setUserOpen(false)}` bor (213).
impact: Telefonda menyudan bo'lim tanlanganda yangi sahifa ochiladi, lekin menyu paneli ochiq turib kontentni pastga suradi. Foydalanuvchi uni qo'lda yopishi kerak. Esc va tashqariga bosish ham ishlamaydi.
evidence: Header.tsx:38 `const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);`, :288-298 `<a key={link.href} href={l(link.href)} ...>` (onClick yo'q), :313-325 mobileAccountLinks ham shunday. pages/+config.ts: `Layout, ... extends: vikeReact`.
recommended_fix: `useEffect(() => { setMenuOpen(false); setUserOpen(false); }, [pathname, pageContext.urlOriginal]);` qo'shing. Mobil havolalarga ham `onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}` bering. Menyu uchun `id` + `aria-controls` va Esc bilan yopish qo'shing.
dependencies: Brauzer testida clientRouting xatti-harakatini tasdiqlash.

title: Bildirishnoma qo'ng'irog'i aria-label o'qilmagan sonni yashiradi; header popover'larida Esc/aria-haspopup yo'q
root_cause: Tugmada `aria-label={t.notifications.title}` bor. aria-label ichki matnni, jumladan 99+ badge'ni, accessible name'dan chiqarib tashlaydi. Popover'da `aria-haspopup`, `aria-controls` va Esc handler yo'q. Header account menyusi (Header.tsx:165-237) va LanguageSwitcher ham faqat click-outside bilan yopiladi, fokus trigger'ga qaytmaydi.
impact: Screen reader foydalanuvchisi o'qilmagan bildirishnomalar borligini bilmaydi. Klaviaturada popover'ni Esc bilan yopib bo'lmaydi va Tab fokusni ochiq popover ortidan sahifaga olib ketadi.
evidence: NotificationBell.tsx:24-27 `aria-expanded={open} aria-label={t.notifications.title}`, :38-42 badge `{unreadCount > 99 ? "99+" : unreadCount}` button ichida. onKeyDown/Escape yo'q (1-91-qatorlar). Header.tsx:165-170 user menu tugmasi `aria-expanded aria-controls="account-menu"`, lekin Escape handler butun faylda yo'q.
recommended_fix: aria-label'ni `unreadCount > 0 ? `${title}, ${t.notifications.unread(unreadCount)}` : title` qiling va badge span'ga aria-hidden bering. Umumiy kichik `useEscape(open, close, triggerRef)` hook yozing (ActionsMenu.tsx:40-45 dagi mantiq) va NotificationBell, Header user menu, LanguageSwitcher'da ishlating.
dependencies: i18n: unread soni uchun matn funksiyasi (uz/ru/en).

title: text-dusk/80 (va placeholder dusk/70-80) kunduzgi rejimda 3.59:1, kichik matnlarda AA'dan o'tmaydi
root_cause: `--dusk` (#5A6A85) surface ustida 5.48:1, lekin /80 alpha'da 3.59:1, /70 da 2.95:1 ga tushadi. Bu klass 11-14px ikkilamchi matnlarga ishlatilgan. text-ink/55 esa 4.00:1.
impact: Bildirishnoma turi (11px), vakansiya kartasidagi e'lon sanasi (text-xs), rezyumedagi 'to'ldirilmagan' belgilari va form placeholder'lari zaif ko'ruvchi foydalanuvchiga o'qilmaydi.
evidence: NotificationBell.tsx:122 `text-[11px] text-dusk/80`, VacancyCard.tsx:51 `text-xs text-dusk/80`, profile/ResumePreview.tsx:22 `italic text-dusk/80`, profile/ResumeWizard.tsx:263, profile/ProfileOverview.tsx:251, profile/ui.tsx:181 (11px counter). placeholder:text-dusk/70|80 9 joyda, masalan vacancies/detail/ReportDialog.tsx:79. Hisob: mix(dusk, white, .8) = 3.59:1.
recommended_fix: Matn uchun alpha'siz `text-dusk` ishlating (5.48:1). Placeholder'lar uchun `placeholder:text-dusk` ga o'ting. Dekorativ ikonkalar (ApplicationCard.tsx:150 kabi) qolishi mumkin. Disabled pagination (text-dusk/50, aria-hidden) istisno.
dependencies: Yo'q.

title: Bir nechta qidiruv/filtr inputlarida label yo'q (faqat placeholder)
root_cause: Inputlarda `<label htmlFor>`, `aria-label` va `aria-labelledby` yo'q, nom faqat placeholder'dan keladi. Placeholder yozish boshlanishi bilan yo'qoladi va ishonchli accessible name emas.
impact: Bosh sahifaning asosiy qidiruv maydoni (core seeker flow), admin jadvallaridagi qidiruv (AdminSearchInput: users/vacancies/companies va boshqalar) va employer nomzod qidiruvi screen reader'da 'edit text, blank' deb o'qiladi. WCAG 1.3.1/4.1.2.
evidence: SearchBar.tsx:31-37 `<input name="q" type="text" ... placeholder={t.home.searchPlaceholder} className="... focus:outline-none" />`. AdminShell.tsx:216-221 AdminSearchInput `<input value={value} ... placeholder={placeholder} .../>` (AdminSelect :246 da esa aria-label bor). pages/employer/candidates/+Page.tsx:80-84 `<input value={q} ... placeholder={t.candidatesPage.searchPlaceholder} />`. components/FilterSidebar.tsx:78,86 salary from/to ham label'siz, lekin import topilmadi (ehtimol o'lik kod). Statik skaner jami 22 nomzod topdi, qolganlari label ichida, hidden file input yoki dinamik id bo'lib chiqdi.
recommended_fix: Har biriga `aria-label={placeholder}` qo'shing (AdminSearchInput'da prop allaqachon bor) yoki `<label className="sr-only" htmlFor>` ishlating. Qidiruv formalarini `role="search"` bilan belgilang. FilterSidebar ishlatilmasa o'chiring.
dependencies: i18n'da mavjud placeholder matnlari yetarli.

title: Custom Select va LanguageSwitcher: fokus ko'rinmaydi, klaviatura navigatsiyasi va Esc yo'q, listbox semantikasi noto'g'ri
root_cause: Select trigger `focus:outline-none` bilan global :focus-visible outline'ni o'chiradi va o'rniga ring bermaydi (51). Ochilgan `<ul role="listbox">` ichida `<li>` > `<button role="option">` bor: li'ning roli yo'q, listbox'ning nomi (aria-label) yo'q. ↑/↓/Home/End/Esc/typeahead ishlanmagan, fokus listbox'ga o'tmaydi. LanguageSwitcher.tsx:29-56 da ham xuddi shu naqsh; trigger faqat 'UZ' qisqa matnni o'qitadi.
impact: Klaviatura foydalanuvchisi 6 joyda (bosh sahifa hudud tanlovi SearchBar.tsx:47, kompaniya filtri/sort, EmployerCompanyForm region/xodimlar soni, PersonalInfo) fokus qayerdaligini ko'rmaydi. Esc bilan yopib bo'lmaydi. Screen reader noto'g'ri tuzilgan listbox'ni e'lon qiladi. CompanyToolbar.tsx:54 dagi sort Select'ning labeli yo'q ('Saralash:' span faqat xl'da ko'rinadi va bog'lanmagan).
evidence:
Select.tsx:51 `className={`... focus:outline-none ${buttonBase}`}` (focus-visible:ring yo'q), :70-99 `
    ` > `
  • ` > `
recommended_fix: Eng kam o'zgarish: triggerga `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-signal` qo'shing. Listbox o'rniga ActionsMenu.tsx'dagi tayyor naqshni qayta ishlating: ochilganda tanlangan option'ga fokus, ↑/↓/Home/End, Esc yopib trigger'ga fokus qaytaradi, `li role="presentation"`. Select'ga `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` prop qo'shing va CompanyToolbar'da sortLabel'ni bering. LanguageSwitcher'ga `aria-label={`${label}: ${LOCALE_LABELS[locale]}`}` bering. Muqobil: filtr/sort uchun native `<select>` (DESIGN.md salaries qidiruvi shunday qilgan).

title: StarInput: yulduz tugmalari faqat '1'..'5' deb nomlangan va tanlangan holat e'lon qilinmaydi
root_cause: Har bir tugmada `aria-label={`${i}`}` bor, lekin `aria-pressed`, `role="radio"`/`aria-checked` yoki guruh nomi yo'q. Tanlangan qiymat faqat rang bilan ko'rsatiladi (text-gold va text-line). Fokus uslubi ham yo'q (global outline'ga tayanadi).
impact: RatingDialog'da (messages) screen reader foydalanuvchisi '1, button' eshitadi va nechta yulduz tanlanganini bilmaydi. WCAG 1.3.1/4.1.2 va 1.4.1 (faqat rang orqali ma'lumot).
evidence: StarRating.tsx:39-50 `<button type="button" key={i} onMouseEnter=... onClick={() => onChange(i)} aria-label={`${i}`} className={active >= i ? "text-gold" : "text-line ..."}>`. Ishlatilishi: messages/RatingDialog.tsx:104.
recommended_fix: Konteynerga `role="radiogroup"` va aria-label (fieldset legend bilan bog'lang), tugmalarga `role="radio" aria-checked={value === i}` hamda `aria-label={t.rating.stars(i)}` ('3 / 5 yulduz') bering. ←/→ uchun roving tabindex qo'shing. Minimal variant: `aria-pressed={value >= i}` va aniq label.
dependencies: i18n'ga 'N / 5' matni.

title: Markaziy dialoglarda max-height/overflow yo'q: telefonda klaviatura ochilganda kontent ekrandan chiqib ketadi
root_cause: Overlay `fixed inset-0 flex items-end p-4`, panel esa `w-full max-w-md ... p-5`. Panelda `max-h-[..dvh]` ham, `overflow-y-auto` ham yo'q. useDialog body scroll'ni qulflaydi (useDialog.ts:28), shuning uchun viewport'dan baland panelning tepa qismiga (sarlavha, matn) yetib bo'lmaydi.
impact: Employer holat dialogida (textarea + hint + 2 tugma) telefon klaviaturasi ochilganda yoki landscape rejimda panel viewport'dan oshadi: sarlavha/matn ko'rinmaydi, scroll qilib bo'lmaydi. Core employer flow (ariza holatini o'zgartirish) mobilda noqulay.
evidence: ApplicationStatusDialog.tsx:71 overlay `fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-end justify-center ... p-4`, :85 panel `w-full max-w-md animate-pop rounded-2xl ... p-5` (max-h yo'q). Xuddi shu holat: ConfirmDialog.tsx:55, messages/RatingDialog.tsx:71, admin/team/TeamList.tsx:175 (ProfileDialog, 2 input).
