title: Tungi rejimda text-signal matni AA kontrastdan o'tmaydi (surface'da 3.96:1, signal-soft'da 3.51:1)
root_cause: Dark `--signal: 99 102 241` (#6366F1) bitta token ham tugma foni, ham matn rangi sifatida ishlatiladi. Hisob: #6366F1 #121828 (surface) ustida 3.96:1, #1A2236 (surface-2) ustida 3.55:1, #1C2140 (signal-soft) ustida 3.51:1. Normal matn uchun AA talabi 4.5:1.
impact: text-signal kodda 360 marta uchraydi, dark:text-indigo-300 bilan tuzatilgani esa 51 ta. Qolgan link, aktiv tab, chip va hisoblagich matnlari tungi rejimda past kontrastli. Ayniqsa kichik matnlar (text-xs, 12-13px) ko'rish qobiliyati past foydalanuvchiga o'qilmaydi.
evidence: global.css:49. Namunalar: NotificationBell.tsx:53 (`text-xs font-medium text-signal`, surface), NotificationBell.tsx:83 viewAll link, CompanyFilterDrawer.tsx:105 (`bg-signal-soft ... text-xs font-bold text-signal`), CompanyCard.tsx:116 (`bg-signal-soft ... text-[13px] text-signal`), Select.tsx:87 aktiv option (`bg-signal-soft text-signal`), applications/ApplicationDetail.tsx:138. Qisman tuzatilgan joylar ham bor, masalan AdminShell.tsx:107 `dark:text-indigo-300` (8.87:1).
recommended_fix: Matn uchun alohida token kiriting: `--signal-text` (light: 79 70 229; dark: 165 180 252 ≈ indigo-300). Tailwind'da `signal.text` sifatida ulang va `text-signal`ni global CSS'da `.dark .text-signal { color: rgb(var(--signal-text)) }` bilan override qiling. Shunda 360 joy bir yo'la tuzaladi va bg-signal tegilmaydi. Keyin 51 ta dark:text-indigo-300 ni tozalash mumkin.
dependencies: Tailwind config (signal ranglari) va global.css; white-on-signal (P3) topilmasi bilan birga ko'rilsin.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: `.dark .text-signal` override hover:text-signal va group-hover variantlariga ham ta'sir qiladi. Vizual regress tekshiruvi kerak.

title: prefers-reduced-motion ataylab e'tiborsiz qoldirilgan: cheksiz fon animatsiyalari to'xtatib bo'lmaydi
root_cause: global.css:419-420 izohida 'brend talabi — prefers-reduced-motion bilan animatsiya o'chirilmaydi' deyilgan. drift-a/b/c (11-17s infinite), .particle rise, .text-shine (8s infinite), float, breathe, spin-slow, pulse-ring doim ishlaydi. Pauza boshqaruvi ham yo'q.
impact: WCAG 2.2.2 (Pause, Stop, Hide, A darajasi: 5 soniyadan uzun avtomatik harakat) va 2.3.3 buzilgan. Vestibular kasalligi bor foydalanuvchida bosh aylanishi/ko'ngil aynishi chaqirishi mumkin. Doimiy GPU animatsiyasi past quvvatli telefonlarda batareyani ham sarflaydi.
evidence: global.css:231-233 `.drift-a { animation: drift-a 14s ease-in-out infinite; }`, :254 `.particle { animation: rise linear infinite; }`, :353 `.text-shine ... animation: shine-move 8s linear infinite`, :281/:285/:292 pulse-ring/spin-slow/breathe infinite. motion-reduce faqat 2 joyda: SalaryDistributionChart.tsx:63 va SalaryExperienceChart.tsx:61.
recommended_fix: global.css oxiriga `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .drift-a,.drift-b,.drift-c,.particle,.text-shine,.pulse-ring,.spin-slow,.breathe,.animate-float { animation: none !important; } .reveal-pending { opacity:1; transform:none; } html { scroll-behavior:auto; } }` qo'shing. Brend fon statik holatda qoladi, faqat harakat to'xtaydi.
dependencies: Mahsulot egasi bilan 'brend talabi' izohini qayta kelishish kerak (DESIGN.md).
fix_risk: Past: faqat reduce sozlamasi yoqilgan foydalanuvchilarga ta'sir qiladi.

title: Ochiq kompaniya endpoint'i barcha faol vakansiya va barcha tasdiqlangan sharhlarni cheksiz qaytaradi — SSR HTML va JSON-LD shishadi
root_cause: `include: { reviews: { where approved }, vacancies: { where active, include region, category } }` da take/select yo'q. Butun Company hujjati (ichki maydonlar: subscriptionPlanId, subscriptionExpiresAt, ownerUserId) ham qaytadi. Sharhlarda userId chiqadi.
impact: Katta kompaniya (yuzlab vakansiya/sharh) sahifasi SSR'da bir necha MB JSON'ni pageContext.data sifatida HTML'ga seriyalaydi, bu LCP/TTFB'ni yomonlashtiradi. Ichki billing maydonlari ochiq API'da ko'rinadi. companies/@slug/+Head.tsx:46 Organization description'ni to'liq qo'yadi.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:177-198 findUnique include'lar take'siz; 200-qator `return company;` (select yo'q).
recommended_fix: `select` bilan faqat ochiq maydonlarni qaytaring; vacancies'ga `take: 20` (+ `_count`), reviews'ga `take: 10` (+ aggregate rating) qo'ying. Sahifada 'Barcha vakansiyalar' → `/vacancies?company=<slug>` havolasi bo'lsin. userId o'rniga `isMine` flag'i yoki umuman chiqarmaslik.
dependencies: lib/companies/detail.ts mapCompanyToViewModel (ratingSummary reviews'dan hisoblaydi — aggregate'ga o'tkazish kerak); CompanyReviews komponenti
fix_risk: O'rta: sharh reytingi va 'mening sharhim' mantiqi to'liq ro'yxatga tayanishi mumkin.

title: Email/Telegram/push havolalari til prefiksini yo'qotadi; sitemap origin (WEB_ORIGIN) va canonical origin (VITE_SITE_URL) — ikki xil manba
root_cause: absoluteUrl = WEB_ORIGIN + url, foydalanuvchi tili hisobga olinmaydi. chat.routes.ts:131 (`${env.WEB_ORIGIN}/messages`), alerts.service.ts:153 (`/vacancies/slug`) va public/sw.js:29-40 (push `client.navigate(target)`) ham shunday. robots/sitemap URL'lari env.WEB_ORIGIN'dan (seo.routes.ts:14), canonical/hreflang esa VITE_SITE_URL'dan (lib/i18n/config.ts:21-23) olinadi. WEB_ORIGIN default 'http://localhost:5173' (env.ts:24), web dev esa 3001'da.
impact: ru/en foydalanuvchi har bir bildirishnomadan o'zbekcha sahifaga tushadi. WEB_ORIGIN Vercel domeniga (masalan ishbor.vercel.app), VITE_SITE_URL esa custom domenga sozlansa, sitemap'dagi barcha URL'lar canonical'dan boshqa host'da bo'ladi va Google sitemap'ni 'canonical emas' deb e'tiborsiz qoldiradi. WEB_ORIGIN prod'da berilmasa, xatlarda localhost havolalari ketadi.
evidence: notifications.service.ts:60 `const absoluteUrl = input.url ? `${env.WEB_ORIGIN}${input.url}` : env.WEB_ORIGIN;`; env.ts:24 `WEB_ORIGIN: z.string().default("http://localhost:5173")`; config.ts:22 `VITE_SITE_URL || "http://localhost:3001"`.
recommended_fix: notify()'da user locale'ni oling (agar User/Profile'da til saqlansa; bo'lmasa cookie'dan olingan tilni profilga yozish) va `loc(locale, url)` qo'llang (seo.routes.ts:22 dagi funksiyani common'ga chiqaring). Prod'da WEB_ORIGIN'ni majburiy qiling (`isProd` bo'lsa default yo'q) va DEPLOY.md'da WEB_ORIGIN === VITE_SITE_URL talabini yozing; yoki sitemap uchun alohida PUBLIC_SITE_URL env'ini qo'shing.
dependencies: User modelida locale maydoni bormi — tekshirilmagan; DEPLOY.md
fix_risk: Past (env validatsiyasi prod deploy'ni to'xtatishi mumkin — ataylab).

title: OG rasm endpoint'i vakansiya statusini tekshirmaydi — draft/rejected/archived e'lon ma'lumoti ochiq
root_cause: `prisma.vacancy.findUnique({ where: { slug } })` faqat mavjudligini tekshiradi. getVacancyBySlug (vacancies.service.ts:357) va similarVacancies (379) esa `status !== 'active'` bo'lsa 404 beradi.
impact: Moderatsiyadan o'tmagan yoki rad etilgan vakansiyaning sarlavhasi, kompaniya nomi, hududi va maoshi slug orqali PNG ko'rinishida ochiq ko'rinadi. Javob 1 kun `immutable` bilan keshlanadi, shuning uchun vakansiya keyin yopilsa ham ulashilgan havola eski ma'lumotni ko'rsatadi. Detail sahifa 404 bilan zid.
evidence: og.routes.ts:10-17 `findUnique({ where: { slug }, include: { company, region } }); if (!vacancy) return 404` — status tekshiruvi yo'q; 27-qator `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400, immutable`.
recommended_fix: `if (!vacancy || vacancy.status !== 'active') return 404` qo'shing va `select` bilan faqat kerakli maydonlarni oling. `immutable`ni olib tashlang (max-age=3600, stale-while-revalidate).

title: sitemap-employer barcha kompaniyalarni (bo'sh, auto-yaratilgan, bloklangan egali) filtrsiz va tartibsiz kiritadi
root_cause: `prisma.company.findMany({ select, take: 50000 })` da where va orderBy yo'q. sitemap-vacancy (101-105) da ham orderBy yo'q. Company modelida holat maydoni yo'q (schema.prisma:299-335); egasi User.isBlocked (schema:168) hisobga olinmaydi. Public /api/companies/:slug (companies.routes.ts:175-200) ham bloklangan egali kompaniyani qaytaradi.
impact: Ro'yxatdan o'tganda avtomatik yaratilgan, tavsifsiz va vakansiyasiz kompaniya sahifalari thin content sifatida indeksga yuboriladi, bu sayt sifat bahosini pasaytiradi. 50 000 dan oshganda qaysi yozuvlar kesilishi noaniq (orderBy yo'q). Bloklangan foydalanuvchi kompaniyasi ochiq qoladi.
evidence: seo.routes.ts:114-117 where yo'q; 101-105 `where: { status: 'active' }, take: 50000` orderBy'siz.
recommended_fix: Kompaniyalarni `where: { OR: [{ vacancies: { some: { status: 'active' } } }, { description: { not: null } }], owner: { isBlocked: false } }` bilan filtrlang (Prisma Mongo relation filter), `orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' }` qo'shing. Vakansiyalarga `orderBy: { publishedAt: 'desc' }` qo'shing. 50k'dan oshsa sitemap-vacancy-N.xml bo'laklariga ajrating (vercel.json va seo.js ALLOWED regex'i `sitemap(-[a-z]+)?` raqamli suffiksni o'tkazmaydi — uni ham yangilang). Vakansiyasiz/tavsifsiz kompaniya sahifasiga noindex qo'yish ham mumkin.
dependencies: apps/web/vercel.json rewrites, apps/web/api/seo.js:15 ALLOWED regex
fix_risk: Past: faqat sitemap tarkibi; relation filter Mongo'da har kompaniya uchun lookup qiladi, lekin 10k'da qabul qilinadi.

title: Har ko'rishda viewsCount update qilinadi, @updatedAt yangilanadi — sitemap lastmod ma'nosiz; SSR/bot GET ham bazaga yozadi
root_cause: getVacancyBySlug har chaqiruvda `prisma.vacancy.update({ viewsCount: increment })` qiladi. Vacancy.updatedAt `@updatedAt` (schema.prisma:428), shuning uchun u ham yangilanadi. sitemap-vacancy lastmod = updatedAt (seo.routes.ts:108). SSR +data (vacancies/@slug/+data.ts:14) va client retry ham shu endpoint'ni chaqiradi.
impact: Mashhur vakansiyalar lastmod'i doim 'hozir' bo'ladi. Google soxta lastmod'ni sezib, sayt uchun lastmod signalini butunlay e'tiborsiz qoldiradi. Har bir bot hit'i bitta yozuv (20k vakansiya × crawl), ya'ni GET yon ta'sirga ega; viewsCount statistikasi ham botlar bilan buziladi.
evidence: vacancies.service.ts:359-362 `await prisma.vacancy.update({ where: { id }, data: { viewsCount: { increment: 1 } } })`; seo.routes.ts:103,108 `select: { slug, updatedAt }` → lastmod.
recommended_fix: Sitemap lastmod uchun `publishedAt` ishlating (yoki content o'zgarishida qo'lda yangilanadigan `contentUpdatedAt` maydoni qo'shing). viewsCount'ni `$runCommandRaw` ($inc, updatedAt'ga tegmasdan) orqali oshiring yoki alohida endpoint/beacon'ga ko'chiring, botlarni (user-agent) hisobga olmang.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: $runCommandRaw ObjectId konvertatsiyasini talab qiladi; oddiy yechim — faqat lastmod manbasini almashtirish.

title: SSR +data fetch'larida timeout yo'q — sekin API SSR'ni osiltirib qo'yadi
root_cause: Server tomonda chaqiriladigan fetcher'lar signal berilmasa timeout'siz ishlaydi: tryFetch (api.ts:60-66), fetchVacancyPage (299), fetchVacancyDetail (336), fetchSimilarVacancies (350), fetchCompanyPage (395), fetchCompanyDetail (443), fetchSimilarCompanies (459), articles/api.ts:12. +data.ts fayllari signal uzatmaydi. apps/web/api/seo.js:39 (sitemap proxy) ham timeout'siz.
impact: API sekinlashsa har bir SSR so'rov Vercel funksiyasi timeout'igacha (504) osilib qoladi. Barcha ochiq sahifalar (home, /vacancies, detail) ishlamay qoladi, crawl budget yeydi, error-state/retry UI esa hech qachon chizilmaydi.
evidence: vacancies/+data.ts:15-18 `fetchVacancyPage(toApiParams(query))` signalsiz; index/+data.ts:4-8 Promise.all(fetchStats, fetchVacancies, fetchCompanies) — hammasi tryFetch orqali, AbortSignal yo'q.
recommended_fix: api.ts'da `serverSignal(signal?)` yordamchisini qo'shing: `signal ?? (typeof window === 'undefined' ? AbortSignal.timeout(5000) : undefined)`. Uni tryFetch va barcha public fetcher'larda ishlating. Timeout'ni AbortError emas, ApiError(0) deb qayta tashlang, shunda +data'ning mavjud 'failed' yo'li ishlaydi. seo.js'ga ham `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000)` qo'shing.
dependencies: Detail sahifalar uchun 503 finding'i bilan birga qilish ma'qul
fix_risk: Past: Node 20 AbortSignal.timeout'ni qo'llaydi; hozirgi catch'lar faqat AbortError nomini alohida tekshiradi, shuning uchun timeout xatosini ApiError'ga aylantirish shart.

title: Canonical va hreflang barcha query param'larni tashlab yuboradi — sitemap'dagi /salaries?category= va sahifalash URL'lari o'z canonical'iga zid
root_cause: useHead canonical'ni faqat logical pathname'dan quradi. HeadDefault.tsx:52-55 dagi alternates ham shunday. Natijada sitemap-static'dagi `/salaries?category=X` va `/salaries?region=Y` (seo.routes.ts:91-94) sahifalarining canonical'i `/salaries` bo'ladi. /vacancies?page=2, /companies?..., /articles?page=N ham 1-sahifaga canonical qilinadi. /vacancies?q= sarlavhasi so'rovga moslashadi (vacancies/+Head.tsx:12-13), lekin noindex yo'q (articles'da bor: articles/index/+Head.tsx:28).
impact: Sitemap'dagi yuzlab maosh URL'lari 'canonical boshqa sahifa' deb indeksdan chiqariladi, ya'ni sitemap'dagi kasb/hudud bo'yicha maosh sahifalari organik trafik bermaydi. Sahifalashdagi vakansiyalar kashf qilinmaydi. Cheksiz ?q= kombinatsiyalari 'duplicate, Google chose different canonical' shovqinini beradi. ItemList JSON-LD filtrlangan sahifalarda ham chiqadi.
evidence: head.ts:25 `canonical: `${SITE_ORIGIN}${localizeHref(logical, locale)}``; seo.routes.ts:92 `/salaries?category=${c.slug}`; salaries/+Head.tsx:12 `canonical={canonical}`; vacancies/+Head.tsx:31 noindex'siz.
recommended_fix: useHead'ga `canonicalParams?: string[]` opsiyasini qo'shing. U whitelist param'larni saqlaydi va tartiblaydi (salaries: category, region; vacancies/companies/articles: page>1). alternates ham shu param'larni olsin. /vacancies va /companies'da `q` (va saved=1) bo'lsa `noindex` qo'ying. Aks holda salaries sitemap yozuvlarini olib tashlang — ikkalasidan biri izchil bo'lsin.
dependencies: seo.routes.ts sitemap-static; HeadDefault.tsx alternates
fix_risk: Past: faqat meta teglar; canonical'dagi param tartibi sitemap URL'lari bilan bir xil bo'lishi kerak.

title: Rol guard'lar faqat client'da: SSR kontenti chaqnaydi, returnTo yo'q, redirect zanjirlari bor
root_cause: useRequireRole/useRedirectRole useEffect ichida window.location.assign/replace qiladi. Login sahifasiga qaytish manzili uzatilmaydi va login doim '/'ga olib boradi (login/+Page.tsx:32,95). Zanjirlar: signup(employer) → /employer (signup/+Page.tsx:34) → useRedirectRole → /profile (employer/+Page.tsx:13); admin /favorites yoki /alerts → /employer/candidates (favorites/+Page.tsx:19, alerts/+Page.tsx:13) → useRequireRole('employer','/') → '/'. Employer uchun '/', '/vacancies', '/companies' avval to'liq SSR qilinadi, keyin /employer/candidates'ga sakraydi (index/+Page.tsx:37, vacancies/+Page.tsx:46, companies/+Page.tsx:53).
impact: Notification/email havolasi (/employer/applications, /messages, /applications) orqali kelgan login qilinmagan foydalanuvchi login'dan keyin bosh sahifaga tushadi, kontekst yo'qoladi. Ikki marta to'liq sahifa qayta yuklanishi va kontent chaqnashi yuz beradi. Xavfsizlik backend'da (API requireRole), shuning uchun faqat UX/perf muammo.
evidence: useRoleGuard.ts:18 `window.location.assign(l("/login"))` (returnTo yo'q); login/+Page.tsx:32 `window.location.assign(l("/"))`.
recommended_fix: useRequireRole'da `/login?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(pathname+search)}` yuboring. Login/SocialLogin'da safeInternalUrl (lib/notifications/adapter.ts:61 dagi mantiq) bilan tekshirib o'sha manzilga qayting. signup employer done → to'g'ridan-to'g'ri '/profile' yoki '/employer/vacancies'. wrongRoleRedirect'ni rolga qarab hisoblang (admin → '/admin'). Kontent chaqnashini kamaytirish uchun `status === 'loading'` paytida skeleton ko'rsating.
dependencies: pages/login/+Page.tsx, pages/signup/+Page.tsx, components/SocialLogin.tsx
fix_risk: Past: returnTo open-redirect bo'lmasligi uchun faqat '/' bilan boshlanib, '//' bo'lmagan yo'llarga ruxsat bering.

title: Bosh sahifa SSR'da API xatosini bo'sh holat (0 statistika, bo'sh bloklar) sifatida 200 bilan beradi
root_cause: fetchStats (api.ts:498-502) xatoda EMPTY_STATS {0,0,0} qaytaradi; fetchVacancies (api.ts:280-285) {items:[],total:0}; fetchCompanies (api.ts:389-393) [] qaytaradi. +data xatoni sezmaydi.
impact: API o'chiq yoki sekin bo'lsa bosh sahifa '0 vakansiya, 0 kompaniya' ko'rsatadi va shunday indekslanadi/keshlanadi. Bu product rule 4'ga zid (EMPTY ≠ ERROR). Timeout yo'qligi bilan birgalikda sahifa yoki osiladi, yoki yolg'on nol ko'rsatadi.
evidence: api.ts:500 `if (!res || !res.ok) return EMPTY_STATS;`; api.ts:282 `if (!res || !res.ok) return { items: [], total: 0 };`; index/+data.ts:4-13 hech qanday failed flag'siz.
recommended_fix: index/+data.ts'da fetchVacancyPage/fetchCompanyPage (ApiError tashlaydigan) variantlaridan foydalaning va `{ stats: Stats|null, vacancies: Vacancy[]|null, ... }` qaytaring. Page null'da blokni yashirsin yoki retry ko'rsatsin, statistikani esa 0 o'rniga umuman chiqarmasin.
dependencies: index/+Page.tsx render mantiqi (0 qiymat qanday chizilishi tekshirilmagan)

title: Detail sahifada API xatosi HTTP 200 + noindex bilan qaytadi — vaqtinchalik nosozlik indeksdan chiqarib yuboradi
root_cause: +data.ts ApiError'da `vacancy: null` qaytaradi (vacancies/@slug/+data.ts:17), sahifa 200 bilan chiziladi, +Head esa `noindex` qo'yadi. companies/@slug (+data.ts:17, +Head.tsx:23-24) va articles/@slug (+data.ts:19, +Head.tsx:27-28) ham xuddi shunday.
impact: API bir necha soniya sekin yoki o'chiq bo'lganda Googlebot o'sha paytda kirsa, faol vakansiya/kompaniya/maqola sahifasi indeksdan chiqadi. Qayta indekslanishi kunlab cho'ziladi. 5xx ishlatilganda bot keyinroq qaytib keladi, noindex'da esa qaytmaydi.
evidence: vacancies/@slug/+data.ts:17 `if (error instanceof ApiError) return { vacancy: null, failed: true }`; +Head.tsx:34-35 `if (!vacancy) return <Seo ... noindex />`; +title.ts xato sarlavhasini beradi, status kodi o'zgarmaydi.
recommended_fix: Faqat SSR'da (`typeof window === 'undefined'`) ApiError bo'lsa `throw render(503, VACANCY_UNAVAILABLE)` qiling. _error sahifasi shu abortReason uchun mavjud Retry holatini (VacancyDetailError) ko'rsatsin, noindex'siz. Client navigatsiyada hozirgi `null` + retry xatti-harakati qolsin. Uchala detail sahifaga ham qo'llang.
dependencies: _error/+Page.tsx va +Head.tsx'ga yangi abortReason tarmoqlari; useVacancyDetail/useCompanyDetail/useArticleDetail hook'lari
fix_risk: O'rta: Vike render(503) client-side navigatsiyada ham _error'ni chizadi, shuning uchun faqat server tomonda qo'llash kerak.

title: JobPosting: baseSalary currency doim 'UZS' (USD maosh noto'g'ri), hiringOrganization.sameAs ichki sahifa, validThrough amalda hech qachon yo'q
root_cause: (1) Vacancy.currency mavjud (schema.prisma:412), lekin VM'ga o'tmaydi (lib/vacancies/detail.ts:175-190) va +Head 'UZS' deb qattiq yozadi. (2) sameAs (69-qator) kompaniyaning o'z sayti o'rniga ISH BOR!'dagi /companies/:slug'ga ishora qiladi. (3) validThrough faqat expiresAt bo'lsa qo'yiladi, API'da esa Vacancy.expiresAt hech qayerda o'rnatilmaydi va tekshirilmaydi (grep: api src'da vakansiya expiresAt ishlatilmaydi). Vakansiyalar abadiy active qoladi. (4) employment 'remote' → FULL_TIME (13-qator).
impact: USD'dagi maosh Google Jobs'da so'mda ko'rinadi, ya'ni to'qima ma'lumot (product rule 4). sameAs noto'g'ri entity bog'lanishini beradi. validThrough yo'qligi va eskirgan e'lonlarning yopilmasligi Google Jobs'da 'expired job' ogohlantirishlariga va sifat pasayishiga olib keladi.
evidence: +Head.tsx:94-95 `currency: "UZS"`; :69 `sameAs: `${ORIGIN}${localizeHref(`/companies/${company.slug}`, locale)}``; :59 `...(vacancy.expiresAt ? { validThrough } : {})`; detail.ts:190 salary {min,max,type} — currency yo'q.
recommended_fix: VM salary'ga `currency: str(raw?.currency) ?? 'UZS'` qo'shib, +Head'da ishlating. sameAs'ni `company.website` bo'lsa shu bilan to'ldiring, aks holda `url` maydoniga ichki sahifani qo'ying. Vakansiya faollashtirilganda expiresAt = publishedAt + 30 kun o'rnatish va muddati o'tganlarni `closed`/`archived` qiluvchi sweep qo'shish uchun product qarori kerak; hozircha kamida sitemap'da publishedAt'ga qarab eski e'lonlarni cheklash.
dependencies: lib/vacancies/detail.ts VM tipi; API createVacancy/admin status o'tishlari (expiresAt uchun)
fix_risk: Past (currency/sameAs); O'rta (expiresAt sweep — mavjud vakansiyalarni yopib qo'yishi mumkin, backfill kerak).

title: Admin panel (moderatsiya, bloklash, rol berish, broadcast) token'dagi rolga ishonadi — DB'dagi joriy rol/blok tekshirilmaydi
root_cause: `adminOnly = { preHandler: [requireAuth, requireRole("admin")] }` (admin.routes.ts:19) — `requireRole` faqat `req.user.role` (auth-guard.ts:170-175). `requireStaff` (auth-guard.ts:183-190, DB'dan rol+isBlocked) faqat articles/team'da. Admin roli olib tashlansa yoki bloklansa (team.routes.ts:188-192, admin.routes.ts:191-197) eski token 15 daqiqa amal qiladi; auth-guard izohida (:177-181) bu ataylab admin panel uchun qilingani yozilgan, lekin admin.routes'ga qo'llanmagan.
impact: Faolsizlantirilgan admin 15 daqiqa ichida boshqa adminlarni bloklashi, o'ziga qayta rol berishi (`/api/admin/users/:id/role` boshqa hisobiga), broadcast yuborishi mumkin. Hujjat/kod nomuvofiqligi: auth-guard.ts izohi "Admin paneli ... uchun" deydi, admin.routes.ts requireRole ishlatadi.
evidence: admin.routes.ts:19; auth-guard.ts:170-175 vs 183-190; jwt.ts:126-129 payload `role`.
recommended_fix: admin.routes.ts:19 → `requireStaff("admin")` (bitta indexed findUnique, admin so'rovlari kam). Employer/seeker route'larda token roli qolaversin (yuk tufayli), lekin refresh'da (auth.service.ts:122) allaqachon DB roli olinadi — yaxshi.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Refresh token stateless (30 kun), bekor qilish ro'yxati yo'q — logout/parol o'zgarishi o'g'irlangan cookie'ni to'xtatmaydi
root_cause: `signRefreshToken({sub})` 30 kunlik JWT (jwt.ts:135-137), DB'da saqlanmaydi; `refreshSession` faqat imzo + user mavjud + isBlocked (auth.service.ts:110-123). `/api/auth/logout` faqat cookie'ni tozalaydi (auth.routes.ts:90-93). Rotation'da eski token amal qilishda davom etadi.
impact: CORS/SVG/XSS zanjirlari yoki qurilma o'g'irlanishi orqali olingan refresh cookie 30 kun davomida yangi access tokenlar beradi; foydalanuvchi "chiqish" qilsa ham, admin blok qilmasa hech narsa yordam bermaydi. Parolni almashtirish oqimi ham yo'q.
evidence: jwt.ts:136 `expiresIn: "30d"`; auth.service.ts:113-122; auth.routes.ts:91 `clearRefreshCookie(reply)` — server tomonda hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.
recommended_fix: User modeliga `tokenVersion Int @default(0)` qo'shib refresh payload'ga `ver` yozish; `refreshSession`da `payload.ver !== user.tokenVersion` → 401; logout (`/api/auth/logout` — cookie'dagi tokendan sub olib) va admin block'da `tokenVersion++`. Bu bitta indexed findUnique — allaqachon bor (:118). Minimal va backward-compatible: `ver` yo'q eski tokenlar 0 deb qabul qilinadi.
dependencies: schema.prisma User; admin.routes.ts:168-189 block handler

title: WebSocket: maxPayload 100MB (ws default), xabar/ulanish rate-limit yo'q, token muddati va blok holati qayta tekshirilmaydi
root_cause: server.ts:108 `app.register(websocket)` options'siz → ws.Server default `maxPayload: 100*1024*1024` (ws/lib/websocket-server.js:74). chat.routes.ts:71-80 token faqat ulanishda tekshiriladi (15 daqiqadan keyin ham socket ochiq qoladi, bloklangan/roli o'zgargan user ham). Har `message` uchun `participantsOf` DB so'rovi (:92) va `prisma.message.create` (:111) cheklovsiz; foydalanuvchi bir nechta socket ochishi cheklanmagan (realtime.ts:12-19). @fastify/rate-limit faqat HTTP upgrade so'roviga tegadi, xabarlarga emas.
impact: Bitta kirgan foydalanuvchi soniyasiga minglab 4000-belgili xabar yuborib bazani va suhbatdoshning Telegram'ini (notifyUserViaTelegram, :129) spam bilan to'ldiradi; 100MB frame'lar xotira bosimi; bloklangan user chat orqali yozishda davom etadi (100k xabar miqyosida bounded data prinsipi buziladi).
evidence: server.ts:108; chat.routes.ts:76 `verifyAccessToken(...)` faqat bir marta; :83-134 `ws.on("message")` ichida limit yo'q; :112 `body.slice(0, 4000)` faqat uzunlik; realtime.ts:18 `set.add(ws)` cheklovsiz.
recommended_fix: `app.register(websocket, { options: { maxPayload: 16 * 1024 } })`; ulanishda `prisma.user.findUnique({select:{isBlocked:true}})` tekshiruvi; token `exp` dan keyin (`setTimeout(() => ws.close(4001), (exp*1000 - Date.now()))`) socketni yopish, client reconnect qiladi; per-socket token-bucket (masalan 20 xabar/10s) — oshsa xabarni tashlash yoki yopish; userId uchun maksimal 5 socket; `data.conversationId` ni `isObjectId` bilan tekshirish (Prisma xatosini oldini oladi).
dependencies: web useChatSocket.ts reconnect mantiqi (4001 kodini tushunishi)
fix_risk: Past; maxPayload juda kichik qo'yilsa uzun xabar (4000 belgi ≈ 16KB UTF-8 gacha) uzilishi mumkin — 64KB xavfsiz

title: Upload va boshqa og'ir endpoint'larda alohida rate-limit yo'q (600/min umumiy × 5MB)
root_cause: Global limit 600 so'rov/min (server.ts:103, env RATE_LIMIT_MAX default 600); strict limit faqat login/register/google/telegram-start (auth.routes.ts:55), support (5/min), team invites, articles helpful (20/min). Logo (companies.routes.ts:126), rezyume PDF (profile.routes.ts:95), maqola muqovasi (articles.admin.routes.ts:289) — har biri 5MB gacha, disk'ka yoziladi; `/api/auth/refresh` (auth.routes.ts:74), `/api/auth/telegram/poll` (:115), `/api/conversations/start` (chat.routes.ts:140), `/api/vacancies/:id/apply` — umumiy limitda.
impact: Bitta employer daqiqasiga ~3GB (600×5MB) yozib Railway Volume'ni to'ldiradi; eski logo o'chirilsa ham rezyume/muqova eskilari qolib ketadi (profile.routes.ts'da eski fayl o'chirilmaydi). Refresh endpoint'iga 600/min — refresh token brute-force amaliy emas, lekin DB'ga (auth.service.ts:118) keraksiz yuk.
evidence: server.ts:103 `rateLimit, { max: env.RATE_LIMIT_MAX, timeWindow: "1 minute" }`; companies.routes.ts:126-157, profile.routes.ts:95-121, articles.admin.routes.ts:289-306 — `config.rateLimit` yo'q; grep bo'yicha rateLimit config faqat 4 joyda.
recommended_fix: Upload route'larga `{ config: { rateLimit: { max: 5, timeWindow: "1 minute" } } }`; refresh/poll'ga 30/min; write-endpoint'lar (apply, conversations/start, reviews) 20/min. Profile resume upload'da eski faylni o'chirish (companies.routes.ts:147-151 namunasi) va DELETE'da unlink.
dependencies: trustProxy fix'i bilan birga ma'noli (aks holda XFF bilan chetlab o'tiladi)

title: Ochiq kompaniya va vakansiya sahifalari kompaniyaning ichki maydonlarini (STIR, legalName, ownerUserId, obuna) va sharh muallifi userId'sini qaytaradi
root_cause: `GET /api/companies/:slug` butun Prisma company obyektini (`return company`, :201) — `stir`, `legalName`, `ownerUserId`, `subscriptionPlanId`, `subscriptionExpiresAt`, `industryId` (schema.prisma:299-321) — va `reviews.userId` (:189) ni tokensiz beradi. `getVacancyBySlug` (vacancies.service.ts:345-352) `company: { include: ... }` — xuddi shu maydonlar. Frontend view-model faqat keraklisini oladi, lekin API ochiq.
impact: Soliq raqami (STIR) va yuridik nom — kompaniya ochiq ma'lumoti hisoblanishi mumkin, lekin `ownerUserId` + `reviews[].userId` ObjectId'lari: boshqa employer `/api/conversations/start` (chat.routes.ts:140-151, candidateUserId) orqali sharh yozgan nomzodlarga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozadi; obuna muddati raqobatchiga ko'rinadi. Product rule 3 ("candidate private data noqonuniy expose qilinmaydi") ga zid.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:175-202 `include` bilan findUnique va `return company;`; :184-191 review select'da `userId: true`; vacancies.service.ts:344-352.
recommended_fix: Ikkala joyda `select` bilan ochiq maydonlar ro'yxati: id, name, slug, logoUrl, description, website, industry, employeeCount, foundedYear, images, region, isVerified, createdAt; reviews'dan `userId` ni olib tashlab `mine` ni serverda hisoblash (token ixtiyoriy) yoki review id bilan o'chirish (reviews.routes.ts:225 allaqachon id bilan ishlaydi).
dependencies: apps/web/src/lib/companies/detail.ts va vacancies/detail.ts mapper'lari (qo'shimcha maydon kutmaydi — xavfsiz); reviews `mine` belgisi frontend'da userId'ga bog'liq bo'lsa tekshirish
fix_risk: Frontend biror joyda `company.ownerUserId` yoki `review.userId` ishlatsa sinadi — grep bilan tekshirish

title: Nomzod rezyume PDF'lari /uploads/ da autentifikatsiyasiz, `resume-<userId>-<ms>.pdf` nomi bilan; eski fayl o'chirilmaydi
root_cause: Fayl nomi `resume-${userId}-${Date.now()}.pdf` (:104) — userId employer'larga `/api/candidates` (candidates.routes.ts:86) va chat orqali ma'lum; fastifyStatic hammaga beradi (server.ts:107). Yangi yuklashda eski fayl o'chirilmaydi (:103-119), DELETE ham faqat DB'ni tozalaydi (:123-131) — fayl diskda qoladi va URL'ni bilgan har kim ochishda davom etadi.
impact: Shaxsiy hujjat (telefon, manzil) o'chirilgandan keyin ham ochiq qoladi; nom taxmini: userId ma'lum bo'lsa ms-timestamp brute force (~60k so'rov/daqiqa oralig'i uchun) rate-limit ichida bir necha soatda amalga oshadi. Disk hajmi 10k user × bir nechta yuklash → cheklanmagan o'sish.
evidence: profile.routes.ts:104 `const filename = \`resume-${req.user!.sub}-${Date.now()}.pdf\`;`; :127-129 faqat `resumeUrl: null`; server.ts:107 prefix `/uploads/` auth'siz.
recommended_fix: Nomga `crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex')` qo'shish (articles cover'dagidek, articles.admin.routes.ts:298); eski faylni `fs.promises.unlink` bilan o'chirish (upload va DELETE'da); ideal: rezyumeni `/api/profile/resume/file` (o'zi) va `/api/applications/:id/resume` (vakansiya egasi) orqali `requireAuth` bilan stream qilish, `Content-Disposition: attachment`.
dependencies: Employer applications UI rezyume havolasini qaysi URL'dan oladi — tekshirish
fix_risk: Mavjud `resumeUrl` yozuvlari eski nom bilan qoladi (backward compatible)

title: Fastify default logger har WS ulanishida `req.url` ni yozadi → `/ws/chat?token=<accessToken>` loglarga tushadi
root_cause: `Fastify({ logger: true })` (server.ts:48) — fastify/lib/logger.js:52 request serializer'i `url: req.url` ni info darajasida yozadi. Chat va bildirishnoma socketlari tokenni query'da yuboradi (chat.routes.ts:75-76; web useChatSocket.ts:35, useNotifications.ts:63 `?token=${...}`) — har sahifa yuklanishi/reconnect'da.
impact: Railway/log agregator'ida amaldagi access tokenlar (15 daqiqa) saqlanadi; loglarga kirish huquqi bo'lgan yoki log oqimi sizib chiqsa — seans egallash. GDPR/ichki xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan ham token loglanmasligi kerak.
evidence: server.ts:47-53; fastify/lib/logger.js:52 `url: req.url`; chat.routes.ts:75 `const url = new URL(req.url ?? "", "http://localhost"); userId = verifyAccessToken(url.searchParams.get("token") ?? "").sub;`
recommended_fix: `logger: { serializers: { req(req) { return { method: req.method, url: req.url.replace(/([?&]token=)[^&]+/, '$1[redacted]'), hostname: req.hostname, remoteAddress: req.ip } } } }`. Alternativ: WS'da tokenni birinchi xabar (`{type:'auth', token}`) sifatida yuborish yoki `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` sarlavhasida — URL'da umuman bo'lmaydi.
dependencies: Agar auth-xabar usuli tanlansa web useChatSocket.ts/useNotifications.ts ham o'zgaradi
fix_risk: Serializer o'zgarishi — past; protokol o'zgarishi — client/server sinxron deploy talab qiladi

title: `trustProxy: true` — X-Forwarded-For soxtalashtirib rate-limit'ni chetlab o'tish mumkin
root_cause: `trustProxy: true` barcha proxy'larga ishonadi; proxy-addr shunda XFF zanjirining eng chap (mijoz yozgan) manzilini `req.ip` qiladi (fastify/lib/request.js:118). @fastify/rate-limit `defaultKeyGenerator = (req) => req.ip` (rate-limit/index.js:27). Mijoz har so'rovda `X-Forwarded-For: <random>` yuborsa Railway proxy uni o'chirmay ustiga qo'shadi.
impact: Login brute-force (auth.routes.ts:55-57 10/min), support spam (5/min), upload flood — barcha IP-ga bog'liq chegaralar bekor bo'ladi.
evidence: server.ts:52 `trustProxy: true`; rate-limit/index.js:27 `req.ip`; fastify/lib/request.js:116-119 proxyAddr(this.raw, proxyFn).
recommended_fix: `trustProxy: 1` (faqat bitta — Railway edge — hop'iga ishonish) yoki Railway'ning ichki tarmoq CIDR'i. Login/register uchun qo'shimcha email-asosli kalit: `keyGenerator: (req) => normalizeEmail(req.body?.email) ?? req.ip`.
dependencies: Railway'da hop soni (odatda 1); self-host'da nginx sozlamasi
fix_risk: Hop soni noto'g'ri bo'lsa hamma so'rov proxy IP'siga yig'ilib butun sayt 429 oladi (server.ts:49-51 izohida shu xavf yozilgan) — deploy'dan keyin tekshirish shart

title: /uploads/ statik xizmatida xavfsizlik sarlavhalari (Content-Disposition, sandbox CSP) yo'q va mimetype faqat client sarlavhasidan
root_cause: `fastifyStatic({ root, prefix })` — `setHeaders` yo'q; Content-Type kengaytmadan. Yuklashda `data.mimetype` (client `Content-Type` part header) asosida kengaytma tanlanadi (companies.routes.ts:135, profile.routes.ts:101, articles.admin.routes.ts:292); fayl tarkibi tekshirilmaydi. Helmet nosniff bor — shuning uchun PNG/PDF nomli HTML sniff qilinmaydi, lekin SVG va PDF (Chrome PDF viewer, `application/pdf` inline) API origin'ida ochiladi. Logo route'da noto'g'ri mimetype bo'lsa stream o'qilmaydi (companies.routes.ts:136 — articles'dagi `data.file.resume()` yo'q) — so'rov osilib qolishi mumkin.
impact: SVG XSS (alohida P0), PDF'lar inline ochilishi (fishing/`javascript` yo'q, lekin brendlangan sahifa sifatida ko'rinadi), disk'ka istalgan tarkibli fayl yozish (png nomli zip/exe).
evidence: server.ts:107; companies.routes.ts:133-141; profile.routes.ts:99-106; articles.admin.routes.ts:290-300.
recommended_fix: `fastifyStatic({..., setHeaders(res, filePath){ res.setHeader('Content-Security-Policy',"default-src 'none'; sandbox"); res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options','nosniff'); if (filePath.endsWith('.pdf')) res.setHeader('Content-Disposition','attachment'); res.setHeader('Cache-Control','public, max-age=31536000, immutable'); } })`; umumiy `readUpload(part, allowed: {mime, magic, ext}[])` helper (magic-bytes + `truncated`) uchta route'da; noto'g'ri mimetype'da `data.file.resume()`.
dependencies: SVG P0 fix'i bilan bitta helper
fix_risk: Past; ``/og:image ishlashda davom etadi (sandbox img'ga ta'sir qilmaydi)

title: Web (Vike) origin'ida Content-Security-Policy umuman yo'q; API'da esa script-src 'unsafe-inline'
root_cause: vercel.json:232-245, server/index.mjs:40-45, vite.config.ts:8-13 — faqat nosniff/XFO/COOP/Referrer-Policy (+HSTS Vercel'da). CSP yo'q, shuning uchun JSON-LD kabi har qanday HTML injection to'g'ridan-to'g'ri script ishga tushiradi va localStorage'dagi access tokenni oladi. API'da (server.ts:63) 'unsafe-inline' — API HTML bermaydi, lekin /uploads/ SVG uchun aynan shu zaif nuqta.
impact: XSS'ga qarshi ikkinchi qatlam himoya yo'q; bitta injection = token o'g'irlash. Self-hosted (server/index.mjs) da ham HSTS yo'q.
evidence: vercel.json:234-244 headers ro'yxatida CSP yo'q; server/index.mjs:40-45 SECURITY_HEADERS; server.ts:63 `scriptSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"...]`.
recommended_fix: Web'ga: `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-<THEME_INIT_SCRIPT>' https://accounts.google.com; connect-src 'self' <API_URL> wss://<API_HOST> https://accounts.google.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; frame-src https://accounts.google.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'` (avval Report-Only). API'da `scriptSrc: ["'self'"]` (API HTML bermaydi, inline kerak emas) va /uploads/ uchun sandbox CSP.
dependencies: JSON-LD fix'i; Google GIS, HMR (dev'da alohida), THEME_INIT_SCRIPT hash'i
fix_risk: O'rta — noto'g'ri CSP saytni sindiradi; Report-Only bilan boshlash

title: NODE_ENV .env.example'da yo'q (default 'development' prod'da jim xavfsizlik rejimini o'chiradi); lokal .env'da ishlatilmaydigan REDIS_URL/SITE_URL; JWT secret min(8)
root_cause: env.ts:5 NODE_ENV default 'development'. U berilmasa refresh cookie Lax va secure=false (auth.routes.ts:39-40), CORS'ga localhost origin'lar qo'shiladi (env.ts:110), CSP 'unsafe-eval' va ws: (server.ts:63,71), HSTS o'chiq (81-83). .env.example'da NODE_ENV qatori yo'q, DEPLOY.md:62,74 esa uni 'majburiy' deydi. apps/api/.env:4 REDIS_URL va :9 SITE_URL kodda hech qayerda o'qilmaydi (grep bo'sh), :2 eski PostgreSQL satri izohda. JWT_*_SECRET z.string().min(8) (env.ts:18-19) prod uchun juda zaif.
impact: Railway'da NODE_ENV unutilsa: seans har yangilanishda yo'qoladi (Lax cross-site), prod CORS'da http://localhost:* credentials bilan ruxsat oladi, HSTS yo'q. 8 belgili secret brute-force qilinishi mumkin.
evidence: env.ts:5,18-19,105-111; .env.example (NODE_ENV yo'q; qolgan 40 kalit env.ts bilan mos); apps/api/.env qatorlari 2,4,9; DEPLOY.md:62,74,197.
recommended_fix: .env.example boshiga `NODE_ENV=development  # Railway'da production` qo'shing. env.ts'da superRefine: NODE_ENV=production bo'lsa JWT secret'lar min(32) va bir-biriga teng emas. Startup'da `if (!isProd && process.env.RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT) app.log.warn('NODE_ENV=production emas')`. Lokal .env'dan REDIS_URL/SITE_URL/eski PG satrini olib tashlang.
dependencies: Mavjud prod secret'lar 32 belgidan qisqa bo'lsa, rotatsiya hamma seanslarni chiqaradi.
fix_risk: O'rta (secret min uzunligi prod startni to'xtatishi mumkin — avval warn, keyin enforce).

title: test:e2e eski dist'ni qayta build qilmasdan ishlatadi; 'ws' faqat tranzitiv; root'da test/CI yo'q; faqat NODE_ENV=production rejimi testlanadi
root_cause: "test:e2e": "node scripts/e2e-check.mjs" (package.json:17) faqat dist/server.js borligini tekshiradi (e2e:47-50), eskirganligini emas. e2e:392 import('ws') — ws apps/api/package.json dependencies'da yo'q (@fastify/websocket orqali hoist qilingan). e2e env NODE_ENV: 'production' (67), dev yo'llari (Lax cookie, localhost CORS) tekshirilmaydi. Root package.json'da faqat test:e2e bor, web uchun test yo'q, CI yo'q.

evidence: apps/api/package.json:13,17; e2e-check.mjs:45-50,64-83,392; root package.json scripts.
recommended_fix: "pretest:e2e": "npm run build" qo'shing (yoki e2e ichida dist mtime < src mtime bo'lsa ogohlantiring). "ws": "^8" ni devDependencies'ga qo'shing. Ixtiyoriy: dev rejimda cookie SameSite=Lax va localhost CORS'ni tekshiradigan kichik ikkinchi ishga tushirish. Minimal CI: typecheck + build (+ Mongo service bilan e2e).
dependencies: Untracked modullar commit qilinishi (CI uchun).

title: Kritik authz yo'llari testlanmagan: users/:id/summary, conversations/start va rating, saved-searches IDOR, reviews DELETE, admin (articles/team'dan tashqari) non-admin, refresh lifecycle, uploads
root_cause: 52 check asosan happy-path va tanlangan IDOR'larni qamraydi. Qamralganlar: vakansiya PUT/PATCH/DELETE begona (714-723), ariza status begona (357-363), notifications (823-874), favorites (802-821), messages begona (375-389). Qamralmaganlar (grep=0): /api/users/:id/summary (chat.routes.ts:400), /api/conversations/start (140), /api/conversations/:id/rating (329,360), PATCH/DELETE /api/saved-searches/:id begona (alerts.routes.ts:115-145), DELETE /api/reviews/:id begona (reviews.routes.ts:77), /api/admin/users|overview|vacancies/:id/moderate|broadcast|payments/:id/confirm'ga nomzod/employer (admin.routes.ts:39-500; e2e 886-899 faqat /api/admin/articles va /team), /api/auth/refresh rotatsiya, logout cookie tozalash, bloklangan oddiy user refresh, /api/profile/resume va /api/employer/company/logo tur validatsiyasi, 429.
impact: Bu route'larda regressiya (masalan admin guard olib tashlansa yoki summary'da conversation tekshiruvi buzilsa) deploydan oldin sezilmaydi. Nomzod shaxsiy ma'lumoti chiqib ketishi (summary) yoki admin panel ochilib qolishi mumkin.
evidence: e2e-check.mjs check ro'yxati (grep '^await check(' = 52); coverage grep: conversations/start=0, /summary=0, moderate=0, saved-searches/=0, api/reviews/=0, profile/resume=0, company/logo=0, auth/refresh=0, auth/logout=0, broadcast=0, payments=0, 429=0.
recommended_fix: Bitta 'authz matritsasi' check qo'shing: [path, method] ro'yxati × [guest→401, seeker→403, employer→403] (admin route'lar). IDOR check'lar: seeker2 → PATCH/DELETE seeker'ning saved-search → 403; hr2 → GET /api/users/<seekerId>/summary → 403; seeker2 → DELETE review → 403. Refresh: login → cookie bilan /refresh → yangi token; logout → Max-Age=0; bloklangan user /refresh → accessToken null.
dependencies: P2023 fix (malformed id check'lari uchun); candidates 402 fix.

title: E2E: yetim server jarayoni va eski serverga qarshi yolg'on 'OK', sleep'ga tayangan kutishlar, zanjirli holat
root_cause: Server spawn qilinadi (85), lekin top-level await'lar (137-142 bootstrap loop, 196-199 prisma update) try/finally ichida emas. Istisno bo'lsa server.kill chaqirilmaydi va 4711-portda tirik qoladi. Keyingi ishga tushirishda yangi server EADDRINUSE bilan o'ladi, lekin health loop (90-101) ESKI serverni topib up=true qiladi. server 'exit' hodisasi kuzatilmaydi. Bootstrap loop (137-142) 30s'dan keyin jim to'xtaydi. Qat'iy sleep'lar: 426 (700ms bildirishnoma), 1008 (300ms ko'rishlar). Token/ID'lar global o'zgaruvchilarda, bitta erta xato keyingilarini kaskad qiladi.
impact: Flaky natijalar, yuklangan mashinada tasodifiy yiqilishlar. Eng yomoni: eski build yoki boshqa bazaga qarshi testlar 'HAMMASI O'TDI' deyishi.
recommended_fix: Butun check blokini try { ... } finally { server.kill('SIGTERM'); await prisma.$disconnect() } ichiga oling. server.once('exit', code => { if (!done) { console.error(log); process.exit(1) } }) qo'shing. Portni env'dan oling (E2E_PORT) yoki boshlashdan oldin port bandligini tekshiring. Bootstrap loop tugamasa aniq xato bilan exit(1) qiling. sleep(700/300) o'rniga 'shart bajarilguncha poll' helper (waitFor(fn, 5000)) ishlating.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: --force-reset xavfsizlik sharti substring 'test' — 'latest', 'contest', 'attestation' kabi ishchi baza nomlari ham o'tadi

title: Bloklangan oddiy user (seeker/employer) access token muddati (15 daq) tugaguncha barcha API va WS'dan foydalanaveradi; test faqat staff uchun
root_cause: requireAuth faqat JWT'ni tekshiradi (auth-guard.ts:12-23). isBlocked faqat login/refresh'da (auth.service.ts:86,120) va requireStaff'da (41-42) tekshiriladi. Admin block (admin.routes.ts:168) darhol kuchga kirmaydi.

evidence: auth-guard.ts:12-23,38-45; auth.service.ts:70-88,110-122; e2e-check.mjs:1061-1066 faqat staff bloklash.
recommended_fix: Minimal: requirePhoneVerified allaqachon DB so'rovi qiladi (53-56) — select'ga isBlocked qo'shib 403 qaytaring (kalit yozish amallarini qoplaydi). WS connect'da ham tekshiring. e2e: admin seeker2'ni bloklaydi → eski token bilan POST /api/vacancies/:id/apply → 403.
dependencies: WS fix bilan birga.

title: WebSocket: maxPayload yo'q (ws default 100MiB), auth xatosida close code yo'q, blocked/phone tekshiruvi yo'q, xabar rate-limit yo'q; e2e faqat happy-path
root_cause: app.register(websocket) opsiyasiz (server.ts:108), shuning uchun ws maxPayload default 100 MiB va JSON.parse butun payload'ni o'qiydi (chat.routes.ts:86). Yaroqsiz token'da ws.close() kodsiz (78), klient uni tarmoq uzilishidan ajrata olmaydi. Token faqat ulanishda tekshiriladi, keyin muddati tugasa yoki user bloklansa ham socket ochiq qoladi. Xabar yuborishda requirePhoneVerified yo'q (REST /start'da bor, 140). Per-socket xabar limiti yo'q.
impact: Bitta ulanish katta frame'lar bilan xotira/CPU'ni to'ldiradi (DoS). Bloklangan user suhbatda yozishda davom etadi. Spam xabarlar cheksiz, har biri DB write va Telegram notify.
evidence: server.ts:108; chat.routes.ts:71-137; e2e-check.mjs:391-423 (faqat yaroqli token + clientId).
recommended_fix: app.register(websocket, { options: { maxPayload: 64 * 1024 } }). Auth xatosida ws.close(4401, 'unauthorized'). Ulanishda prisma.user.findUnique({select:{isBlocked:true}}) — bloklangan bo'lsa 4403. Oddiy token bucket (masalan 20 xabar/10s). e2e check'lar: yaroqsiz token → close 4401; begona conversationId'ga yuborish → suhbatdoshga yetmaydi va DB'da xabar yo'q.
dependencies: Web chat klientining reconnect logikasi 4401'da refresh qilishi kerak.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: maxPayload 4000 belgilik xabar + JSON uchun yetarli bo'lishi kerak.

title: Path param'dagi noto'g'ri ObjectId → Prisma P2023 → 500 (22 ta handler); e2e faqat body'dagi ObjectId'ni tekshiradi
root_cause: Global error handler faqat P2002/P2025'ni map qiladi (server.ts:126-133). `req.params as { id: string }` validatsiyasiz Prisma'ga beriladi: vacancies.routes.ts:150,199,231; applications.routes.ts:29,187,214; notifications.routes.ts:92,109; alerts.routes.ts:119,134; chat.routes.ts:305,330,361,401; reviews.routes.ts:78; admin.routes.ts:169,192,257,345,413,420,470; team.routes.ts:168. MongoDB'da Prisma malformed ObjectID uchun P2023 tashlaydi.
impact: /api/notifications/abc/read kabi so'rovlar 500 INTERNAL_ERROR qaytaradi va error darajasida loglanadi (log shovqini, monitoring'da yolg'on alert). 400/404 kutgan frontend noto'g'ri xabar ko'rsatadi.
evidence: server.ts:126-140; e2e-check.mjs:217-223 faqat body regionId; grep: 24 ta 'params as { id: string }', faqat 2 tasi isObjectId/objectId() bilan (articles.admin.routes.ts:135, team.routes.ts:159).
recommended_fix: Bitta global fix: error handler'ga `if (error.code === 'P2023') return reply.status(400).send({ error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'ID formati noto\'g\'ri' })` qo'shing (yoki resurs route'lari uchun 404). Keyinchalik route'larda isObjectId guard. e2e'ga check: GET /api/conversations/xyz/messages, POST /api/notifications/xyz/read, PATCH /api/applications/xyz/status → 400/404, 500 emas.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Jarayon ichidagi holat (WS sockets, Telegram login token'lari, rate-limit store, alert timer, bot long-poll) — deploy overlap'da dublikat/409; SIGTERM'da loop va timer to'xtatilmaydi, timeout yo'q
root_cause: realtime.ts:10 sockets Map; telegram.service.ts:55,87 link/login token Map'lari; rate-limit memory store (server.ts:103); setInterval (alerts.service.ts:184-202); for(;;) getUpdates (telegram.service.ts:329). Shutdown handler (server.ts:208-223) faqat app.close + prisma.$disconnect qiladi: bot loop va alert timer ishlashda davom etadi, app.close uchun majburiy timeout yo'q. numReplicas: 1 (railway.json:13) bo'lsa ham Railway yangi konteynerni eskisi to'xtamasdan ko'taradi.
impact: Deploy paytida ikkala nusxa getUpdates → Telegram 409 va alert sweep ikki marta, ya'ni takroriy email/push. Restart'da Telegram orqali kirayotgan foydalanuvchilar token'i yo'qoladi ('expired'). $disconnect'dan keyin loop Prisma'ga murojaat qilib xato loglaydi. app.close osilib qolsa SIGKILL.
evidence: server.ts:201-203,208-223; realtime.ts:10; telegram.service.ts:55,87,327-348; alerts.service.ts:184-202; railway.json:13; DEPLOY.md:89-93.
recommended_fix: telegram.service'da `let stopped=false; export function stopTelegramBot(){stopped=true}` va loop `while(!stopped)`; alerts'da `stopAlertScheduler(){clearInterval(timer)}`; shutdown'da avval shularni, keyin app.close, hammasini `setTimeout(()=>process.exit(1),10_000).unref()` bilan o'rang. Alert sweep dublikatiga qarshi DB lease: savedSearch.lastCheckedAt'ni shartli updateMany bilan 'claim' qiling. Single-instance cheklovini README/DEPLOY'da ro'yxat sifatida yozing (rate-limit, WS, login token'lar).
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Ariza holati o'tishlari tekshirilmaydi — istalgan holatdan istalgan holatga, takroriy holat ham tarixga yoziladi
root_cause: `PATCH /api/applications/:id/status` (210-280) `statusSchema` (18-21) faqat enum'ni tekshiradi; `application.status === status` yoki ruxsat etilgan o'tish (`sent→viewed→invited→accepted|rejected`) tekshiruvi yo'q. Vakansiya holatida esa `allowedFrom` mantiqi bor (vacancies.routes.ts:209-212).
impact: `accepted → viewed`, `rejected → invited` kabi mantiqsiz o'tishlar; bir xil holat qayta yuborilsa `applicationStatusHistory` ga takror yozuv (231-238) va nomzodga takroriy bildirishnoma/chat xabari (243-276). Frontend (employer/applications) sahifasi tarixni 'Faoliyat' sifatida ko'rsatadi — takrorlar chiqadi.
evidence: applications.routes.ts:215 `const { status, reason } = statusSchema.parse(req.body);` :229-240 transaction'da hech qanday `application.status` sharti yo'q.
recommended_fix: `if (application.status === status) return application;` (no-op) + `const allowedFrom: Record<status, string[]>` (viewed: [sent]; invited: [sent, viewed]; accepted: [invited, viewed, sent]; rejected: [sent, viewed, invited]) — mos kelmasa `Errors.conflict(...)` (409, vacancies bilan bir xil konventsiya). Frontend `vacancyActionErrorKind` kabi 409 ni 'transition' deb ko'rsatsin.
dependencies: Frontend employer/applications 409 xabari; e2e-check holat testlari
fix_risk: O'rta — biznes qoidasi (masalan rad etilganni qayta taklif qilish) kerak bo'lsa ro'yxatni kengaytiring

title: Bir qator zod sxemalarida satr uzunligi cheklanmagan (title/description/requirements/conditions, coverLetter, email/password/firstName/lastName, company maydonlari, qidiruv `text`)
root_cause: Faqat Fastify default bodyLimit (1MB) chegara. Cheklanmagan: vacancies.routes.ts:42-45 `title: z.string().min(3)`, `description: min(10)`, `requirements`, `conditions`; :22-23 `text`, `categorySlug` (query); auth.routes.ts:13-17 `email`, `password: min(8)`, `firstName`, `lastName` (:23 login `password: min(1)`); applications.routes.ts:14 `coverLetter`; companies.routes.ts:255-261 `name`, `legalName`, `stir`, `description`; chat.routes.ts:46 `companySlug`; candidates.routes.ts:24-25 `text` (zod umuman yo'q). Taqqoslash: alerts.routes.ts:139 `text: max(200)`, admin.routes.ts:22 `max(120)`, resume.routes.ts barcha maydon max bilan.
impact: 1MB gacha sarlavha/tavsif saqlanadi, Meilisearch'ga indekslanadi (`syncVacancyIndex`), SSR sahifa, sitemap/OG rasm (og.routes.ts:273-278 `renderVacancyOgImage({ title })`) va bildirishnomalar matniga tushadi; 1MB parol argon2 hash/verify'ga (auth.service.ts:33; login) — CPU yuki (rate-limit 10/min faqat yumshatadi). Qidiruv `text` uzun bo'lsa `contains` regex 5 maydon × 6 term (vacancies.service.ts:101-127) — sekin so'rov.

recommended_fix: `.trim().max(N)` qo'shing: title 160, description/requirements/conditions 10_000, coverLetter 4000 (chat body bilan mos), email 254, password 128 (team.routes.ts:227 kabi), firstName/lastName 60 (profile.routes.ts bilan mos), company name 160/legalName 200/stir 20/description 2000, query `text` 200, `categorySlug` 80; candidates uchun zod sxema (`text max 100`, `region: objectId().optional()`).

fix_risk: Past — mavjud haqiqiy ma'lumot chegaralardan kichik; edit'da eski uzun yozuv bo'lsa 400 chiqishi mumkin (limitni yetarli katta tanlang)

title: `z.coerce.number()` salary/salaryTo/page/pageSize `.int()/.finite()/.max()` siz — Infinity va juda katta qiymatlar Prisma xatosi (500) yoki behuda og'ir so'rovga olib keladi
root_cause: listQuerySchema (27-34): `salary`, `salaryTo`, `page`, `pageSize` faqat `z.coerce.number()`. Zod `Number("Infinity")`/`"1e400"` → Infinity ni qabul qiladi (NaN rad etiladi, Infinity emas). Service (vacancies.service.ts:190-192) `page` ni faqat pastdan cheklaydi: `Math.max(query.page ?? 1, 1)`; `skip = (page-1)*pageSize` → `1e300` kabi qiymat Prisma `skip` uchun yaroqsiz (Int chegarasi) → PrismaClientValidationError → 500. `salaryMin: { gte: Infinity }` (:84-91) Int filtriga tushadi. Meilisearch yo'lida `offset: skip` (:208) ham shu qiymat.
impact: `?page=1e300` yoki `?salary=Infinity` → 500 (errorHandler map qilmaydi) + error log shovqini; katta lekin yaroqli `page` (masalan 10^7) 20k vakansiyada foydasiz `skip` bilan to'liq skan.
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:27 `salary: z.coerce.number().optional(),` :33 `page: z.coerce.number().optional(),`; vacancies.service.ts:190 `const page = Math.max(query.page ?? 1, 1);` :192 `const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;`. Taqqoslash: articles.routes.ts:34 `page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10_000)`, alerts.routes.ts:144 `salary: z.coerce.number().int().min(0)`.
recommended_fix: `salary/salaryTo: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(2_147_483_647)`, `page: .int().min(1).max(10_000)`, `pageSize: .int().min(1).max(50)` — articles/alerts sxemalari bilan bir xil. `salaryQuerySchema` va companies list allaqachon `.catch()` bilan yumshoq.
dependencies: Frontend lib/vacancies/query.ts parse (URL dan kelgan qiymat)

title: :id param'lar ObjectId sifatida tekshirilmaydi va errorHandler P2023 ni ushlamaydi — noto'g'ri id 404/400 o'rniga 500 beradi
root_cause: errorHandler (117-125) faqat P2002→409, P2025→404 ni map qiladi; Prisma+MongoDB'da noto'g'ri formatdagi id `PrismaClientKnownRequestError` P2023 ("Malformed ObjectID") tashlaydi → 133 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` + error log. ObjectId tekshiruvi (`validation.ts objectId/isObjectId`) faqat team, articles.admin, favorites/companies da ishlatilgan. Tekshirilmaydigan yo'llar: vacancies.routes.ts:150,199,231 (`ownedVacancy` :78 findUnique), applications.routes.ts:29-33, 187-192, 214-217; chat.routes.ts:305, 330, 361, 401-409 (where ichida string); favorites.routes.ts:343-345, 365; notifications.routes.ts:92-93, 109-110; alerts.routes.ts:244-246, 260; admin.routes.ts:168-173, 191-195, 256-266, 344-351, 412-415, 419-421; reviews.routes.ts:78-79; candidates.routes.ts:32 (`regionId: query.region`). Shuningdek `PrismaClientValidationError` va CORS rad etish (`cb(new Error(...))` :94, statusCode yo'q) ham 500 ga tushadi.

evidence: server.ts:117-125 faqat `P2002`/`P2025`; vacancies.routes.ts:150 `const { id } = req.params as { id: string };` → :78 `prisma.vacancy.findUnique({ where: { id: vacancyId } ...`; candidates.routes.ts:32 `...(query.region ? { regionId: query.region } : {})`.
recommended_fix: Minimal va backward-compatible: errorHandler'ga `if (error.code === "P2023") return reply.status(404).send({ error: "NOT_FOUND", ... })` (yoki 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) va `error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientValidationError → 400`; CORS xatosiga `statusCode = 403`. Qo'shimcha: umumiy `const idParams = z.object({ id: objectId() })` va route'larda `idParams.parse(req.params)`.

root_cause: REFRESH_COOKIE (auth.routes.ts:37-42): httpOnly, secure(prod), SameSite=None, path=/api/auth — cross-site arxitektura (Vercel+Railway) uchun majburiy. CORS (server.ts:486-495) ruxsatsiz origin'ni rad etadi, JSON body preflight talab qiladi. Lekin `fetch(url, {method:"POST", mode:"no-cors", credentials:"include"})` body'siz — preflight'siz yuboriladi: /refresh bajariladi (yangi accessToken javobi opaque — hujumchi o'qiy olmaydi, cookie yangilanadi — zarar yo'q), /logout (90-93) cookie'ni tozalaydi — foydalanuvchi begona saytdan chiqarib yuboriladi. Cookie `Origin` sarlavhasi tekshirilmaydi.
impact: Past: sessiya o'g'irlanmaydi; faqat majburiy logout. Origin tekshiruvi qo'shilsa to'liq yopiladi.
evidence: apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.routes.ts:37-52,74-93; apps/api/src/server.ts:484-495.
recommended_fix: authRoutes'ga preHandler: `/api/auth/refresh` va `/logout` uchun `Origin` sarlavhasi mavjud bo'lsa allowedOrigins/VERCEL_PREVIEW ga mos kelishini talab qiling (origin'siz — SSR/curl — ruxsat, hozirgi CORS mantiqi kabi). Yoki `Content-Type: application/json` ni majburiy qiling (no-cors bilan yuborib bo'lmaydi).
dependencies: env.ts allowedOrigins; e2e-check.mjs:169 cookie testi.

title: Google tokeninfo: fetch timeout yo'q, tarmoq xatosi 500 bo'ladi, iss tekshirilmaydi, Google sub saqlanmaydi
root_cause: verifyGoogleCredential (auth.service.ts:300-311) `fetch` AbortSignal/timeout'siz; `fetch` throw qilsa AppError emas -> server.ts:533-534 500 "Kutilmagan xatolik". aud va email_verified tekshiriladi (yaxshi), `iss` (accounts.google.com) va `exp` tokeninfo'ga ishonib qoldirilgan (tokeninfo muddati o'tgan tokenni 400 bilan rad etadi — qabul qilinadi). Foydalanuvchi Google `sub` bilan emas, faqat email bilan bog'lanadi.
impact: Google sekin javob bersa so'rov osilib qoladi (Fastify default timeout'siz), foydalanuvchi noaniq 500 ko'radi (EMPTY≠ERROR ruhida — bu holat 503 GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE bo'lishi kerak). Email o'zgargan Google hisobi yangi hisob sifatida ochiladi.
evidence: apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts:300-311; apps/api/src/server.ts:529-534.
recommended_fix: `fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })`, catch'da `new AppError(503, "GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE", ...)`; `info.iss` ni `https://accounts.google.com`/`accounts.google.com` bilan tekshiring; User'ga ixtiyoriy `googleSub String?` qo'shish (keyinchalik).
dependencies: Node 20 AbortSignal.timeout mavjud.

title: Access token localStorage'da — XSS bo'lsa 15 daqiqalik token o'g'irlanadi; hujjatlashtirilgan tradeoff
root_cause: AuthContext.tsx:16,55,80,88 `localStorage["ish-top:accessToken"]`. Refresh httpOnly (yaxshi). Helmet CSP faqat API javoblariga (server.ts:449-478), web (Vercel) tomonida CSP yo'qligi bu audit doirasida tekshirilmadi. Token muddati qisqa (15m) va refresh httpOnly bo'lgani uchun zarar chegaralangan.
impact: Stored XSS (boshqa dimension) bo'lsa tokenni 15 daqiqa ichida ishlatish mumkin; refresh o'g'irlanmaydi. Qabul qilinadigan risk, lekin in-memory saqlash + cookie-based refresh bilan yanada kamaytiriladi.
evidence: apps/web/src/components/AuthContext.tsx:16,37-66; apps/api/src/server.ts:449-478.
recommended_fix: Hozircha o'zgartirmaslik mumkin. Kelajakda: tokenni faqat xotirada saqlash (mount'da har doim refresh — cookie bor), localStorage'ni tashlab yuborish; web tomonida CSP (vercel.json headers). #2 (kuchli secret) bu riskning ta'sirini kamaytiradi.
dependencies: #2; frontend hosting CSP.
fix_risk: O'rta (in-memory'ga o'tishda mount'da har doim bitta refresh so'rovi qo'shiladi).

title: POST /api/push/subscribe — `endpoint` bo'yicha upsert boshqa foydalanuvchining obunasini o'ziga qayta yozadi
root_cause: `pushSubscription.upsert({ where: { endpoint }, update: { userId: req.user.sub, ... } })` — endpoint mavjud bo'lsa egasi tekshirilmasdan joriy userga o'tkaziladi. Endpoint URL'lari brauzer tomonidan yaratiladi (taxminlash qiyin), lekin bir qurilmada ikki hisob yoki endpoint sizgan holatda kuchga kiradi.
impact: Jabrlanuvchi push bildirishnomalarini yo'qotadi (kalitlar hujumchiniki bo'lgani uchun o'qiy olmaydi — asosan DoS). Past xavf.
evidence: notifications.routes.ts:332-347.
recommended_fix: `deleteMany({ where: { endpoint, userId: { not: me } } })` so'ng upsert; yoki unique'ni (`userId`, `endpoint`) juftligiga ko'chirish.
dependencies: schema.prisma:783 `endpoint @unique` — o'zgartirilsa `prisma db push`.

title: Yuklangan PDF rezyumelar `/uploads/resume-<userId>-<timestamp>.pdf` nomi bilan autentifikatsiyasiz ochiq
root_cause: Fayl nomi `resume-${userId}-${Date.now()}.pdf` (104) — userId 24-hex ma'lum bo'lsa (ownerUserId/reviews.userId sizishi, 7-topilma) va yuklash vaqti taxminan bilinsa, ms-darajali brute-force bilan topiladi. fastify-static (server.ts:195) barcha `/uploads/` fayllarini tekshiruvsiz beradi; rate-limit umumiy.
impact: Nomzodning shaxsiy PDF rezyumesi (telefon, manzil) potentsial ravishda uchinchi shaxsga ochiladi. Amaliy ehtimol past (rate-limit + vaqt oynasi), lekin dizayn jihatidan private fayl public static'da.
evidence: profile.routes.ts:104 `const filename = \`resume-${req.user!.sub}-${Date.now()}.pdf\``; server.ts:195.
recommended_fix: Fayl nomiga `crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex")` qo'shish (userId/timestamp o'rniga) — minimal; uzoq muddatda private fayllarni `GET /api/files/resume/:id` orqali egalik tekshiruvi bilan berish.
dependencies: 7-topilma (ID sizishi) bilan bog'liq.

title: Bosh sahifa kartasida ish joylashuvi (remote/hybrid/office) yo'q, stat'da "+" suffiksi, sharhlarda userId ochiq
root_cause: (1) Bosh sahifa eski VacancyCard'dan foydalanadi: faqat experience · employment ko'rsatiladi, workplaceType e'tiborsiz (47-50, 81-85). /vacancies'dagi yangi karta esa ko'rsatadi (components/vacancies/VacancyCard.tsx:41-50). (2) CountUp suffix="+" real sonni oshirib ko'rsatadi ("5+", "0+") (index/+Page.tsx:323). (3) GET /api/companies/:slug har sharh uchun userId qaytaradi (companies.routes.ts:189), bu faqat "mine" belgisi uchun ishlatiladi.
impact: Masofaviy va hududsiz vakansiya bosh sahifada joylashuvsiz ko'rinadi (bir sahifada ikki xil karta). "+" to'qima tuyulishini beradi. Ochiq reviewer userId'lari ko'rinadi (PDF fayl nomi ham userId'ga bog'liq).
evidence: components/VacancyCard.tsx:81-85 {t.enums.experience[...]} · {t.enums.employment[...]}; grep workplace → yo'q; index/+Page.tsx:323 <CountUp value={value} suffix="+" />; companies.routes.ts:189 userId: true.
recommended_fix: Bosh sahifada components/vacancies/VacancyCard'ni ishlatish (saved/onToggleSave bilan). suffix'ni olib tashlash. Sharhlarda userId o'rniga optional auth bilan `mine: boolean` hisoblash, yoki userId'ni faqat so'rovchi o'zi bo'lsa qaytarish.
dependencies: useFavorites API'si yangi karta prop nomlariga moslanadi

title: Admin overview va ro'yxatlar: users.createdAt/isBlocked, vacancies.createdAt indekslari yo'q; 14 kunlik ro'yxat xotirada, sana kalitlari TZ bo'yicha nomuvofiq
root_cause: overview 14 count'ining bir nechtasi indekssiz (user createdAt/isBlocked, application.count() va createdAt) va 14 kunlik findMany'lar bajaradi. Days bucket'i `setHours` (lokal) + `toISOString().slice(0,10)` (UTC) aralash. /api/admin/users va /api/admin/vacancies `orderBy createdAt desc` indekssiz sort, skip chuqurligi cheklanmagan, text qidiruv relation filter (jobSeekerProfile/company name) orqali $lookup.
impact: Admin sahifasi har ochilishda ≈ 10k users + 50k applications + 20k vacancies scan qiladi. Trafik past bo'lgani uchun tizimga ta'siri kichik, lekin sekin. Grafik Toshkent vaqti bo'yicha kunlarni 5 soatga siljitadi.
evidence: admin.routes.ts:59-97, 132-145, 217-230; schema.prisma:198-200 (User indekslari: telegramChatId, role), 436-439.
recommended_fix: `User @@index([createdAt])`, `Vacancy @@index([createdAt])`, `Application @@index([createdAt])` qo'shing. 14 kunlik dinamikani `aggregateRaw` $group ($dateToString, timezone: "Asia/Tashkent") bilan hisoblang. Overview'ni 60s kesh qiling.
dependencies: /api/stats uchun Application createdAt indeksi bilan umumiy

title: find-then-create naqshlari unique indeks bilan poyga holatida P2002 → 500 (conversation, application apply, companyReview)
root_cause: Mavjudlik `findUnique/findFirst` bilan tekshirilib keyin `create` — parallel ikki so'rovda ikkinchisi unique indeksga urilib Prisma P2002 tashlaydi, u 500 sifatida qaytadi (upsert/catch yo'q).
impact: Ikki marta bosish/ikki tab'da 500 (foydalanuvchi 'xato' ko'radi, aslida yozuv bor). Xavfsiz holat tamoyili buziladi, ma'lumot yo'qolmaydi.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:310-322 getOrCreateConversation; applications.routes.ts:52-65; reviews.routes.ts:995-1012. schema.prisma:505, 465, 725 unique indekslar.
recommended_fix: `upsert` (where unique compound, update: {}, create) yoki `create` ni try/catch P2002 → mavjudni qaytarish. Application uchun: `create` → catch P2002 → `findUnique` → 200.

title: reindexAll — barcha faol vakansiyalar bitta findMany + bitta addDocuments (Meili payload limiti), warmSearchIndex har server startida to'liq reindex
root_cause: Chegarasiz findMany (20k × description 4000) → ~100 MB gacha bitta HTTP so'rov Meili'ga (default payload limit 100 MB); `deleteAllDocuments` keyin qo'shish → qisqa vaqt qidiruv bo'sh natija beradi.
impact: Faqat Meili yoqilganda; 20k'da start sekin, reindex muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa qidiruv bo'sh (EMPTY≠ERROR buzilishi mumkin — fallback Mongo'ga o'tadi, lekin faqat xato bo'lsa).
evidence: search.service.ts:878-888, 954-962; server.ts:202 `void warmSearchIndex()`.
recommended_fix: Cursor bilan 1 000 talik bo'laklarda o'qish/yuborish; deleteAll o'rniga eskirgan id'larni farq bilan o'chirish; start'da faqat indeks bo'sh bo'lsa reindex.

title: Vakansiya detail — har ko'rishda `update viewsCount` (`@updatedAt` ham yangilanadi → sitemap lastmod har doim 'hozir') + to'liq company include (stir, ownerUserId, subscription*, images)
root_cause: Prisma `update` updatedAt'ni bumpaydi; articles'da bu `$runCommandRaw $inc` bilan hal qilingan, vacancy'da yo'q. include `company: { include: {...} }` to'liq.
impact: Har ochiq sahifa ko'rishi = 1 yozish; sitemap lastmod ma'nosiz; ichki kompaniya maydonlari ochiq javobda.
evidence: vacancies.service.ts:342-364; articles.routes.ts:1241-1245 (incrementCounter namunasi); og.routes.ts:10-13 ham `company: true`.
recommended_fix: `$runCommandRaw({ update:'vacancies', updates:[{ q:{_id}, u:{ $inc:{ views_count:1 } } }] })` (fire-and-forget), yoki bot/crawler'larni (UA) hisoblamaslik; company uchun `select` (name, slug, logoUrl, isVerified, industry, description, website, employeeCount, foundedYear, images, region).

title: PUT va PATCH status'da requirePhoneVerified yo'q (POST'da bor); ariza yuborishdagi race 200 o'rniga 409 beradi
root_cause: POST /api/vacancies `requirePhoneVerified`ni talab qiladi (133), PUT (148) va PATCH (197) esa yo'q: telefoni tasdiqlanmagan hisob eski draft'ni faollashtira oladi. Apply'da findFirst→create ketma-ketligi parallel so'rovda unique indeksga uriladi, P2002 → 409 'Bu yozuv allaqachon mavjud', holbuki kutilgan idempotent javob 200 (applications.routes.ts:52-65).
impact: Kichik siyosat nomuvofiqligi. Ikki marta bosishda nomzod xato xabarini ko'radi.
evidence: vacancies.routes.ts:133, 148, 197; applications.routes.ts:52-65; server.ts:127-129.
recommended_fix: PATCH status→active'ga requirePhoneVerified qo'shish. Apply'da P2002'ni ushlab, mavjud arizani 200 bilan qaytarish.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: DESIGN.md bilan farqlar: markViewed optimistik, 'Moderatsiyada' kartasi erishib bo'lmaydigan holat, landing moderatsiya va'dasi
root_cause: DESIGN.md:109 'Holat server javobidan keyin yangilanadi' deydi, lekin markViewed holatni avval lokal o'zgartiradi va xatoda jimgina qaytaradi (127-134). DESIGN.md:66 5 ta statistika kartasida 'Moderatsiyada'ni ko'rsatadi, lekin employer yo'lida hech narsa bu holatni qo'ymaydi (vacancies.service.ts:435). 'Yopilgan' (archived) kartasi yo'q, garchi bu employer uchun real holat bo'lsa ham (VacancyStats.tsx:7-14).
impact: Spetsifikatsiya va xulq mos emas. 'Moderatsiyada 0' doimiy shovqin bo'ladi, 'Yopilgan'ni esa faqat toolbar orqali topish mumkin.

Rejected→moderation fix'i qabul qilinsa 'Moderatsiyada' kartasi mazmunli bo'ladi. Aks holda kartani 'Yopilgan' bilan almashtirish va DESIGN'ni yangilash.

title: Masofaviy vakansiyada hudud tanlab bo'lmaydi va tahrirlashda doim null yuboriladi (backend ixtiyoriy deydi); 'remote' employmentType API'da hali qabul qilinadi
root_cause: toVacancyPayload remote'da `regionId: edit ? null : undefined` yuboradi. Rule 2 va backend (`assertVacancyPlacement`) remote'da hududni ixtiyoriy deb biladi, e2e-check.mjs:739 'remoteWithRegion' holatini sinaydi. createSchema/updateSchema'da `employmentType: 'remote'` hali ruxsat (vacancies.routes.ts:50), UI esa yangi e'londa uni yashiradi (form.ts:29-31).
impact: Hududi bor eski masofaviy e'lon istalgan maydon tahrirlanganda hududini jimgina yo'qotadi. API orqali yangi e'lonlarga employmentType=remote va workplaceType=office kabi qarama-qarshi kombinatsiya yozilishi mumkin.
evidence: form.ts:34, 128, 209; vacancies.routes.ts:48-50, 156, 168; vacancies.rules.ts:26.
recommended_fix: Edit'da remote bo'lsa, foydalanuvchi hududni o'zgartirmagan bo'lsa regionId'ni yubormaslik (undefined), shunda saqlangan qiymat qoladi. API'da `employmentType === 'remote' && workplaceType && workplaceType !== 'remote'` bo'lsa 400 berish (faqat yangi yoki yangilanayotgan yozuvlar uchun).
dependencies: DESIGN.md:129 ('masofaviyda yashiriladi va yuborilmaydi') bilan kelishish.

title: Cleanup'siz setTimeout'lar — unmount'dan keyin setState
root_cause: SaveSearchButton.tsx:118-121, FavoriteButton.tsx:35, EmployerCompanyForm.tsx:93, ContactForm.tsx:114, useMessenger.ts:197 (`emitInboxChanged` 500ms) — taymerlar ref'da saqlanmaydi va unmount'da tozalanmaydi. React 18 ogohlantirmaydi, lekin sahifa almashganda keraksiz ish va (useMessenger) navigatsiyadan keyin event.
impact: Polish: konsol shovqini yo'q, lekin naqsh nomuvofiq (useShare.ts:37-38 va useNotice.ts to'g'ri qilingan).
evidence: SaveSearchButton.tsx:118 `window.setTimeout(() => { setOpen(false); setDone(false); }, 1600)`; FavoriteButton.tsx:35.
recommended_fix: useShare.ts naqshi: `timer = useRef<number>()` + `useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer.current), [])`.

title: useSalaryCatalogs: kataloglar so'rovi cancel flag'siz va xatoda jimgina bo'sh
root_cause: 60-65 `fetchCategories().then(setCategories)` — unmount'dan keyin setState; `fetchCategories/fetchRegions` (api.ts:721-725) xatoda `[]` → filtr select'lari bo'sh, xato ko'rinmaydi.
impact: Maoshlar sahifasida kategoriya/hudud filtri 'yo'q' bo'lib ko'rinadi.
evidence: useSalaryStats.ts:60-65; api.ts:723 `if (!res || !res.ok) return [];`.
recommended_fix: `let alive = true` + AbortSignal; bo'sh natija bilan xatoni ajratish (VacancyFormView.tsx:85 kabi `error`).

title: useClickOutside har renderda qayta obuna bo'ladi (inline callback deps)
root_cause: Barcha chaqiruvchilar (`Header.tsx:40`, `NotificationBell.tsx:16`, `SaveSearchButton.tsx:100`) `() => setOpen(false)` inline beradi; effekt deps `[ref, onOutside, active]` — active bo'lganda har render 3 ta listener remove/add. useDialog.ts:18-21 esa ref orqali barqaror qilingan.

title: 429 rate-limit xabari inglizcha va o'zbek interfeysida ham chiqadi
root_cause: @fastify/rate-limit errorResponseBuilder'siz ro'yxatdan o'tgan. Uning default xabari 'Rate limit exceeded, retry in 1 minute', error handler uni o'zgartirmasdan uzatadi.
impact: Login/signup'da ko'p urinishdan so'ng barcha tillarda inglizcha texnik matn ko'rinadi (login +Page.tsx:34 err.message).
evidence: server.ts:103 `app.register(rateLimit, { max, timeWindow })`; server.ts:136-137 `message: error.message`; node_modules/@fastify/rate-limit/index.js:30 `Rate limit exceeded, retry in ${context.after}`.
recommended_fix: errorResponseBuilder bilan { statusCode: 429, error: 'RATE_LIMITED', message: "Juda ko'p urinish. Birozdan so'ng qayta urinib ko'ring." } qaytaring. Frontend RATE_LIMITED kodini t.errors.rateLimited ga map qilsin (#2 bilan birga).
dependencies: Topilma #2 (error code map)

title: Xato (404) sahifasida til almashtirish bosh sahifaga olib ketadi
root_cause: Switcher pageContext.localePathname'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'qiydi. render(404) bilan chizilgan xato sahifasida bu maydon bo'lmaydi (pageLocale.ts izohi aynan shu holatni tushuntiradi) va fallback '/' ga tushadi.
impact: /ru/vacancies/eski-slug 404 sahifasida EN tanlansa foydalanuvchi /en/vacancies/eski-slug o'rniga /en ga tushadi. Kichik UX.
evidence: LanguageSwitcher.tsx:19 `(pageContext.localePathname as string) || "/"`; lib/i18n/pageLocale.ts:4-17 (URL'dan tiklash logikasi bor, lekin switcher uni ishlatmaydi).
recommended_fix: `const logical = pageLocale(pageContext).pathname;` ishlating.

title: Sharh muallifi fallback'i qattiq yozilgan "Nomzod" — RU/EN vakansiya sahifasida o'zbekcha
root_cause: mapReview ismsiz profil uchun "Nomzod" satrini qaytaradi. lib/companies/detail.ts esa null qaytaradi va UI t.*.anonymous'dan foydalanadi, ya'ni ikki xil yondashuv bor.

title: Raqamlar hamma tilda ru-RU formatida (EN'da '1 207' bo'ladi, '1,207' emas)
root_cause: formatNumber, grp va CountUp'da Intl.NumberFormat("ru-RU") qattiq yozilgan, locale parametri yo'q.
impact: Ingliz interfeysida maosh va sonlar narrow-nbsp bilan guruhlanadi, EN konvensiyasiga zid. Kichik, lekin hamma joyda bor. Employer candidates sahifasida desiredSalary valyutasiz chiqadi.
evidence: lib/format.ts:3; lib/i18n/types.ts:2366 grp (messages.en.ts:796,1135,1152 va boshqalarda ishlatiladi); components/CountUp.tsx:39; pages/employer/candidates/+Page.tsx:265 (valyuta belgisi yo'q); apps/api/src/common/format.ts:3.

Candidates sahifasida t.fmt.salaryFrom kabi valyutali formatter ishlatilsin. Agar biznes uch tilda ham bo'sh joy bilan guruhlashni istasa, buni kodda izoh sifatida qayd eting.

title: Til cookie'si hech qachon yozilmaydi va o'qilmaydi (persistLocale/resolveLocale o'lik kod)
root_cause: LanguageSwitcher.choose() faqat navigate() qiladi va persistLocale chaqirilmaydi. resolveLocale ham hech qayerda ishlatilmaydi. Til faqat URL prefiksida yashaydi.
impact: Kutilgan 'cookie + URL prefiksi' xatti-harakati yo'q. /ru'ni tanlagan foydalanuvchi prefiksiz havola orqali (email, Telegram, bildirishnoma url'i '/employer/applications') kirsa, sahifa o'zbekcha ochiladi. O'lik kod chalg'itadi.
evidence: config.ts:9 LOCALE_COOKIE, :60 resolveLocale, :68-72 persistLocale; grep bo'yicha chaqiruvlar yo'q (faqat ta'riflar). components/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:15-22.
recommended_fix: Qaror qabul qiling: (a) LanguageSwitcher.choose() ichida persistLocale(next) chaqiring va faqat prefiksiz ichki navigatsiyada (SEO bot emas) cookie bo'yicha tavsiya qiling, 302 auto-redirect QILMANG; yoki (b) o'lik funksiyalarni o'chirib, hujjatda 'til faqat URL'da' deb yozing. Backend bildirishnoma url'lari tilsiz bo'lgani uchun (a) foydaliroq.
fix_risk: Past (cookie yozish SSR'ga ta'sir qilmaydi, redirect qo'shilmasa)

title: Terminologiya nomuvofiq: 'ariza' / 'murojaat', 'nomzod' / 'ish izlovchi', EN 'candidate' / 'applicant' / 'job seeker'
root_cause: Bir xil tushuncha (vakansiyaga yuborilgan application) turli bo'limlarda turli so'z bilan yozilgan, lug'at uchun glossary yo'q.
impact: Employer arizalar sahifasida sarlavha 'Hozircha murojaatlar yo'q', matn esa 'arizalar kelganda' deydi, bitta kartada ikki termin. EN'da nomzod 50 joyda 'candidate', 11 joyda 'job seeker', 3 joyda 'applicant'.
evidence: messages.uz.ts:716 `empty: "Hali murojaat yo'q."` (empApplications), :2536-2537 (murojaatlar va arizalar bir blokda), :2541 'Mos murojaatlar topilmadi'. Sanoq: uz 'ariza' 142 / 'murojaat' 12, 'nomzod' 44 / 'ish izlovchi' 11; ru 'кандидат' 43 / 'соискател' 14; en 'candidate' 50 / 'job seeker' 11 / 'applicant' 3.
