title: Filtr drawer'lari useDialog o'rniga fokus tuzog'ining nusxasini ishlatadi va farqlari bor
root_cause: CompanyFilterDrawer (46-85) va VacancyFilterDrawer (42-80) bir xil qo'lda yozilgan trap'ni takrorlaydi. Ular lib/useDialog.ts'dan farq qiladi: FOCUSABLE'da `select` `:not([disabled])` siz (7/8-qator), elementlar yo'qligida Tab'da preventDefault yo'q, fokus `trigger?.focus()` preventScroll'siz qaytadi, panel fokuslanganida Shift+Tab ishlanmaydi.
impact: Hozircha katta xato emas, lekin ikki joyda divergent a11y mantiq bor: bir joy tuzatilsa, ikkinchisi qolib ketadi. Yopilganda sahifa trigger'ga 'sakrashi' mumkin.
evidence: CompanyFilterDrawer.tsx:7 `const FOCUSABLE = '... select, textarea, ...'`, :62 `if (items.length === 0) return;`, :83 `trigger?.focus?.();`. VacancyFilterDrawer.tsx:8, :58, :78 xuddi shunday. useDialog.ts:39-43 da esa preventDefault bor va :59 preventScroll ishlatilgan.
recommended_fix: Ikkala drawer'da `useDialog(open, panelRef, onClose)` ishlating va faqat desktop matchMedia'da yopish effektini alohida qoldiring (DetailsDialog.tsx:15-22 naqshi).
dependencies: lib/useDialog.ts.

title: Tor (300px) sidebar sarlavhasiga whitespace-nowrap berilgan: ru/en tarjimada toshishi mumkin
root_cause: h2 `whitespace-nowrap`, ota flex-wrap esa faqat havolani pastga tushiradi. Sarlavhaning o'zi uzun bo'lsa sinmaydi, `min-w-0`/`truncate` ham yo'q.
impact: Uzun ruscha sarlavhalarda karta chegarasidan chiqib ketish yoki gorizontal toshish ehtimoli bor.
evidence: dashboard/SidebarCards.tsx:36 izoh 'Tor panelda (300px) sarlavha ikki qatorga bo'linmasin', :37 `<h2 id={id} className={`${SIDEBAR_TITLE} whitespace-nowrap`}>`.
recommended_fix: `whitespace-nowrap` o'rniga `min-w-0 truncate` (va `title`) ishlating yoki sinishiga ruxsat bering. Uch tildagi eng uzun sarlavhani 300px'da brauzerda tekshiring.
dependencies: i18n messages.ru.ts sarlavha uzunliklari.

title: DESIGN.md 'aylanadigan qator bor grid'ga grid-cols-1' qoidasi bir nechta grid'da qo'llanmagan
root_cause: `grid ... lg:grid-cols-[...]` klasslari lg'dan pastda implicit auto ustun beradi. Ichida overflow-x-auto tablist bo'lsa, min-content ustunni cho'zishi mumkin (DESIGN.md:286-287, 301-303 da qayd etilgan tuzoq).
impact: < lg ekranda gorizontal toshish xavfi. Hozir ApplicationDetail `min-w-0` o'ramda (EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:288) turgani uchun ehtimol yumshatilgan, lekin qoida izchil emas va kelajakdagi o'zgarishda regress bo'ladi.
evidence: EmployerApplicationsView.tsx:273 `className="mt-5 grid scroll-mt-28 items-start gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[340px_minmax(0,1fr)] ..."` (grid-cols-1 yo'q). Ichidagi employer/applications/ApplicationDetail.tsx:239 `role="tablist" ... overflow-x-auto`. Shu naqsh yana: messages/MessagesStates.tsx:12 MESSENGER_COLUMNS, articles/detail/ArticleDetailView.tsx:41, companies/detail/CompanyDetailStates.tsx:65, admin/articles/AdminArticleEditor.tsx:424, AuthShell.tsx:23. To'g'ri misol: pages/salaries/+Page.tsx:104 va pages/profile/+Page.tsx:188.
recommended_fix: Bu grid'larga `grid-cols-1` qo'shing (vizual o'zgarish yo'q), tarkibi aylanadigan ustun elementlariga esa `min-w-0` bering.
dependencies: Brauzer bosqichida 360/390px scrollWidth tekshiruvi bilan tasdiqlash.

title: Sahifa illyustratsiyalarining ko'pida tungi variant/moslashuv yo'q, drop-shadow rangi hardcoded
root_cause: messages/contact/support uchun `-dark.webp` va `dark:hidden/dark:block` juftligi bor, hero va auth-desk uchun CSS filter bor. Qolgan 7 ta rasmda hech narsa yo'q. Soya `drop-shadow-[0_10px_18px_rgba(79,70,229,0.18)]` light indigo qiymatida qotirilgan.
impact: Tungi rejimda yorug' illyustratsiyalar to'q fonda 'yopishtirilgan' ko'rinishi mumkin (vizual nomuvofiqlik). Funksional emas.
evidence: notifications/NotificationsHeader.tsx:47 `src="/notifications-bell.webp"` (:52 className'da dark: yo'q), applications/ApplicationsHeader.tsx:33, articles/ArticlesHeader.tsx:43, favorites/FavoritesHeader.tsx:40, salaries/SalaryPromoCard.tsx:26, vacancies/VacancyPromoBanner.tsx:25, companies/CompaniesHero.tsx:55. Taqqoslash: messages/MessagesHeader.tsx:44-45 va contact/ContactIllustration.tsx:13-14 da dark variant bor.
recommended_fix: Brauzer testida ko'rib chiqing. Kerak bo'lsa `.dark .illo { filter: brightness(.88) saturate(.92) }` kabi umumiy klass qo'shing (hero-photo naqshi) yoki -dark.webp tayyorlang. Soya uchun `dark:drop-shadow-[...]` variantini bering.
dependencies: Dizayn qarori, public/*.webp.

title: Sticky yon panellar va form sidebar'da 100vh ishlatilgan (dvh emas)
root_cause: `max-h-[calc(100vh-7.5rem)]` va `xl:max-h-[calc(100vh-7rem)]`. Mobil brauzer UI paneli ochiq-yopiq bo'lganda 100vh haqiqiy ko'rinadigan balandlikdan katta. Dialoglar va messenger esa to'g'ri dvh ishlatadi.
impact: Faqat lg/xl (planshet landscape / kichik noutbuk) holatida panel pastki qismi qisman kesilishi mumkin. Telefonda ta'siri yo'q, chunki bu elementlar lg'dan pastda yashirin.
evidence: pages/vacancies/+Page.tsx:134 `sticky top-24 max-h-[calc(100vh-7.5rem)] overflow-y-auto`, pages/companies/+Page.tsx:119 xuddi shunday, employer/vacancies/VacancyForm.tsx:544 `xl:max-h-[calc(100vh-7rem)]`, Layout.tsx:21 `min-h-screen`. Taqqoslash: messages/MessagesStates.tsx:8,10 `100dvh`.
recommended_fix: `100vh` → `100dvh` (Tailwind arbitrary value), Layout'da `min-h-screen` → `min-h-dvh` (Tailwind 3.4+ bo'lsa) yoki `min-h-[100dvh]`.
dependencies: Tailwind versiyasi (min-h-dvh utility uchun).

title: Tungi bg-signal ustidagi oq matn 4.47:1 (izohda 4.9:1 deyilgan); tungi danger tugmasi alohida qo'lda tuzatilgan
root_cause: #FFFFFF va #6366F1 kontrasti 4.47:1, global.css:49 izohi esa 'oq matn 4.9:1 ✓' deydi. Header signup (text-sm), filtr 'Natijalarni ko'rsatish' kabi bg-signal text-white tugmalar 14px semibold, ya'ni 'large text' emas. Danger uchun oq matn 2.67:1 bo'lgani sabab ConfirmDialog.tsx:87 va ApplicationStatusDialog.tsx:21 da `dark:text-[#0B0F1A]` qo'lda yozilgan.
impact: Asosiy CTA tugmalari tungi rejimda AA chegarasidan biroz past. Izoh va kod farq qiladi, dizayn-token hujjati noto'g'ri.
evidence: global.css:49 `--signal: 99 102 241; /* #6366F1 indigo — oq matn 4.9:1 ✓ */`. Hisob 4.47:1. Header.tsx:256 `bg-signal ... text-sm font-semibold text-white`.
recommended_fix: Dark `--signal`ni biroz to'qroq qiling (masalan 88 80 236, oq matn bilan ≥4.8:1). Matn uchun esa P2 topilmadagi `--signal-text` tokenini ishlating. Izohni haqiqiy qiymatga moslang. `--danger` uchun `--on-danger` tokeni qo'shib, qo'lda yozilgan hex'larni almashtiring.
dependencies: 'text-signal tungi kontrast' (P2) topilmasi bilan birga qilinsin: bitta tokenni ikki yo'nalishga surib bo'lmaydi.
fix_risk: Past-o'rta: brend rangiga vizual ta'sir qiladi.

title: Bildirishnoma va to'lov return URL'lari hali /pricing'ga ishora qiladi — 302 → /employer → client redirect → /profile zanjiri
root_cause: admin.routes.ts:483 va billing.routes.ts:155 notify url '/pricing'; billing.service.ts:223,239,247 return_url `${WEB_ORIGIN}/pricing`. pricing/+guard.ts:11 hamma uchun (employer bo'lmaganga ham) 302 → /employer; employer/+Page.tsx:13 employer'ni /profile'ga yuboradi.
impact: Eski/izolyatsiyalangan billing oqimidagi foydalanuvchi uch bosqichli redirect'ni boshdan kechiradi. `?pending=` param yo'qoladi (guard search'ni saqlamaydi). Product rule 1 bo'yicha core flow emas, shuning uchun ta'siri kam.
evidence: pricing/+guard.ts:11 `throw redirect(localizeHref("/employer", ...), 302)`; billing.service.ts:223 `${env.WEB_ORIGIN}/pricing?pending=${transactionId}`.
recommended_fix: Notify url'larni '/profile' (employer) ga almashtiring. Guard'ni employer uchun '/profile'ga (auth ma'lumoti SSR'da yo'q bo'lsa, '/employer' qoldiring) yo'naltiring. pricing/+data.ts, +Head.tsx (indekslanadigan canonical), +Page.tsx checkout kodi o'lik — guard data'dan oldin ishlaydi — ularni olib tashlang yoki +Head'ga noindex qo'ying.
dependencies: Billing modulini izolyatsiya qilish qarori

title: robots.txt noindex sahifalarni Disallow qiladi (bot noindex'ni ko'ra olmaydi), mavjud bo'lmagan yo'llar bor, qidiruv/filtr tuzoqlari bloklanmagan
root_cause: PRIVATE_PATHS'da /dashboard va /account bor, lekin bunday sahifalar yo'q. /login, /signup, /profile va boshqa sahifalar bir vaqtda ham noindex meta'ga ega (login/+Head.tsx:12), ham Disallow qilingan. `/vacancies?q=`, `/companies?saved=1` va cheksiz filtr kombinatsiyalari bloklanmagan.
impact: Tashqi havolasi bor Disallow sahifalar 'Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt' bo'lib qolishi mumkin. Filtr kombinatsiyalari crawl budget'ni yeydi (20k vakansiya × filtrlar).
evidence: seo.routes.ts:28-43 PRIVATE_PATHS; pages/ ro'yxatida dashboard/account papkalari yo'q.
recommended_fix: /dashboard va /account'ni olib tashlang. Akkaunt sahifalarini Disallow'dan chiqarib, faqat noindex'ga tayaning (yoki aksincha — izchil bitta usul). `Disallow: /*?*saved=`, `/companies?saved=1` qo'shing. q uchun noindex (canonical finding) yetarli.
dependencies: Canonical/noindex finding'i

title: _error: ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND uchun meta/title tarmog'i yo'q; 500 xatoga ham '404 topilmadi' meta; 404 sahifada hreflang chiqadi
root_cause: +Head.tsx:12-20 va +title.ts:9-11 faqat VACANCY/COMPANY_NOT_FOUND'ni tekshiradi, is404 tekshirilmaydi. HeadDefault.tsx:52-55 alternates va x-default barcha sahifalarda, jumladan 404/noindex sahifalarda ham chiqadi.
impact: Maqola 404 sahifasida umumiy sarlavha chiqadi. 500 sahifada 'Sahifa topilmadi' title/description ko'rinadi. 404 URL'lar uchun hreflang juftliklari Search Console'da 'no return tags'/xato signal beradi. Status kodlari to'g'ri (Vike render(404)), shuning uchun ta'siri kichik.
evidence: _error/+title.ts:11 `return t.meta.notFound.title;` — is404 tekshiruvisiz; _error/+Page.tsx:19 ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND Page'da bor, Head'da yo'q.
recommended_fix: +Head/+title'ga ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND tarmog'ini (t.articles.detail notFound matnlari) va `pageContext.is404 === false` uchun t.error.title500 tarmog'ini qo'shing. HeadDefault'da `pageContext.is404 !== undefined` (error page) bo'lsa alternates'ni chiqarmang.

title: Admin vakansiyalar jadvali har qator (draft/rejected/archived) uchun /vacancies/:slug havolasini beradi — 404 ga olib boradi
root_cause: Havola status'ga qarab gating qilinmaydi. Employer VacancyRow esa `caps.viewPublic` bilan gating qiladi (components/employer/vacancies/VacancyRow.tsx:53,73), favorites/messages/applications `isClosed` bilan (FavoriteVacancyCard.tsx:52, ConversationDetails.tsx:239, ApplicationCard.tsx:65).
impact: Moderator rad etilgan yoki qoralama vakansiya kontentini ko'rish uchun bosganda 404 oladi, moderatsiya uchun preview yo'q.
evidence: admin/vacancies/+Page.tsx:114-115 `<a href={l(`/vacancies/${row.slug}`)}>` shartsiz.
recommended_fix: `row.status === 'active'` bo'lsa havola bering, aks holda matn qoldiring yoki admin preview (masalan /admin/vacancies?id=... drawer) oching.

title: /employer/@slug har qanday noma'lum bitta segmentni (/employer/profile, /employer/settings) /companies/<segment>'ga 301 qiladi
root_cause: Statik /employer/vacancies|applications|candidates ustun turadi (Vike static > param), lekin boshqa har qanday so'z kompaniya slug'i deb qabul qilinadi va doimiy (301) redirect beriladi.
impact: Yozuv xatosi yoki kelajakdagi yangi employer bo'limi (masalan /employer/company) avval brauzer va proxy keshida qoladigan 301 → /companies/company → 404 beradi. Keyin shu nomda statik sahifa qo'shilsa, eski 301 keshi foydalanuvchini noto'g'ri joyga olib boradi.
evidence: employer/@slug/+guard.ts:12-16 shartsiz `throw redirect(... `/companies/${slug}` ..., 301)`.
recommended_fix: Reserved segmentlar ro'yxatini (profile, settings, company, dashboard, billing, new) guard'da tekshirib, ular uchun render(404) qiling. Ixtiyoriy ravishda slug formatini regex bilan tekshiring.

title: ADMIN_PASSWORD / SMTP_PASS / TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / CLICK_SECRET_KEY — minimal tekshiruv yo'q; Payme webhook Basic auth parolini `===` bilan solishtiradi
root_cause: env.ts:82 `ADMIN_PASSWORD` uzunligi faqat ensure-admin.ts:32 da (`< 8` → yaratilmaydi) tekshiriladi — 8 belgili admin paroli ruxsat; billing.service.ts:312 `key === env.PAYME_KEY` va :326 `expected === sign_string` — timing-safe emas (tarmoq shovqini tufayli amaliy emas, lekin `crypto.timingSafeEqual` arzon). Telegram bot token URL'da (telegram.service.ts:14) — xatolik loglarida `method` va `description` gina yoziladi (:31), token chiqmaydi — OK. Google: tokeninfo orqali `aud` va `email_verified` tekshiriladi (auth.service.ts:153-164) — OK.
impact: Zaif admin paroli + login 10/min limit (XFF bilan chetlab o'tiladi) → admin brute-force; webhook'lar bepul platformada ishlatilmaydi (product rule 1), ta'sir past.
evidence: env.ts:81-82; ensure-admin.ts:32-38; billing.service.ts:301-327.
recommended_fix: `ADMIN_PASSWORD` uchun `.min(12)` (berilgan bo'lsa); `timingSafeEqual` (uzunlik tekshiruvi bilan); login'da email bo'yicha ham rate-limit kaliti.
dependencies: trustProxy fix'i

title: jwt.verify `algorithms` aniq berilmagan — hozir kutubxona defaulti (HS256/384/512) himoya qiladi, lekin sirni kalit-fayl/PEM'ga o'tkazilsa alg-confusion xavfi
root_cause: jwt.ts:140,144 `jwt.verify(token, secret)` options'siz. jsonwebtoken 9.0.3 verify.js:132-140 secret satr bo'lsa `HS_ALGS`ni o'zi qo'yadi, `none` rad etiladi (:116-117) — hozir xavfsiz. Ammo bu implicit; refresh va access sirlari o'zaro almashinuvi (`aud`/`typ` yo'q) — access sir bilan imzolangan tokenni refresh sifatida ishlatib bo'lmaydi (sirlar farqli bo'lsa), lekin ikkala sir bir xil qo'yilsa access token (payload'da `sub` bor) refresh cookie sifatida 30 kun emas, 15 daqiqa amal qiladi — kichik.
impact: Hozir ekspluatatsiya yo'q; kelajakdagi o'zgarishlarda (RS256'ga o'tish) klassik alg-confusion.
evidence: jwt.ts:139-145; node_modules/jsonwebtoken/verify.js:132-144.
recommended_fix: `jwt.verify(token, secret, { algorithms: ["HS256"] })`; sign'da `{ expiresIn, algorithm: "HS256" }`; refresh payload'ga `typ: "refresh"` qo'shib verify'da tekshirish; env'da ikki sir teng bo'lsa startup'da rad etish.
dependencies: P1 secret-length fix'i bilan birga

title: Admin broadcast `url` faqat `startsWith("/")` bilan tekshiriladi — `//evil.com` WS/push payload'iga o'zgarishsiz ketadi
root_cause: admin.routes.ts:522 `url: url && url.startsWith("/") ? url : "/"` — `//evil.com` va `/\evil.com` o'tadi. notifications.service.ts:82 (WS `url: input.url`) va :103 (push `url`) xom yuboradi; faqat REST o'qishda `urlFromPayload` (notifications.routes.ts:47-52) `//` ni rad etadi. Email CTA `absoluteUrl = WEB_ORIGIN + url` (:60) — `https://site//evil.com` → sayt ichida qoladi, xavfsiz.
impact: Faqat admin (ishonchli rol) tomonidan; real-time bildirishnoma/push'da ochiq redirect. Past ehtimol, lekin bitta joyda normalizatsiya arzon.
evidence: admin.routes.ts:522; notifications.service.ts:60,82,103; notifications.routes.ts:47-52.
recommended_fix: `urlFromPayload` mantiqini `common/validation.ts`ga `safeInternalPath()` sifatida ko'chirib broadcast va `notify()` kirishida qo'llash (`//`, `/\` rad).
dependencies: Yo'q

title: SameSite=None cookie bilan `/api/auth/logout` va `/api/auth/refresh` cross-site oddiy form POST'ga ochiq (CSRF logout)
root_cause: Prod'da cookie `sameSite: none` (auth.routes.ts:39); `/api/auth/logout` (:90-93) va `/api/auth/refresh` (:74-88) Origin/Content-Type tekshirmaydi. Cross-site `<form method=POST enctype=text/plain>` preflight'siz ketadi, cookie qo'shiladi. Fastify text/plain parser yo'q → 415 qaytarishi mumkin, lekin `clearCookie`/`setCookie` handler'gacha yetmaydi — logout uchun `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` ham parser yo'q (415). Amaliy ta'sir cheklangan, lekin Origin tekshiruvi arzon himoya.
impact: Hozirgi holatda (JSON parser'gina) cross-site form 415 oladi — CSRF amaliy emas; agar kelajakda form parser qo'shilsa yoki refresh GET'ga o'tsa — foydalanuvchini majburan chiqarish/cookie yangilash. Refresh javobi CORS'siz o'qilmaydi (CORS P0 bundan mustasno).
evidence: auth.routes.ts:37-42, :74, :90; server.ts'da formbody plugin yo'q.
recommended_fix: `/api/auth/*` uchun preHandler: `const o = req.headers.origin; if (o && !allowedOrigins.includes(o) && !VERCEL_PREVIEW.test(o)) throw Errors.forbidden()`; `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` bo'lsa rad etish. Formbody parser hech qachon qo'shmaslik.
dependencies: CORS fix'i (bir xil allowlist funksiyasini ulashish)

title: createCompanySchema `website: z.string().url()` `javascript:`/`data:` sxemalarini qabul qiladi; register'da firstName/lastName/password max uzunlik yo'q
root_cause: zod `.url()` har qanday sxemani o'tkazadi (`javascript:alert(1)` valid URL); POST /api/companies (companies.routes.ts:211-220) `...body` ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri saqlaydi (PUT'dagi `normalizeWebsite` (:42-46) faqat prefiks qo'shadi, sxemani tekshirmaydi). Web'da `websiteUrl()` (detail.ts:149-158) `https://` prefiks + hostname tekshiruvi bilan neytrallaydi — hozircha xavfsiz, lekin faqat frontend'ga tayanadi. auth.routes.ts:12-19: `firstName`/`lastName` cheksiz, `password` max yo'q (argon2 1MB body'ni hash'laydi), `description` createCompanySchema'da cheksiz.
impact: Backend authoritative prinsipiga zid: boshqa iste'molchi (Telegram bot, email, JSON-LD `sameAs`) xom `website`ni ishlatsa `javascript:` havola chiqadi. Cheksiz satrlar — 1MB ism/parol bilan DB va argon2 yuki.
evidence: companies.routes.ts:27 `website: z.string().url().optional()`, :217 `data: { ...body, ... }`; auth.routes.ts:16-17 `.optional()` max'siz, :14 `password: z.string().min(8)`; team.routes.ts:227 da `password ... .max(128)` bor — nomuvofiq.
recommended_fix: `website: z.string().max(200).refine(v => /^https?:\/\//i.test(normalizeWebsite(v)))` + `normalizeWebsite` create'da ham; register: `firstName/lastName .max(60)`, `password .max(128)`, `description .max(2000)`; vacancies createSchema'da `title .max(160)`, `description .max(20000)`.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: Telegram/email HTML escape qamrovi to'g'ri (tekshirildi) — faqat handleContact'dagi `phone` va admin `/myid` chatId escape'siz, lekin ikkalasi raqam
root_cause: Audit natijasi: chat xabari (chat.routes.ts:131 tgEscape), notify title/body (notifications.service.ts:94), support (support.routes.ts:135-140), admin reply (:278), email body'lar (applications.routes.ts:77,271-274; alerts.service.ts:155,171; team.routes.ts:144) — hammasi escape qilingan; renderEmail `body` ni xom qabul qiladi (mailer.ts:103) lekin barcha chaqiruvchilar escapeHtml ishlatadi. `phone` (:233 `+` + raqamlar) va `chatId` (:294) — raqamli, xavfsiz. `reason` → chat message matn sifatida saqlanadi, web'da dangerouslySetInnerHTML ishlatilmaydi (faqat JsonLd va THEME_INIT_SCRIPT).
impact: Hozir zaiflik yo'q; xavf — kelajakda `renderEmail({ body })` ga yangi chaqiruvchi escape'siz matn bersa. Nomuvofiqlik: `Errors`/AppError xabarlari Telegram'ga ketmaydi — OK.
evidence: telegram.service.ts:46-48; mailer.ts:72-116 (`${body}` xom); notifications.service.ts:125 `escapeHtml(input.body)`; grep dangerouslySetInnerHTML → 2 ta joy.
recommended_fix: `renderEmail` ga `body` o'rniga `bodyHtml` nomi + JSDoc "escape qilingan bo'lishi shart"; yoki `bodyText` (avtomatik escape) va `bodyHtml` ikkita parametr. Chat message'lar uchun `CONTROL_CHARS` tozalash (support.routes.ts:33 kabi) — Telegram xabarini buzmaslik uchun.
dependencies: Yo'q

title: moduleResolution 'Bundler' Node ESM runtime uchun extensionless importni ushlamaydi (dev tsx'da ishlaydi, prod'da yiqiladi); support.routes.ts'da xom NUL/control belgilar
root_cause: api tsconfig module ESNext + moduleResolution Bundler (tsconfig.json:4-5), runtime esa `node dist/server.js` (package.json:15). tsc '.js'siz relative import'ni xato demaydi, nodemon'dagi tsx (nodemon.json:5) uni hal qiladi, shuning uchun muammo faqat prod'da ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND bo'lib chiqadi. Hozircha barcha import'lar .js bilan (grep bo'sh). support.routes.ts:33 regex ichida 149 ta xom control bayt (\x00 va boshqalar) bor, shuning uchun git/grep faylni 'binary' deb biladi (diff/review ko'rinmaydi).
impact: Kelajakda bitta extensionless import 'dev'da ishlaydi, prod'da yiqiladi' holatini keltirib chiqaradi. support.routes.ts o'zgarishlari PR/diff'da 'Binary files differ' bo'lib ko'rinadi.
evidence: apps/api/tsconfig.json:4-5; apps/api/nodemon.json:5; apps/api/package.json:15; `grep -c $'\x00' support.routes.ts` = 149, `file` → 'data'; support.routes.ts:33 CONTROL_CHARS.
recommended_fix: api tsconfig: "module": "NodeNext", "moduleResolution": "NodeNext" (import'lar allaqachon .js bilan, shuning uchun o'zgarish kichik). support.routes.ts:33'ni escape bilan qayta yozing: /[�-]/g (ESLint no-control-regex izohi bilan). Lokal Node v24.15.0, engines >=20: CI'da Node 20 bilan ham build qiling (argon2 native prebuild).
dependencies: Yo'q
fix_risk: Past (NodeNext ba'zi type import'larda qo'shimcha tuzatish talab qilishi mumkin).

title: Vercel va self-hosted SSR farqlari: robots/sitemap proxy faqat Vercel'da, HSTS faqat vercel.json'da (includeSubDomains; preload), includeFiles dist/** klient aktivlarini funksiyaga qo'shadi, web'da engines yo'q
root_cause: vercel.json:12-17 robots/sitemap'ni api/seo.js'ga yuboradi, apps/web/server/index.mjs'da bunday route yo'q va public/'da robots.txt yo'q, shuning uchun self-hosted'da /robots.txt Vike 404 bo'ladi. HSTS preload+includeSubDomains (vercel.json:29-30) custom domen ildizida barcha subdomenlarni (masalan api.*) majburan HTTPS qiladi va preload'dan chiqish qiyin. server/index.mjs:40-45 va api/ssr.js:73-78'da HSTS yo'q (drift). includeFiles: "dist/**" (vercel.json:8) dist/client'ni ham funksiya bundle'iga qo'shadi. apps/web/package.json'da engines yo'q (Vercel Node versiyasi default).
impact: Self-hosted variantda SEO fayllari yo'q. Custom domen ulanganda noto'g'ri HSTS preload subdomenlarni sindirishi mumkin. Funksiya hajmi va cold start oshadi.
evidence: apps/web/vercel.json:6-9,11-18,28-31; apps/web/server/index.mjs:40-45,99-118; apps/web/api/ssr.js:73-78; apps/web/api/seo.js:15; apps/web/package.json (engines yo'q).
recommended_fix: includeFiles'ni "dist/server/**" ga toraytiring (Vike renderPage uchun dist/client/assets manifest kerak bo'lsa, tekshirib qoldiring). HSTS'dan 'preload'ni domen tayyor bo'lguncha olib tashlang. server/index.mjs'ga /robots.txt va /sitemap*.xml proxy (seo.js logikasi) qo'shing yoki self-hosted variant qo'llab-quvvatlanmasligini hujjatlang. "engines": {"node": ">=20"} qo'shing.
dependencies: Vike build manifest joylashuvi (includeFiles toraytirishdan oldin tekshirilsin).
fix_risk: O'rta (includeFiles toraytirish SSR'ni sindirishi mumkin — preview deployda tekshiring).

title: Playwright skriptlari eskirgan URL, eski seed slug va qayd etilmagan dependency'ga tayanadi
root_cause: '/search/vacancy' endi /vacancies'ga 301 redirect (apps/web/src/pages/search/vacancy/+guard.ts), '/vacancy/demo-frontend-dasturchi-react' esa /vacancies/:slug'ga 301 (pages/vacancy/@slug/+guard.ts). Slug eski seed.ts:179'dan olingan, demo-seed (@demo.ish.top) emas. test_hover.py qat'iy clip koordinatalari va 'Frontend dasturchi (React)' matniga bog'langan. playwright hech qayerda dependency sifatida ko'rsatilmagan, skriptlar hujjatlanmagan.
impact: Skriptlar redirect sahifalarni screenshot qiladi yoki demo-seed bilan 404 detail oladi. Dizayn regressiyasini ushlamaydi va chalg'itadi.
evidence: scripts/test_frontend.py:6-10,39; scripts/test_hover.py (page.goto '/search/vacancy', locator 'Frontend dasturchi (React)'); apps/api/src/prisma/seed.ts:179.
recommended_fix: URL'larni /vacancies, /vacancies/<demo-seed slug>, /companies, /articles, /ru, /en ga yangilang. BASE_URL'ni env'dan oling. requirements.txt yoki README bo'limi qo'shing. Foydasiz bo'lsa test_hover.py'ni o'chiring.
dependencies: demo-seed slug'lari

title: WS xabar tanasi tipi tekshirilmaydi — obyekt/massiv `String()` orqali "[object Object]" sifatida saqlanadi
root_cause: 108 `const body = String(data.body ?? "").trim();` — `data.body` string ekani tekshirilmaydi; `type`/`conversationId` ham xuddi shunday. Xabar uzunligi 4000 ga kesiladi (112), lekin kiruvchi frame hajmi cheklanmagan (JSON.parse katta payload).
impact: Nomaqbul matnli xabarlar bazaga tushadi; katta JSON frame'lar xotira yuki.
evidence: chat.routes.ts:84-86 `data = JSON.parse(raw.toString())`; :108.
recommended_fix: `typeof data.body !== "string"` bo'lsa e'tiborsiz qoldirish; `raw.length > 16_384` bo'lsa tashlab yuborish; `@fastify/websocket` `options.maxPayload` sozlash.
dependencies: P0 WS topilmasi bilan birga

title: Bir nechta mutatsiya funksiyalari backend xabarini tashlab, umumiy 'Xatolik' beradi (409 transition, 403 PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED, 400 validatsiya matni yo'qoladi)
root_cause: `setVacancyStatus` (760-768), `deleteVacancy` (770-777), `setApplicationStatus` (788-801), `deleteReview` (485-492) `!res.ok` da `new ApiError(res.status, "Xatolik")` — javob JSON'idagi `message`/`error` o'qilmaydi. Boshqa funksiyalar (`updateVacancy` 743-744) to'g'ri o'qiydi.
impact: Foydalanuvchi vakansiya holatini o'zgartira olmaganda sababi ("Bu holatdagi vakansiyaning holatini o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi") ko'rinmaydi; `isPhoneGateError` kabi kod bo'yicha aniqlash ishlamaydi.
evidence: api.ts:767 `if (!res.ok) throw new ApiError(res.status, "Xatolik");`; :800; :491.
recommended_fix: Bitta `throwIfNotOk(res)` yordamchisi: `json?.message ?? "Xatolik", json?.error` — `updateVacancy` naqshi.
